items.summary_zh: CRISPR/Cas9诱导的DNA双链断裂（DSBs）广泛应用于基因组工程，但其引发姐妹染色单体交换（SCE）的能力尚未完全理解。我们使用可扩展的单细胞模板链测序平台sci-L3-Strand-seq，绘制了在靶向Cas9切割后发生的SCE图谱。针对独特基因组位点的Cas9靶向显著增强了断裂位点的SCE，达到同一细胞周期41%和后续分裂17%的水平，表明非局部姐妹修复频繁。靶向237个重复Alu位点产生了轻微的靶向SCE富集，而SCE负担较高的细胞在程序切割位点显示显著富集，提示在重复位点的重组依赖于上下文。互惠子细胞对分析揭示了诱导SCE的染色体上存在大规模结构改变，表明Cas9诱导的SCE并不普遍反映无误的同源重组。LIG3、LIG4、XRCC1和XRCC4在Cas9切割位点的破坏未显著改变SCE频率，符合编辑后功能丧失的延迟。总之，这些发现表明Cas9诱导的DSBs是强有力的SCE局部触发因子，并揭示了不可见的结构结果。
items.l1_lead: 研究表明，CRISPR/Cas9诱导的DNA双链断裂显著增强了姐妹染色单体交换的发生，揭示了其在基因组修复中的复杂机制和潜在的结构改变。
items.l2_summary:
本研究探讨了CRISPR/Cas9诱导的DNA双链断裂（DSBs）在全基因组范围内对姐妹染色单体交换（SCE）的影响。尽管CRISPR/Cas9技术在基因组工程中得到了广泛应用，但其引发SCE的机制尚未完全阐明。研究团队采用了可扩展的单细胞模板链测序平台sci-L3-Strand-seq，绘制了在Cas9靶向切割后发生的SCE图谱。结果显示，针对特定基因组位点的Cas9靶向显著增强了断裂位点的SCE，达到同一细胞周期41%和后续分裂17%的水平，表明非局部姐妹修复的频率较高。

此外，研究还发现，靶向237个重复Alu位点时，虽然产生了轻微的SCE富集，但在SCE负担较高的细胞中，程序切割位点显示出显著的富集，提示重复位点的重组过程依赖于其上下文。通过互惠子细胞的分析，研究揭示了诱导SCE的染色体上存在大规模的结构改变，这表明Cas9诱导的SCE并不总是反映无误的同源重组过程。

值得注意的是，LIG3、LIG4、XRCC1和XRCC4等基因在Cas9切割位点的破坏并未显著改变SCE频率，这与编辑后功能丧失的延迟相符。综上所述，这些发现表明，Cas9诱导的DSBs是强有力的SCE局部触发因子，并揭示了在这一过程中可能存在的不可见结构结果，为理解CRISPR/Cas9技术在基因组编辑中的作用提供了新的视角。

items.title: Large-scale prospective evaluation of co-folding across hundreds of Mac1–ligand complexes and three virtual screens
items.abstract: Accurate prediction of ligand-bound protein complexes and ranking them by affinity are central problems in drug discovery. While deep-learning co-folding methods can help address these challenges, their evaluation has been hampered by the difficulties in assessing independence from training data and insufficiently large test sets. Here, we test the ability of co-folding methods to predict the structures of 551 ligands, 489 of which are of sufficient quality for evaluation, bound to the SARS-CoV-2 NSP3 macrodomain (Mac1) that were determined after the training cutoff dates. AlphaFold3 (AF3), Boltz-2, and Chai-1 each reproduced 50% of the Mac1 ligand poses to better than 2 Å root-mean-square deviation of experiment. Despite the potential for co-folding to describe protein conformational changes that stabilize ligand binding, we did not find that common conformational rearrangements, including peptide flip and a large loop opening, were recapitulated by the co-folding prediction. For AF3 and Chai-1, ligand pose prediction confidence weakly, but significantly, tracked experimental potency, while DOCK3.7 energies were only weakly correlated. Boltz-2 affinity predictions showed the strongest correlation with measured potency and, after calibration, achieved lower mean absolute error than a baseline predictor. We next assessed whether co-folding scores could rescore docking hit lists to distinguish true ligands from non-binders among hundreds of molecules prospectively experimentally tested against AmpC β-lactamase, the dopamine D4, and the σ 2 receptors. AF3 ligand pose confidence values did not separate true ligands from high-scoring false positives as effectively as docking scores or Boltz-2 affinity predictions did. Taken together, the modest, but independent correlations of docking score and co-folding confidence or affinity suggest that integrating physics-based and deep-learning approaches may help with hit prioritization and subsequent optimization in structure-based ligand discovery.

items.title: Starvation transforms signal encoding in C. elegans thermoresponsive neurons and suppresses heat avoidance via bidirectional glutamatergic and peptidergic signaling
items.abstract: Animals must continuously adapt their behavioral outputs in response to changes in internal state, including nutritional state. Here, we show that starvation induces a profound and progressive suppression of thermonociceptive behavior in Caenorhabditis elegans . During early food deprivation (1 hr without food), the thermoresponsive AWC sensory neurons mediate robust heat-evoked reversals over a broad range of stimulus intensities via glutamate and FLP-6 neuropeptide signaling, each covering distinct heat intensity ranges. After 6 hr of food deprivation (prolonged starvation), heat-evoked reversal responses are nearly abolished, independently of external food odor cues. Starvation shifts the distribution of AWC heat-evoked calcium response polarity, from mostly excitatory responses to a heterogeneous pattern combining excitatory and inhibitory activities. This switch relies on ASI neurons, proposed to sense internal state. INS-32 and NLP-18 neuropeptide signals from ASI switch from reversal-promoting to reversal-inhibiting effects. In addition, reversal-promoting glutamatergic transmission by AWC is antagonized by glutamatergic transmission from non-AWC neurons that suppress FLP-6-dependent reversals. Our findings define a circuit logic by which gating of nociceptive responsiveness by internal nutritional state is linked to dynamic modulation of sensory neuron activity patterns and orchestrated by bidirectional glutamatergic and neuropeptidergic signals.
items.title_zh: 饥饿改变秀丽隐杆线虫热敏神经元信号编码
items.summary_zh: 动物必须根据内部状态的变化（包括营养状态）不断调整其行为输出。本研究表明，饥饿会显著抑制秀丽隐杆线虫的热痛觉行为。在早期食物剥夺（无食物1小时）期间，热敏感的AWC感觉神经元通过谷氨酸和FLP-6神经肽信号介导强烈的热刺激引发的反转行为，覆盖不同的热强度范围。然而，在食物剥夺6小时后（长期饥饿），热刺激引发的反转反应几乎消失，与外部食物气味线索无关。饥饿改变了AWC热刺激引发的钙响应极性，从主要的兴奋性反应转变为结合兴奋性和抑制性活动的异质模式。这一转变依赖于感知内部状态的ASI神经元。来自ASI的INS-32和NLP-18神经肽信号从促进反转转变为抑制反转。此外，AWC的促进反转的谷氨酸能传递被来自非AWC神经元的谷氨酸能传递所拮抗，这些非AWC神经元抑制FLP-6依赖的反转。我们的研究定义了一种电路逻辑，通过内部营养状态调控痛觉反应性与感觉神经元活动模式的动态调节相联系。
items.l1_lead: 研究发现，饥饿状态显著改变秀丽隐杆线虫热敏神经元的信号编码，导致热痛觉行为的抑制和神经元活动模式的动态调节。
items.l2_summary:
本研究探讨了饥饿如何影响秀丽隐杆线虫（Caenorhabditis elegans）热敏神经元的信号编码及其行为反应。动物在面对内部状态变化（如营养状态）时，必须不断调整其行为输出。研究发现，饥饿显著抑制了秀丽隐杆线虫的热痛觉行为。在经历1小时的食物剥夺后，热敏感的AWC（AWC感受器）感觉神经元通过谷氨酸（glutamate）和FLP-6神经肽信号介导了强烈的热刺激引发的反转行为，且这种反应覆盖了不同的热强度范围。然而，当食物剥夺时间延长至6小时（长期饥饿）时，热刺激引发的反转反应几乎消失，这一变化与外部食物气味线索无关。

研究进一步揭示，饥饿改变了AWC热刺激引发的钙响应极性，从主要的兴奋性反应转变为结合兴奋性和抑制性活动的异质模式。这一转变依赖于感知内部状态的ASI（ASI神经元）神经元。来自ASI的INS-32和NLP-18神经肽信号的作用也发生了变化，从促进反转转变为抑制反转。此外，AWC的促进反转的谷氨酸能传递被来自非AWC神经元的谷氨酸能传递所拮抗，这些非AWC神经元抑制了FLP-6依赖的反转。

综上所述，本研究定义了一种电路逻辑，揭示了内部营养状态如何调控痛觉反应性与感觉神经元活动模式的动态调节之间的关系。这一发现为理解动物如何根据营养状态调整其行为提供了新的视角，并可能对研究其他生物体的行为调节机制具有重要启示。

items.title: Punctuated mutagenesis promotes multi-step evolutionary adaptation in human cancers
items.abstract: The rate of acquisition of genomic changes in cancer has been the topic of much discussion, with several recent investigations finding evidence of punctuated evolution instead of gradual accumulation of such changes. Despite forays into the description and quantification of these punctuated events, the effects of such changes on subsequent cancer evolution remain incompletely understood. Here we investigate how non-gradual mutagenesis affects the ability of tumor cells to acquire and retain fitness-enhancing adaptations. We find that punctuated mutagenesis significantly facilitates adaptation in scenarios where adaptation requires crossing a fitness valley, that is when multiple mutations are required which individually are maladaptive but jointly confer a fitness advantage. By increasing the probability that multiple mutations occur in close succession, punctuation increases the chance that mutants in a fitness valley mutate further to reach a fitness peak before going extinct. Analyzing data from The Cancer Genome Atlas, we find that tumors with signatures of APOBEC mutagenesis, which has been shown to proceed in episodic bursts, exhibit patterns consistent with higher rates of crossing fitness valleys. Lastly, we characterize how the interplay between this enhanced ability to cross fitness valleys and adaptation-limiting effects of clonal interference affects overall adaptability in complex fitness landscapes.
items.title_zh: 突变突发促进人类癌症的多步进化适应
items.summary_zh: 癌症中基因组变化的获取速率一直是讨论的热点，近期研究发现突变进化的证据，表明其并非逐渐积累。本文探讨非渐进性突变如何影响肿瘤细胞获取和保持适应性增强的能力。研究发现，突变突发显著促进适应，尤其在需要跨越适应性谷的情况下，即多个单独不适应但共同赋予适应优势的突变。通过增加多个突变紧密发生的概率，突变突发提高了在适应性谷中的突变体进一步突变以达到适应性峰值的机会。分析癌症基因组图谱的数据，我们发现具有APOBEC突变特征的肿瘤表现出更高的跨越适应性谷的速率。最后，我们描述了这种跨越适应性谷的增强能力与克隆干扰的适应限制效应之间的相互作用如何影响整体适应性。
items.l1_lead: 突变突发显著提升肿瘤细胞跨越适应性谷的能力，促进癌症的多步进化适应。
items.l2_summary:
近期的研究揭示了癌症中基因组变化的获取速率并非如以往认为的那样是逐渐积累的，而是存在突变突发的现象，这一发现为理解肿瘤细胞的适应性进化提供了新的视角。研究表明，非渐进性突变在肿瘤细胞获取和保持适应性增强的能力中起着重要作用，尤其是在需要跨越适应性谷的情况下。适应性谷是指多个单独不适应但共同赋予适应优势的突变所形成的障碍。突变突发通过增加多个突变紧密发生的概率，显著提高了在适应性谷中的突变体进一步突变以达到适应性峰值的机会。

通过对癌症基因组图谱的数据分析，研究发现具有APOBEC突变特征的肿瘤表现出更高的跨越适应性谷的速率。这一发现强调了突变突发在癌症进化中的重要性，尤其是在肿瘤细胞面临适应性挑战时。研究还探讨了跨越适应性谷的增强能力与克隆干扰的适应限制效应之间的相互作用，指出这种相互作用可能会影响整体适应性。

综上所述，突变突发不仅加速了肿瘤细胞的适应性进化，还为我们理解癌症的复杂性提供了新的思路。这一研究成果可能为未来癌症治疗策略的制定提供重要的理论基础，尤其是在针对肿瘤细胞适应性变化的干预措施上。

items.title: The structural context of mutations in proteins predicts their effect on antibiotic resistance
items.abstract: In Mycobacterium tuberculosis , a prevalent and deadly pathogen, resistance to antibiotics evolves primarily through non-synonymous mutations in proteins. Sequence-based analyses can uncover the genetic basis of antibiotic resistance, but these methods focus on primary sequence and often neglect other biological signals, such as protein structural information. We hypothesize that integrating the structural context of mutations improves the prediction of effects on function and phenotype. We curate high-confidence structural annotations for the M. tuberculosis proteome from 1350 crystallography and 2337 AlphaFold predictions, and mutations from over 31,000 M. tuberculosis isolates. We demonstrate that mutations in proteins known to cause resistance are clustered in 3D space, even in proteins where inactivating mutations at any position are thought to cause resistance. We find over 450 proteins in the M. tuberculosis proteome that display signals of clustered mutations, many of which have a known relationship with antibiotic resistance. We show that a supervised classifier trained on 3D distance to known resistance sites alone has an F 1 score of 96.5% at classifying mutations as resistance-conferring on a held-out test set. This work demonstrates that protein structure provides useful information for categorizing which variants may cause antibiotic resistance, even when the majority of structures are AI-predicted.
items.title_zh: 突变在蛋白质中的结构背景预测抗生素耐药性影响
items.summary_zh: 在一种常见且致命的病原体结核分枝杆菌中，抗生素耐药性主要通过蛋白质中的非同义突变进化。基于序列的分析可以揭示抗生素耐药性的遗传基础，但这些方法往往忽视蛋白质结构信息。我们假设整合突变的结构背景可以改善对功能和表型影响的预测。我们从1350个晶体学数据和2337个AlphaFold预测中整理了结核分枝杆菌蛋白组的高置信度结构注释，并分析了超过31,000个结核分枝杆菌分离株的突变。研究表明，已知导致耐药性的突变在三维空间中聚集，尽管在某些蛋白质中，任何位置的失活突变都被认为会导致耐药性。我们发现结核分枝杆菌蛋白组中有超过450个蛋白质显示出突变聚集的信号，许多与抗生素耐药性有已知关系。我们展示了一个基于已知耐药位点的三维距离训练的监督分类器在分类突变为耐药性突变时，在保留的测试集上获得了96.5%的F1分数。此研究表明，蛋白质结构为分类可能导致抗生素耐药性的变异提供了有用信息。
items.l1_lead: 研究表明，整合蛋白质结构信息可以显著提高对结核分枝杆菌抗生素耐药性突变的预测准确性。
items.l2_summary:
在结核分枝杆菌（Mycobacterium tuberculosis）这一常见且致命的病原体中，抗生素耐药性主要通过蛋白质中的非同义突变（nonsynonymous mutations）进化。尽管基于序列的分析能够揭示抗生素耐药性的遗传基础，但这些方法往往忽视了蛋白质的结构信息。为此，研究者们假设整合突变的结构背景能够改善对功能和表型影响的预测。为验证这一假设，研究团队整理了1350个晶体学数据和2337个AlphaFold预测，构建了结核分枝杆菌蛋白组的高置信度结构注释，并分析了超过31,000个结核分枝杆菌分离株的突变情况。

研究结果表明，已知导致耐药性的突变在三维空间中呈现聚集现象，尽管在某些蛋白质中，任何位置的失活突变都被认为可能导致耐药性。此外，研究发现结核分枝杆菌蛋白组中有超过450个蛋白质显示出突变聚集的信号，其中许多蛋白质与抗生素耐药性有已知的关系。为了进一步验证这一发现，研究者们展示了一个基于已知耐药位点的三维距离训练的监督分类器（supervised classifier），该分类器在分类突变为耐药性突变时，在保留的测试集上获得了96.5%的F1分数。

综上所述，该研究表明，蛋白质的结构信息为分类可能导致抗生素耐药性的变异提供了重要的参考依据，整合结构背景的分析方法能够显著提高对抗生素耐药性突变的预测能力。这一发现不仅为理解结核分枝杆菌的耐药机制提供了新的视角，也为未来抗生素耐药性研究和新药开发提供了潜在的方向。

items.title: Obtaining maximum information from colony counts with REPOP
items.abstract: Bacterial counts from native environments, such as soil or the animal gut, often show substantial variability across replicate samples. This heterogeneity is typically attributed to genetic or environmental factors. A common approach to estimating bacterial populations involves successive dilution and plating, followed by multiplying colony counts by dilution factors. This method, however, overestimates the heterogeneity in bacterial population because it conflates the inherent uncertainty in drawing a subsample from the total population with the uncertainty in the sample arising from biological origins. In other words, this approach may obscure features that may otherwise be present in the data, hinting at the presence of genuine subpopulations. For example, in plate counting applied to Caenorhabditis elegans gut microbiota, observed multimodality is often interpreted as large host-to-host variance, while the randomness introduced by measurement is frequently ignored. To explicitly account for the uncertainty introduced by dilution and plating randomness, we introduce REPOP, a PyTorch-based library to REconstruct POpulations from Plates within a Bayesian framework. Beyond simple cases, REPOP addresses more complex scenarios, including multimodal populations and correcting the mathematically subtle, but experimentally relevant, bias introduced by excluding plates deemed too crowded to distinguish individual colonies. We demonstrate REPOP’s ability to resolve distinct population peaks otherwise obscured by standard multiplication methods. Applications to both simulated and experimental datasets, including bacterial samples of different concentrations and ones from the gut microbiota of C. elegans , show that REPOP accurately recovers the underlying multimodality by properly accounting for error propagation, where naive multiplication fails. REPOP is available on GitHub: https://github.com/LabPresse/REPOP .

items.title: A membrane-disruptive action of VBIT-4 challenges its role as a widely used VDAC1 oligomerization inhibitor
items.abstract: Voltage-dependent anion channel (VDAC) is the most abundant protein of the mitochondrial outer membrane and a key regulator of metabolite exchange and mitochondrial physiology. Its oligomerization has been proposed to control processes such as mitochondrial DNA release and membrane remodeling, yet the underlying mechanisms remain poorly defined. VBIT-4 has been widely used as a putative inhibitor of VDAC1 oligomerization, despite limited mechanistic validation. Here, using high-speed atomic force microscopy (AFM), we visualized VDAC1 assemblies in lipid membranes and examined the effect of VBIT-4. Unexpectedly, VBIT-4 induced membrane defects and permeabilization at micromolar concentrations, independently of VDAC1. Quantitative AFM analysis further shows that VBIT-4 does not alter VDAC1 cluster organization. Complementary electrophysiology, microscale thermophoresis, and coarse-grained molecular dynamics demonstrate that VBIT-4 partitions into lipid bilayers, increases membrane permeability, and destabilizes membrane structure, without detectable effects on VDAC1 channel properties or assemblies. Consistent with this mechanism, VBIT-4 induces VDAC1-independent cytotoxicity in HeLa cells at concentrations above 10 µM. Together, these results demonstrate that VBIT-4 does not act as a specific inhibitor of VDAC1 oligomerization but instead functions as a membrane-active compound. This work provides a revised framework for interpreting studies using VBIT-4 and highlights the importance of systematically assessing drug-membrane interactions when targeting membrane proteins.

items.title: Role of desolvation on biomolecular liquid–liquid phase separation
items.abstract: Biomolecular condensates play essential roles in cellular organization and are implicated in diverse pathological processes. Their formation is driven by liquid–liquid phase separation (LLPS), a process that requires coordinated multistep desolvation of biomolecular chains and multivalent inter-chain interactions. Although coarse-grained (CG) models with implicit solvent are widely used to probe LLPS thermodynamics and kinetics, they typically neglect water-mediated desolvation effects, limiting their accuracy and mechanistic interpretability. Here, guided by all-atom simulations and experimental measurements, we develop a desolvation-aware implicit-solvent CG model by incorporating residue-level desolvation terms directly into the pairwise energy function, and apply it to investigate LLPS of intrinsically disordered proteins. Incorporating these desolvation interactions reshapes the phase diagram, alleviating dense-phase overcompaction. Notably, we observe an approximately linear correlation between the temperature gap (simulation temperature relative to the critical point) and the extent of conformational expansion accompanying the dilute-to-dense phase transition, a result further supported by theoretical analysis. We also find that desolvation barriers slow early density-fluctuation growth and shorten transient kinetic arrest, whereas solvent-separated contact interactions exert the opposite effects. Both terms further modulate chain mobility within mature condensates through competing packing and energy-landscape effects. Together, this framework enables an efficient representation of desolvation in CG simulations and reveals how desolvation energetics shape both the thermodynamic landscape and kinetic properties of biomolecular LLPS.

items.title: Early recruitment of membrane-bound DNaseX to phagocytic cups in macrophages
items.abstract: Macrophages engulf and degrade pathogens and cellular debris through phagocytosis. The degradation process was generally believed to occur only after phagosome internalization and maturation. Here, we report an early DNase activity at the nascent phagocytic cup (PC) prior to its closure. Using a fluorescent DNase sensor, we revealed rapid and ubiquitous DNase activity upon PC formation across various macrophage types. We further identified the responsible enzyme as the membrane-bound DNaseX, which is constitutively recruited to the PC during PC formation. F-actin polymerization was found to correlate with DNase activity in the PC, likely by promoting physical engagement of DNaseX with solid DNA materials. Functionally, we show that macrophages degrade extracellular DNA (eDNA) within bacterial biofilms through direct physical contact, clearing the eDNA structures without internalization. These findings reveal a previously unrecognized DNA degradation mechanism operating at the macrophage membrane, suitable for degrading bulky eDNA materials which cannot be directly internalized by macrophages.
items.title_zh: 巨噬细胞膜结合DNaseX早期招募至吞噬杯
items.summary_zh: 巨噬细胞通过吞噬作用摄取和降解病原体及细胞碎片。传统上认为降解过程仅在吞噬体内化和成熟后发生。本文报告了在吞噬杯形成初期，即其闭合之前，观察到早期的DNase活性。我们使用荧光DNase传感器揭示了在不同类型巨噬细胞的吞噬杯形成过程中，DNase活性迅速且普遍。进一步确认该酶为膜结合的DNaseX，其在吞噬杯形成过程中持续招募。研究发现F-actin聚合与吞噬杯中的DNase活性相关，可能通过促进DNaseX与固体DNA材料的物理接触。功能上，我们展示了巨噬细胞通过直接物理接触降解细菌生物膜中的细胞外DNA（eDNA），在不内化的情况下清除eDNA结构。这些发现揭示了一种在巨噬细胞膜上运作的全新DNA降解机制，适用于降解无法直接内化的庞大eDNA材料。
items.l1_lead: 研究发现巨噬细胞在吞噬杯形成初期通过膜结合的DNaseX直接降解细菌生物膜中的细胞外DNA，揭示了一种新型的DNA降解机制。
items.l2_summary:
巨噬细胞是免疫系统中的重要组成部分，负责通过吞噬作用摄取和降解病原体及细胞碎片。传统观点认为，巨噬细胞的降解过程主要发生在吞噬体内化和成熟之后。然而，最新研究发现，在吞噬杯形成的早期阶段，即其闭合之前，巨噬细胞已经表现出早期的DNase活性。研究团队使用荧光DNase传感器观察到，在不同类型的巨噬细胞的吞噬杯形成过程中，DNase活性迅速且普遍地被激活。

进一步的实验确认了这一酶为膜结合的DNaseX，其在吞噬杯形成过程中持续被招募。研究还发现，F-actin聚合与吞噬杯中的DNase活性相关，可能通过促进DNaseX与固体DNA材料之间的物理接触来实现这一过程。功能性实验表明，巨噬细胞能够通过直接的物理接触降解细菌生物膜中的细胞外DNA（extracellular DNA, eDNA），而无需将其内化。这一发现揭示了一种全新的DNA降解机制，表明巨噬细胞能够有效清除无法直接内化的庞大eDNA材料。

综上所述，该研究不仅挑战了传统的巨噬细胞降解机制的理解，还为巨噬细胞在免疫应答中的作用提供了新的视角，强调了膜结合DNaseX在吞噬杯形成早期阶段的重要性。这一机制的发现可能为未来的免疫治疗和相关疾病的研究提供新的思路。

items.title: Genome-wide synthetic lethality screen of Bam complex-associated genes in Escherichia coli
items.abstract: Biogenesis of the bacterial outer membrane is key to bacterial survival and antibiotic resistance. Central to this is the β-barrel assembly machine (Bam) complex and its associated chaperones, which are responsible for transport, folding, and insertion of outer membrane proteins (OMPs). The Escherichia coli Bam complex is composed of two essential subunits, BamA and BamD, and three non-essential accessory lipoproteins, BamB, BamC, and BamE. Optimal Bam function is further dependent on the non-essential periplasmic chaperones DegP, Skp, and SurA. Despite intensive study, the specific function of these non-essential Bam-associated proteins is not fully understood. Here, we analysed Δ bamB , Δ bamC , Δ bamE , Δ surA , Δ skp, and Δ degP knockout strains by phenotypic screening, conservation analysis and high-throughput genetics. We identified hundreds of synthetic-lethal interactions and revealed that Bam complex activity is impacted by changes in outer membrane lipid composition and that enterobacterial common antigen is essential in the absence of the chaperone SurA. We also show that genes responsible for synthesis of peptidoglycan are synthetically lethal with Bam accessory lipoprotein encoding genes. Together, our data indicate potential mechanisms for coordination of OMP biogenesis with other cellular growth processes, such as LPS and peptidoglycan biogenesis.
items.title_zh: 大肠杆菌Bam复合体相关基因的全基因组合成致死筛选
items.summary_zh: 细菌外膜的生物合成对细菌生存和抗生素耐药性至关重要。β-桶组装机器（Bam）复合体及其相关伴侣负责外膜蛋白（OMP）的运输、折叠和插入。大肠杆菌Bam复合体由两个必需亚基BamA和BamD以及三个非必需的辅助脂蛋白BamB、BamC和BamE组成。最佳的Bam功能还依赖于非必需的周质伴侣DegP、Skp和SurA。尽管进行了深入研究，这些非必需Bam相关蛋白的具体功能仍不完全清楚。我们通过表型筛选、保守性分析和高通量遗传学分析了ΔbamB、ΔbamC、ΔbamE、ΔsurA、Δskp和ΔdegP敲除株，识别出数百个合成致死相互作用，并揭示Bam复合体活性受到外膜脂质组成变化的影响，且在缺乏伴侣SurA的情况下，肠杆菌共同抗原是必需的。我们的研究表明，负责肽聚糖合成的基因与Bam辅助脂蛋白编码基因具有合成致死性，提示OMP生物合成与其他细胞生长过程（如LPS和肽聚糖生物合成）之间的协调机制。
items.l1_lead: 研究发现大肠杆菌Bam复合体的非必需伴侣蛋白与肽聚糖合成基因存在合成致死性，揭示了外膜蛋白生物合成与细胞生长过程之间的协调机制。
items.l2_summary:
细菌外膜的生物合成在细菌的生存和抗生素耐药性中扮演着重要角色，而β-桶组装机器（Bam）复合体及其相关伴侣则负责外膜蛋白（OMP）的运输、折叠和插入。大肠杆菌的Bam复合体由两个必需亚基BamA和BamD以及三个非必需的辅助脂蛋白BamB、BamC和BamE组成。此外，Bam复合体的最佳功能还依赖于非必需的周质伴侣DegP、Skp和SurA。尽管这些非必需Bam相关蛋白的功能已被广泛研究，但其具体作用仍不完全明确。

本研究通过表型筛选、保守性分析和高通量遗传学分析，对ΔbamB、ΔbamC、ΔbamE、ΔsurA、Δskp和ΔdegP敲除株进行了深入探讨，识别出数百个合成致死相互作用。这些结果表明，Bam复合体的活性受到外膜脂质组成变化的影响，且在缺乏伴侣SurA的情况下，肠杆菌共同抗原是必需的。此外，研究还发现，负责肽聚糖合成的基因与Bam辅助脂蛋白编码基因之间存在合成致死性，这提示OMP生物合成与其他细胞生长过程（如脂多糖（LPS）和肽聚糖生物合成）之间存在协调机制。

综上所述，本研究揭示了大肠杆菌Bam复合体相关基因在外膜蛋白生物合成中的重要性，并强调了其与其他细胞生长过程的相互关系，为理解细菌的生存机制和抗生素耐药性提供了新的视角。

items.title: Circadian photoreceptor CRYPTOCHROME promotes wakefulness under short winter-like days via a GABAergic circuitry
items.abstract: A cardinal symptom of seasonal affective disorder (SAD, also known as winter depression) is hypersomnolence, while the cause of this ‘winter sleepiness’ is not known. Here, we found that lack of the circadian photoreceptor cryptochrome ( cry ) leads to increased sleep under short winter-like days in the fruit fly Drosophila , reminiscent of the hypersomnolence in SAD. CRY functions in neurons that synthesize the major inhibitory neurotransmitter GABA, including the small ventral lateral neurons, which are known to be circadian pacemakers, and downregulates the GABAergic tone. This, in turn, leads to increased neural activity of the wake-promoting large ventral lateral neurons, a subset of circadian neurons that are inhibited by GABA-A receptors. CRY protein is known to be degraded by light, thus rendering CRY to be functional within this GABAergic circuitry to enhance wakefulness only under short-day length. Taken together, we demonstrate a mechanism that specifically regulates wakefulness under short winter-like days, which may provide insights regarding the winter sleepiness in SAD.

items.title: Photo-downregulation of SIRT4 mitigates aging in mice by enhancing H3K9ac via fatty acid metabolism
items.abstract: As organisms age, mitochondrial metabolic activity declines, and disrupted gene expression regulation mediated by histone acetylation induces the emergence of senescent physiological phenotypes in tissues. In this study, we found that periodic exposure to red light significantly increased histone H3 Lys9 acetylation (H3K9ac) levels in the tissues and organs of aged mice. Following red light exposure, silent information regulation factor 4 (SIRT4) protein levels in keratinocytes were notably reduced, whereas glycolysis, fatty acid metabolism, and the tricarboxylic acid (TCA) cycle were significantly activated in keratinocytes. The reduction in mitochondrial SIRT4 levels enhances the acetylation of mitochondrial metabolic proteins, particularly malonyl-CoA decarboxylase, a potent inhibitor of the key rate-limiting enzyme carnitine palmitoyltransferase 1A (CPT1A) in fatty acid oxidation. This process promotes mitochondrial fatty acid oxidation and the TCA cycle. Additionally, the decrease in SIRT4 activates SIRT1 through feedback mechanisms, thereby alleviating its inhibition on PPAR-α in senescent keratinocytes and comprehensively activating the expression of genes related to lipid metabolism. This lipid metabolism activation ultimately facilitates the accumulation of acetyl-CoA within keratinocytes, increases H3K9ac levels, and reshapes the expression patterns of senescence-related genes. Eventually, cellular aging is effectively mitigated by the synergistic regulation of metabolism, inflammation, and gene expression.
items.title_zh: 光调节SIRT4缓解小鼠衰老通过脂肪酸代谢增强H3K9ac
items.summary_zh: 随着生物体的衰老，线粒体代谢活性下降，组蛋白乙酰化介导的基因表达调控失常导致组织中衰老生理表型的出现。本研究发现，定期暴露于红光显著提高了衰老小鼠组织和器官中组蛋白H3赖氨酸9的乙酰化水平（H3K9ac）。红光照射后，角质形成细胞中沉默信息调节因子4（SIRT4）蛋白水平显著降低，同时糖酵解、脂肪酸代谢和三羧酸循环（TCA）在角质形成细胞中显著激活。线粒体SIRT4水平的降低增强了线粒体代谢蛋白的乙酰化，尤其是马洛尼酰-CoA脱羧酶，这是一种脂肪酸氧化关键限速酶肉毒碱棕榈酰转移酶1A（CPT1A）的强抑制剂。该过程促进了线粒体脂肪酸氧化和TCA循环。此外，SIRT4的减少通过反馈机制激活SIRT1，从而减轻其对衰老角质形成细胞中PPAR-α的抑制，全面激活与脂质代谢相关基因的表达。这种脂质代谢的激活最终促进了角质形成细胞内乙酰-CoA的积累，增加了H3K9ac水平，并重塑了与衰老相关的基因表达模式。
items.l1_lead: 定期红光照射通过降低SIRT4水平，激活脂肪酸代谢，增强H3K9ac，进而缓解小鼠衰老相关的生理表型。
items.l2_summary:
随着生物体的衰老，线粒体代谢活性逐渐下降，导致组蛋白乙酰化介导的基因表达调控失常，从而引发组织中衰老的生理表型。本研究探讨了定期暴露于红光对衰老小鼠的影响，发现红光显著提高了衰老小鼠组织和器官中组蛋白H3赖氨酸9的乙酰化水平（H3K9ac）。具体而言，红光照射后，角质形成细胞中沉默信息调节因子4（SIRT4）蛋白水平显著降低，同时糖酵解、脂肪酸代谢和三羧酸循环（TCA）在角质形成细胞中显著激活。

研究表明，线粒体SIRT4水平的降低增强了线粒体代谢蛋白的乙酰化，尤其是马洛尼酰-CoA脱羧酶，这是一种脂肪酸氧化的关键限速酶肉毒碱棕榈酰转移酶1A（CPT1A）的强抑制剂。通过这一机制，线粒体脂肪酸氧化和TCA循环得到了促进。此外，SIRT4的减少还通过反馈机制激活了SIRT1，从而减轻了其对衰老角质形成细胞中PPAR-α的抑制作用，全面激活了与脂质代谢相关基因的表达。

这种脂质代谢的激活最终导致角质形成细胞内乙酰-CoA的积累，进而增加了H3K9ac水平，并重塑了与衰老相关的基因表达模式。综上所述，本研究揭示了光调节SIRT4在缓解小鼠衰老过程中的重要作用，强调了脂肪酸代谢在调控组蛋白乙酰化及衰老相关基因表达中的关键性。

items.title: Heterogeneity and ontogeny of mouse thymic macrophages reveal a requirement for Csf1r -expressing myeloid cells during early T cell development
items.abstract: Thymic macrophages (TMs) maintain tissue homeostasis by clearing the large numbers of apoptotic cells generated during T cell development, but how TM heterogeneity relates to their developmental origin and role in thymocyte maturation remains incompletely understood. Using complementary flow-cytometric, single-cell transcriptomic, and genetic approaches, we resolved two major TM populations corresponding to TIMD4 + cortical and CX3CR1 + medullary/cortico-medullary macrophages. TIMD4 + VCAM1 + TMs displayed a prominent efferocytosis and apoptotic-cell-clearance program, whereas TIMD4 - VCAM1 + TMs were enriched for antigen-presentation and interferon-response pathways. Fate mapping revealed unequal progenitor contributions to these populations, and CCR2 deficiency selectively reduced TIMD4 - VCAM1 + TMs, and thymic monocytes, supporting ongoing input from circulating precursors. Exploratory pseudotime analysis further identified a transcriptional continuum from Ly6c2 + Ccr2 + monocytes toward macrophage states. Using MaFIA fetal thymic organ cultures, AP20187-mediated depletion of Csf1r- expressing myeloid cells reduced CD4 + CD8 + thymocyte differentiation and produced a coordinated accumulation of DN3 cells, loss of DN4 cells, and reduction in CD27 expression. These convergent changes identify the DN3-to-DN4 transition as a developmental stage that requires an intact Csf1r -expressing myeloid compartment and establish a functional connection between the thymic myeloid niche and early αβ T cell development. Together, our study refines the phenotypic and developmental organization of mouse TMs and reveals a previously underappreciated requirement for myeloid-cell support during progression through the β-selection checkpoint.
items.title_zh: 小鼠胸腺巨噬细胞的异质性与发育揭示Csf1r表达的髓系细胞在早期T细胞发育中的必要性
items.summary_zh: 胸腺巨噬细胞（TMs）通过清除在T细胞发育过程中产生的大量凋亡细胞来维持组织稳态，但TM的异质性与其发育来源及在胸腺细胞成熟中的作用尚不完全清楚。通过流式细胞术、单细胞转录组学和遗传学方法，我们识别出两种主要的TM群体，分别对应于TIMD4 +皮质和CX3CR1 +髓质/皮质-髓质巨噬细胞。TIMD4 + VCAM1 + TMs表现出显著的吞噬凋亡细胞能力，而TIMD4 - VCAM1 + TMs则富含抗原呈递和干扰素响应通路。命运追踪显示这些群体的祖细胞贡献不均，CCR2缺失选择性减少TIMD4 - VCAM1 + TMs和胸腺单核细胞，支持循环前体的持续输入。探索性伪时间分析进一步识别出从Ly6c2 + Ccr2 +单核细胞到巨噬细胞状态的转录连续体。使用MaFIA胎儿胸腺器官培养，AP20187介导的Csf1r表达的髓系细胞去除减少了CD4 + CD8 +胸腺细胞分化，并导致DN3细胞的协调积累、DN4细胞的丧失和CD27表达的减少。这些变化表明DN3到DN4的转变是一个需要完整Csf1r表达的发育阶段。
items.l1_lead: 研究发现，胸腺巨噬细胞的异质性与Csf1r表达密切相关，且其在早期T细胞发育中至关重要，影响了细胞分化和成熟过程。
items.l2_summary:
胸腺巨噬细胞（TMs）在T细胞发育过程中发挥着重要作用，主要通过清除大量凋亡细胞来维持组织稳态。然而，TMs的异质性及其发育来源在胸腺细胞成熟中的具体作用尚不明确。研究通过流式细胞术、单细胞转录组学和遗传学方法，识别出两种主要的TM群体：TIMD4 +皮质巨噬细胞和CX3CR1 +髓质/皮质-髓质巨噬细胞。结果显示，TIMD4 + VCAM1 + TMs在吞噬凋亡细胞方面表现出显著的能力，而TIMD4 - VCAM1 + TMs则富含与抗原呈递和干扰素响应相关的通路。命运追踪实验表明，这两种群体的祖细胞来源存在不均匀性，CCR2缺失选择性减少了TIMD4 - VCAM1 + TMs和胸腺单核细胞，支持了循环前体的持续输入。

进一步的探索性伪时间分析揭示了从Ly6c2 + Ccr2 +单核细胞向巨噬细胞状态的转录连续体。使用MaFIA胎儿胸腺器官培养实验，研究发现AP20187介导的Csf1r表达的髓系细胞去除后，CD4 + CD8 +胸腺细胞的分化显著减少，同时观察到DN3细胞的协调积累、DN4细胞的丧失以及CD27表达的减少。这些变化表明，DN3到DN4的转变是一个需要完整Csf1r表达的关键发育阶段。这项研究不仅揭示了小鼠胸腺巨噬细胞的异质性及其发育过程中的重要性，还强调了Csf1r表达的髓系细胞在早期T细胞发育中的必要性，为理解T细胞发育机制提供了新的视角。

items.title: Scanning and active sampling behaviours emerge from conserved insect neural circuits
items.abstract: Navigating insects often pause and rotate to sample their surroundings, behaviours termed scanning. These and other active sampling behaviours embody navigational uncertainty and are key for spatial learning, yet their neural basis remains unclear and existing models impose scanning behaviours rather than explaining its emergence. Here, we show that desert ants’ scanning dynamics can emerge spontaneously from the same conserved neural circuits used for goal-directed navigation, without requiring a specialised scanning module. We built a biologically grounded model combining central complex steering and lateral accessory lobe oscillators and added a downstream stochastic inhibition of forward speed. This minimal system produced diverse, realistic scan dynamics; saccades, fixations, and reversals, whose features were qualitatively compared to high-speed video recordings of Melophorus bagoti scanning. Detailed analysis of these natural scans confirmed model predictions, including how scan structure depends on oscillator phase, goal-heading deviation, and navigational uncertainty. Furthermore, the model reveals that simple modulation of forward speed unifies a broad range of behaviours across ant species, from dashes to smooth oscillatory trajectories to pirouettes and voltes. Crucially, this model suggests a distributed control principle where forward speed acts as a single adjustable parameter, for both individuals and through evolution, to regulate the balance between goal-driven exploitation and information-seeking exploration.

items.title: Cell-cycle-resolved Hi-C reveals unexpected plasticity of A/B compartments across interphase
items.abstract: The spatial organization of chromatin into active (A) and inactive (B) nuclear compartments is fundamental to genome regulation, yet their cell-cycle dynamics remain largely unexplored. Most research on chromatin dynamics during the cell cycle has primarily focused on events surrounding mitosis, providing only limited insight into chromatin behavior during S-phase. To address this gap, we developed a simple, drug-free approach that combines the Fucci cell-cycle indicator with in situ Hi-C to comprehensively analyze A/B compartment dynamics throughout interphase in mouse embryonic stem cells (mESCs). Unexpectedly, and contrary to prevailing views, we found that A/B compartment strength increased abruptly upon S-phase entry, stabilized during S-phase, and subsequently declined in late S/G2. This abrupt strengthening, which we termed ‘compartment maturation’, required passage through the G1/S transition but was independent of active DNA synthesis. This maturation involved substantial architectural remodeling, particularly within the A compartment, which consolidated into a more organized structure as individual A domains rearranged to form long-range interactions. Moreover, compartment maturation was not limited to mESCs but was also evident across different developmental contexts in mice. Based on these observations, we propose a revised, stepwise model of nuclear compartmentalization during cell-cycle progression, consisting of four distinct stages: chromosome unfolding (G1), chromatin maturation (G1/S), stabilization (S phase), and refolding (G2). These findings reveal the unexpected plasticity of A/B compartments and underscore the G1/S transition as a critical period for their reorganization.
items.title_zh: 细胞周期解析的Hi-C揭示A/B区室在间期的意外可塑性
items.summary_zh: 染色质在活跃（A）和非活跃（B）核区室中的空间组织对基因组调控至关重要，但其细胞周期动态尚未得到充分研究。大多数关于细胞周期中染色质动态的研究主要集中在有丝分裂周围事件，限制了对S期染色质行为的理解。为填补这一空白，我们开发了一种简单的无药物方法，将Fucci细胞周期指示剂与原位Hi-C结合，全面分析小鼠胚胎干细胞（mESCs）在间期的A/B区室动态。意外地，与普遍观点相反，我们发现A/B区室强度在进入S期时突然增加，在S期期间稳定，随后在晚期S/G2下降。这种突发的增强被称为“区室成熟”，需要通过G1/S过渡，但与活跃的DNA合成无关。成熟过程涉及显著的结构重塑，尤其是在A区室内，个别A域重新排列形成长程相互作用。此外，区室成熟不仅限于mESCs，在小鼠的不同发育背景中也有所体现。基于这些观察，我们提出了一个修订的核区室分层模型。
items.l1_lead: 研究发现小鼠胚胎干细胞在间期的A/B区室动态具有意外可塑性，A区室在S期前突然增强并稳定，随后在晚期S/G2下降，揭示了染色质组织的新机制。
items.l2_summary:
染色质在活跃（A）和非活跃（B）核区室中的空间组织对基因组调控至关重要，但其在细胞周期中的动态变化尚未得到充分研究。以往的研究主要集中在有丝分裂周围的事件，限制了对S期染色质行为的理解。为此，研究团队开发了一种无药物的方法，将Fucci细胞周期指示剂与原位Hi-C技术结合，全面分析了小鼠胚胎干细胞（mESCs）在间期的A/B区室动态。研究结果意外地发现，与普遍观点相反，A/B区室的强度在进入S期时突然增加，并在S期期间保持稳定，随后在晚期S/G2阶段下降。这一现象被称为“区室成熟”，其发生需要通过G1/S过渡，但与活跃的DNA合成并无直接关联。

成熟过程涉及显著的结构重塑，尤其是在A区室内，个别A域重新排列形成长程相互作用。这一发现表明，染色质的空间组织在细胞周期的不同阶段具有意外的可塑性，挑战了传统的理解。此外，区室成熟的现象不仅限于mESCs，还在小鼠的不同发育背景中得到了体现。基于这些观察，研究团队提出了一个修订的核区室分层模型，以更好地解释染色质在细胞周期中的动态变化。这项研究为理解细胞周期中染色质的行为提供了新的视角，强调了A/B区室在基因组调控中的重要性及其动态特性。

items.title: NK2R signaling governs intestinal lipid mobilization and mucosal inflammation
items.abstract: Neuropeptidergic control of lipid metabolism is conserved and increasingly implicated in metabolic diseases, but receptor-level mechanisms remain unclear. Here, we identify the neurokinin-2 receptor (NK2R) as a central node linking tachykinin signals to intestinal lipid mobilization, epithelial composition, and mucosal inflammation. Across complementary genetic and pharmacological perturbations, modulation of NK2R drives bidirectional effects. Loss or blockade of NK2R increases postprandial triglyceridemia and expands intestinal lipid stores, whereas agonism suppresses chylomicron output, reduces adiposity, and improves glycemia in diet-induced obesity. Transcriptomic and cellular analyses indicate coordinated upregulation of lipid-metabolic programs with a concomitant dampening of immune pathways in the absence of NK2R, accompanied by sex-specific remodeling of secretory lineages and male-biased protection from colitis. NK2R signaling also shaped the fecal microbiota in a genotype- and diet-dependent manner, highlighting crosstalk among neuropeptide signaling, epithelial physiology, and host-microbe interactions. These findings position NK2R as a molecular switch for intestinal lipid handling and mucosal inflammation and suggest that NK2R-targeted agonists or antagonists could be deployed as context- and sex-dependent therapeutic strategies for metabolic disease and inflammatory bowel disease.
items.title_zh: NK2R信号调控肠道脂质动员与黏膜炎症
items.summary_zh: 神经肽对脂质代谢的调控在代谢疾病中越来越受到关注，但受体层面的机制尚不明确。本研究确定了神经激肽-2受体（NK2R）作为连接神经激肽信号与肠道脂质动员、上皮组成和黏膜炎症的核心节点。通过遗传和药理学干扰的互补研究，NK2R的调节表现出双向效应。NK2R的缺失或阻断会增加餐后甘油三酯水平并扩展肠道脂质储存，而激动剂则抑制乳糜微粒输出、减少脂肪量并改善饮食诱导的肥胖中的血糖水平。转录组和细胞分析表明，缺乏NK2R时脂质代谢程序协调上调，同时免疫通路减弱，伴随性别特异性的分泌谱重塑和男性对结肠炎的保护。NK2R信号还以基因型和饮食依赖的方式影响粪便微生物群，突显神经肽信号、上皮生理和宿主-微生物相互作用之间的交叉对话。这些发现将NK2R定位为肠道脂质处理和黏膜炎症的分子开关，并建议NK2R靶向的激动剂或拮抗剂可作为代谢疾病和炎症的治疗策略。
items.l1_lead: 本研究揭示神经激肽-2受体（NK2R）在肠道脂质动员和黏膜炎症中的关键作用，表明其作为代谢疾病和炎症治疗的新靶点。
items.l2_summary:
本研究聚焦于神经肽信号在肠道脂质动员与黏膜炎症中的调控作用，特别是神经激肽-2受体（NK2R）的功能。研究表明，NK2R作为连接神经激肽信号与肠道脂质代谢的核心节点，其调节作用呈现出双向效应。通过遗传和药理学干扰的互补研究，发现NK2R的缺失或阻断会导致餐后甘油三酯水平增加，并扩展肠道脂质储存，而激动NK2R则能够抑制乳糜微粒的输出，减少脂肪量，并改善饮食诱导的肥胖中的血糖水平。

转录组和细胞分析结果显示，缺乏NK2R时，脂质代谢程序的协调上调，同时免疫通路的活性减弱。此外，研究还发现NK2R的缺失伴随着性别特异性的分泌谱重塑，男性在结肠炎中表现出一定的保护作用。这一现象提示NK2R信号在性别差异中的重要性。

更为重要的是，NK2R信号还以基因型和饮食依赖的方式影响肠道微生物群的组成，突显了神经肽信号、上皮生理和宿主-微生物相互作用之间的复杂交互关系。这些发现将NK2R定位为肠道脂质处理和黏膜炎症的分子开关，提示NK2R的激动剂或拮抗剂可能成为治疗代谢疾病和炎症的新策略。整体而言，本研究为理解神经肽在代谢调控中的作用提供了新的视角，并为未来的治疗方法奠定了基础。

items.title: A high-throughput assay for the measurement of Ca 2+ oscillations and insulin release from uniformly sized mouse β-cell (MIN6 ) spheroids
items.abstract: Diabetes mellitus is a rapidly growing global health challenge, necessitating the development of more effective anti-diabetic therapies, including drugs that improve insulin release from pancreatic β-cells. Traditional high-throughput screening methods typically rely on 2D β-cell cultures, but such cultures do not mimic the 3D organization and cell-to-cell communication of β-cells in pancreatic islets of Langerhans. Existing 3D β-cell culture models are hindered by high costs, technical complexity, and limited compatibility with high-throughput screening platforms. In this work, we developed an approach for generating 19 homogeneously shaped pancreatic β-cell spheroids in each well of a 96-well plate, using micropatterned polyethylene glycol (PEG)-based hydrogels and murine mouse insulinoma 6 (MIN6) insulinoma cells. The uniform shape and positioning of the individual spheroids enabled the simultaneous, real-time imaging of Ca 2+ signals in up to 1824 independent spheroids in response to glucose and various test compounds. Using this approach, we show that increasing glucose causes concentration-dependent Ca 2+ oscillations in individual spheroids, that these Ca 2+ oscillations are sensitive to modulators of ATP-sensitive K + channels, and that the frequency of Ca 2+ oscillations correlates with insulin secretion. Finally, we demonstrate that the neurosteroid pregnenolone sulfate, an agonist of the cation channel TRPM3, increases the frequency of glucose-induced Ca 2+ oscillations and enhances insulin release; the TRPM3 antagonist isosakuranetin inhibited these responses. In conclusion, we established a cost-effective and scalable 3D β-cell platform for high-throughput screening of insulin release-modifying compounds, with potential applications in drug development and personalized medicine for the management of diabetes mellitus.
items.title_zh: 高通量测定小鼠β细胞球体Ca 2+波动与胰岛素释放的方法
items.summary_zh: 糖尿病是全球日益严重的健康挑战，需要开发更有效的抗糖尿病疗法，包括改善胰腺β细胞胰岛素释放的药物。传统的高通量筛选方法通常依赖于2D β细胞培养，但这种培养无法模拟胰岛素腺Langerhans岛中β细胞的3D组织和细胞间通信。现有的3D β细胞培养模型受限于高成本、技术复杂性和与高通量筛选平台的兼容性。在本研究中，我们开发了一种方法，在96孔板的每个孔中生成19个均匀形状的胰腺β细胞球体，使用微图案化的聚乙烯醇（PEG）基水凝胶和小鼠胰岛素瘤6（MIN6）细胞。个体球体的均匀形状和定位使得能够同时实时成像多达1824个独立球体的Ca 2+信号。结果表明，增加葡萄糖浓度会导致个体球体中Ca 2+波动的浓度依赖性变化，这些波动对ATP敏感的K +通道调节剂敏感，且Ca 2+波动频率与胰岛素分泌相关。
items.l1_lead: 本研究开发了一种新方法，通过在96孔板中生成均匀的β细胞球体，实现对Ca 2+波动与胰岛素释放的高通量实时成像，揭示了葡萄糖浓度对Ca 2+波动的影响。
items.l2_summary:
糖尿病已成为全球日益严重的健康挑战，因此亟需开发更有效的抗糖尿病疗法，尤其是改善胰腺β细胞胰岛素释放的药物。传统的高通量筛选方法通常依赖于二维（2D）β细胞培养，但这种方法无法真实模拟胰岛素腺Langerhans岛中β细胞的三维（3D）组织结构及其细胞间的通信。现有的3D β细胞培养模型在高通量筛选平台上的应用受到高成本、技术复杂性等因素的限制。为了解决这一问题，本研究开发了一种新方法，在96孔板的每个孔中生成19个均匀形状的胰腺β细胞球体，采用微图案化的聚乙烯醇（PEG）基水凝胶和小鼠胰岛素瘤6（MIN6）细胞。通过这种方法，研究人员能够同时实时成像多达1824个独立球体的钙离子（Ca 2+）信号。

研究结果显示，随着葡萄糖浓度的增加，个体球体中Ca 2+波动的浓度依赖性变化显著。这些Ca 2+波动对ATP敏感的K+通道调节剂表现出敏感性，表明其在胰岛素分泌中的重要作用。此外，Ca 2+波动的频率与胰岛素的分泌密切相关。这些发现为理解胰腺β细胞在不同葡萄糖浓度下的功能提供了新的视角，并为未来开发针对糖尿病的治疗策略奠定了基础。通过这种新型的高通量筛选方法，研究人员能够更有效地评估药物对胰岛素释放的影响，推动抗糖尿病药物的研发进程。

items.title: Human CD1c-autoreactive T-cells recognise Mycobacterium tuberculosis -infected antigen-presenting cells and display cytotoxic effector programmes
items.abstract: Tuberculosis (TB), caused by Mycobacterium tuberculosis (Mtb), remains the leading cause of death from infection globally yet the contribution of non-classical T-cell pathways to human immunity remains poorly defined. CD1c-autoreactive T-cells, which recognise self-lipids presented by the antigen-presenting molecule CD1c, are frequent in human blood but their role during infection remains unclear. Here, we investigate how CD1c-expressing antigen-presenting cells (APCs) and Mtb infection shape CD1c-autoreactive T-cell responses using engineered human APC systems, complemented by single-cell transcriptomic profiling to define the ex vivo phenotypic landscape of these T-cells. CD1c is present within human TB granulomas, whereas Mtb down-modulates CD1c expression on infected APCs, consistent with an immune evasion strategy. CD1c-autoreactive T-cells respond more strongly to Mtb-infected CD1c + APCs than to uninfected cells, exhibiting enhanced activation, cytotoxicity, and diverse cytokine secretion via CD1c-dependent recognition. Under in vitro conditions, these T-cells reduce relative Mtb burden in infected phagocytes. Single-cell RNA sequencing reveals cytotoxic effector-memory programmes and expression of antimicrobial molecules, providing a mechanistic basis for these responses. Together, these findings define a human CD1c-restricted T-cell response to Mtb-infected APCs and identify autoreactive CD1c-restricted T-cells as a candidate cellular axis for lipid-directed immunity in TB.
items.title_zh: 人CD1c自反应T细胞识别结核分枝杆菌感染的抗原呈递细胞
items.summary_zh: 结核病（TB）由结核分枝杆菌（Mtb）引起，仍是全球感染性死亡的主要原因，但非经典T细胞通路对人类免疫的贡献尚不明确。CD1c自反应T细胞识别由抗原呈递分子CD1c呈递的自脂质，在人类血液中频繁存在，但其在感染中的作用不清楚。本研究利用工程化人类抗原呈递细胞（APC）系统，结合单细胞转录组分析，探讨CD1c表达的APC和Mtb感染如何影响CD1c自反应T细胞的反应。结果显示，CD1c在结核病肉芽肿中存在，而Mtb降低感染APC上的CD1c表达，符合免疫逃逸策略。CD1c自反应T细胞对Mtb感染的CD1c+ APC反应更强，表现出增强的激活、细胞毒性和多样的细胞因子分泌。在体外条件下，这些T细胞减少感染吞噬细胞中的相对Mtb负担。单细胞RNA测序揭示了细胞毒性效应记忆程序和抗微生物分子的表达，为这些反应提供了机制基础。这些发现定义了人类CD1c限制的T细胞对Mtb感染APC的反应。
items.l1_lead: 本研究揭示了人类CD1c自反应T细胞在结核分枝杆菌感染中通过识别CD1c抗原呈递细胞发挥增强的免疫反应，揭示了其在免疫逃逸中的重要作用。
items.l2_summary:
结核病（TB）是由结核分枝杆菌（Mtb）引起的全球主要感染性死亡原因之一，但非经典T细胞通路在人体免疫中的作用尚不明确。本研究聚焦于CD1c自反应T细胞，探讨其如何识别由抗原呈递分子CD1c呈递的自脂质，并分析其在Mtb感染中的作用。研究利用工程化的人类抗原呈递细胞（APC）系统，结合单细胞转录组分析，揭示了CD1c表达的APC与Mtb感染对CD1c自反应T细胞反应的影响。

研究结果表明，CD1c在结核病肉芽肿中存在，而Mtb感染会降低APC上CD1c的表达，这一现象符合Mtb的免疫逃逸策略。CD1c自反应T细胞对Mtb感染的CD1c+ APC表现出更强的反应，具体表现为增强的激活、细胞毒性以及多样的细胞因子分泌。在体外实验中，这些T细胞能够显著减少感染吞噬细胞中的Mtb负担，显示出其在抗击感染中的潜在作用。

通过单细胞RNA测序，研究揭示了这些T细胞的细胞毒性效应记忆程序及抗微生物分子的表达，为其反应机制提供了基础。这些发现明确了人类CD1c限制的T细胞在应对Mtb感染的APC中的重要作用，进一步阐明了非经典T细胞通路在结核病免疫反应中的贡献，为未来的免疫治疗策略提供了新的思路。

items.title: Mapping human visual contrast sensitivity and vision loss across the visual field with model-based fMRI
items.abstract: Peripheral vision is crucial for daily activities and quality of life, yet traditional measures of visual function like visual acuity primarily assess central vision. Visual field tests can evaluate peripheral vision but require extended focus and precise fixation, often challenging for patients with severe sight loss. Functional MRI (fMRI) with population receptive field (pRF) mapping offers a non-invasive way to map scotomas but relies on single contrast levels and accurate fixation. We developed an fMRI-based approach to measure contrast sensitivity across the visual field without requiring precise fixation. Combining large-field stimulation with varying spatial frequencies and contrast levels, and either pRF mapping or a structure-based retinotopic atlas, we modeled contrast sensitivity in the primary visual cortex (V1) over a large (40 deg) expanse of the visual field. In seven normally sighted participants, we characterized differences in V1 sensitivity across eccentricities and visual quadrants, finding reliable and reproducible patterns at individual and session levels. To test robustness to fixation variability, we investigated how varying levels of eye movement affected V1 sensitivity patterns in two participants: cortical sensitivity patterns were largely preserved despite eye movements, particularly at low spatial frequencies. This suggests our approach can accommodate several degrees of fixation instability, making it suitable for populations with unstable or biased fixation for whom visual field maps are harder to acquire behaviorally (e.g., patients with dense central scotoma or strabismus). Additionally, our method effectively visualized simulated and disease-linked sensitivity loss at the cortical level. Crucially, these results could be largely recovered using the structure-based retinotopic atlas, eliminating the need for pRF mapping and precise fixation, although with reduced sensitivity. This approach, integrating large-field stimulation with a retinotopic atlas, offers a promising tool for monitoring vision loss and recovery across a range of visual impairments, addressing a significant challenge in current clinical assessments.

items.title: Distinct allosteric remodeling of HIV-1 Env dynamics on virions by gp41-directed antibodies reveals two modes of neutralization
items.abstract: HIV-1 envelope glycoprotein (Env), a gp120–gp41 trimer, undergoes coordinated conformational changes that drive membrane fusion and allow immune evasion by transiently concealing neutralization-sensitive epitopes. Most broadly neutralizing antibodies (bNAbs) target gp120, whereas a distinct subset recognizes conserved gp41 regions, such as the fusion peptide and the membrane-proximal external region; however, their impact on Env dynamics and associated neutralization mechanisms remains unclear. By using bioorthogonal tagging for single-molecule FRET, we monitored real-time bNAb-induced conformational sampling of Env on intact virions. Most gp41-directed bNAbs allosterically stabilized the prefusion-closed (PC) state, whereas the bivalent 10E8.4/iMab favored both PC and CD4-bound open (predominant) states. Antibodies redistributed the conformational populations of Env with modest kinetic effects, preserving a sequential transition pathway. These findings reveal two modes of neutralization for gp41-directed antibodies, fixing the PC conformation and opening it up – in both cases, with neutralization occurring via long-range allosteric control of Env dynamics.

items.title: The type VI secretion system governs strain maintenance in a wild mammalian gut microbiome
items.abstract: Bacteria inhabiting the mammalian gut coexist in dense communities where contact-dependent antagonism mechanisms are widespread. The type VI secretion system (T6SS) is an interbacterial toxin delivery pathway prevalent among gut Bacteroidales, yet its function in naturally evolved microbiomes remains poorly defined. Here, we examine the role of the T6SS in Bacteroides within a physiologically relevant gut community derived from wild mice (the WildR microbiome). Using newly developed genetic tools and a strategy for functional replacement of strains within the WildR community, we demonstrate that the WildR isolate B. acidifaciens employs a T6SS to antagonize co-resident Bacteroidales. We also show that loss of T6SS function compromises the long-term maintenance of B. acidifaciens in the community but not its initial colonization, establishing the system as a determinant of strain persistence. The T6SS we identified resides on an integrative and conjugative element (ICE). ICE-seq, a targeted sequencing approach, reveals that the T6SS-ICE is distributed among select Bacteroidales and Muribaculaceae species in the WildR microbiome, between which it appears to be recently exchanged. We also show that transfer of the T6SS-ICE to WildR isolate Phocaeicola vulgatus confers transient colonization benefits in mice, but is linked to eventual population decline. Our findings demonstrate that the T6SS can stabilize the presence of specific strains within a complex, co-evolved gut microbiome, yet its value is context dependent and constrained by the ecological and physiological landscape of the host community.
items.title_zh: VI型分泌系统在野生哺乳动物肠道微生物群中的作用
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了VI型分泌系统（T6SS）在来自野生小鼠的肠道微生物群（WildR微生物群）中Bacteroides的作用。我们利用新开发的遗传工具和功能替代策略，证明WildR分离株B. acidifaciens通过T6SS对共生的Bacteroidales进行拮抗。结果显示，T6SS功能的丧失会影响B. acidifaciens在微生物群中的长期维持，但不影响其初始定殖，确立了该系统作为菌株持久性的决定因素。我们发现的T6SS位于一个整合与接合元件（ICE）上，ICE-seq分析表明T6SS-ICE在WildR微生物群中的特定Bacteroidales和Muribaculaceae物种间分布，并且似乎最近发生了交换。此外，将T6SS-ICE转移至WildR分离株Phocaeicola vulgatus可在小鼠中带来短暂的定殖优势，但最终与种群下降相关。我们的研究结果表明T6SS在肠道微生物群中对菌株的维持具有重要作用。
items.l1_lead: VI型分泌系统在野生哺乳动物肠道微生物群中对Bacteroides的拮抗作用是维持菌株长期存在的关键因素。
items.l2_summary:
本研究探讨了VI型分泌系统（T6SS）在野生小鼠肠道微生物群（WildR微生物群）中Bacteroides属的作用。研究表明，WildR分离株B. acidifaciens通过T6SS对共生的Bacteroidales进行拮抗，显示出T6SS在微生物群中的重要性。通过新开发的遗传工具和功能替代策略，研究团队发现T6SS功能的丧失会显著影响B. acidifaciens在微生物群中的长期维持，但并不影响其初始定殖，这一发现确立了T6SS作为菌株持久性的关键决定因素。

进一步的分析显示，T6SS位于一个整合与接合元件（ICE）上，ICE-seq分析揭示T6SS-ICE在WildR微生物群中特定Bacteroidales和Muribaculaceae物种间的分布，并且似乎最近发生了基因交换。此外，将T6SS-ICE转移至WildR分离株Phocaeicola vulgatus后，虽然在小鼠中带来了短暂的定殖优势，但最终与种群的下降相关。这一结果表明，尽管T6SS能够在短期内增强某些菌株的竞争力，但其长期维持却可能受到限制。

综上所述，研究结果强调了T6SS在肠道微生物群中对菌株维持的重要作用，揭示了其在微生物群落动态中的复杂性和潜在影响。这些发现为理解肠道微生物群的生态平衡及其与宿主健康的关系提供了新的视角。

items.title: Sex-biased expression of enteroendocrine cell-derived hormones contributes to higher fat storage in Drosophila females
items.abstract: Enteroendocrine (EE) cells in the Drosophila gut produce and release multiple factors, including Allatostatin A (AstA), Allatostatin C (AstC), neuropeptide F (NPF), tachykinin (Tk), Diuretic hormone 31 (Dh31), Bursicon, CCHamide 1, CCHamide 2, and short neuropeptide F. Collectively, these peptides ensure that physiology (e.g., fat storage, fluid balance) and behavior (e.g., feeding, sleep) are coordinated with environmental factors such as nutrient quantity and quality. Despite notable sex differences in physiology and behavior, it remains unclear whether the regulation and function of these EE cell-derived factors are shared between males and females. Given that recent data identified sex-biased physiological effects of two EE cell-derived hormones on Drosophila food intake and energy mobilization, we performed a detailed characterization of these hormones in male and female flies. Despite an overall male bias in mRNA levels of AstA , AstC , Tk , NPF , and Dh31 in whole-body and head samples, we observed a strong female bias in mRNA levels of AstC , Tk , and NPF in the gut. To determine whether this sex-biased regulation was physiologically significant, we monitored triglyceride levels in flies with gut-specific knock-down of EE cell-derived hormones. In 5-day-old flies, knock-down of EE cell-derived AstC significantly reduced fat storage in females with no effect in males, whereas knock-down of EE cell-derived Tk produced a non-significant trend toward reduced fat storage in females. These female-specific effects on fat storage were reproduced in flies with neuron-specific knock-down of the AstC ( AstC-R2 ) and Tk receptors ( TkR99D ). Together, these data uncover strongly sex-biased regulation of EE cell-derived hormones and show that gut-specific knock-down of at least one of these hormones had a female-specific effect on body fat.
items.title_zh: 性别偏向的肠内分泌细胞激素表达影响果蝇雌性脂肪储存
items.summary_zh: 果蝇肠道中的肠内分泌（EE）细胞产生多种激素，包括Allatostatin A (AstA)、Allatostatin C (AstC)、神经肽F (NPF)、速激肽 (Tk)、利尿激素31 (Dh31)等。这些肽类确保生理（如脂肪储存、液体平衡）和行为（如进食、睡眠）与环境因素（如营养量和质量）协调。尽管生理和行为存在显著性别差异，但EE细胞衍生因子的调控和功能是否在雌雄之间共享尚不清楚。研究发现，AstC、Tk和NPF在雌性果蝇肠道中的mRNA水平表现出强烈的雌性偏向。通过监测肠道特异性敲低EE细胞衍生激素的果蝇三酸甘油脂水平，结果显示，5天大的雌性果蝇中AstC的敲低显著减少了脂肪储存，而对雄性无显著影响。
items.l1_lead: 研究表明，果蝇雌性肠内分泌细胞激素的表达偏向影响其脂肪储存，特别是敲低AstC显著减少雌性果蝇的脂肪储存。
items.l2_summary:
研究探讨了果蝇肠道中的肠内分泌（EE）细胞所产生的激素对雌性果蝇脂肪储存的影响。果蝇的EE细胞能够分泌多种激素，包括Allatostatin A (AstA)、Allatostatin C (AstC)、神经肽F (NPF)、速激肽 (Tk) 和利尿激素31 (Dh31)，这些激素在调节生理（如脂肪储存和液体平衡）和行为（如进食和睡眠）方面起着重要作用，并与环境因素（如营养的数量和质量）相互协调。尽管已知生理和行为在性别上存在显著差异，但EE细胞衍生因子的调控和功能在雌雄之间是否存在共享尚不明确。

研究结果显示，AstC、Tk和NPF在雌性果蝇肠道中的mRNA水平表现出明显的雌性偏向。通过对肠道特异性敲低EE细胞衍生激素的果蝇进行三酸甘油脂水平的监测，发现5天大的雌性果蝇中AstC的敲低显著减少了脂肪储存，而对雄性果蝇则没有显著影响。这一发现表明，肠内分泌细胞激素的性别偏向表达可能在雌性果蝇的脂肪储存中发挥了关键作用，进一步揭示了性别在果蝇生理调节中的重要性。研究结果为理解性别差异在能量代谢和脂肪储存中的作用提供了新的视角，可能对相关领域的研究具有重要的启示意义。

items.title: A cortical–hippocampal communication undergoes rebalancing after new learning
items.abstract: The brain’s ability to consolidate a wide range of memories while maintaining their distinctiveness across experiences remains poorly understood. Sharp-wave ripples, neural oscillations that occur predominantly within CA1 of the hippocampus during immobility and sleep, have been shown to play a critical role in the consolidation process. More recently, evidence has uncovered functional heterogeneity of pyramidal neurons within distinct sublayers of CA1 that display unique properties during ripples, potentially contributing to memory specificity. Despite this, it remains unclear exactly how ripples shift the activity of CA1 neuronal populations to accommodate the consolidation of specific memories and how sublayer differences manifest. Here, we studied interactions between the anterior cingulate cortex (ACC) and CA1 neurons during ripples and discovered a reorganization of their communication following learning. Specifically, using a generalized linear model decoder, we demonstrated the pre-existence of ACC-to-CA1 communication, which is weakened during post-training sleep following learning, suggesting that ACC activity reallocates the contribution of CA1 neurons during memory formation. Interestingly, the reorganization appeared unique for a subset of CA1 superficial (CA1sup) neurons that were task inactive, whereas communication between the ACC and CA1deep neurons remained largely stable across pre- and post-training sleep. Consistent with this sublayer-selective reorganization, we found that optogenetic stimulations of the ACC preferentially suppressed CA1sup neurons while activating a unique subset of CA1 interneurons. Overall, these findings highlight an important role of the ACC in rebalancing CA1 neuronal populations’ contribution in learning and memory consolidation.
items.title_zh: 新学习后皮层-海马沟通的重组
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了前扣带皮层（ACC）与海马CA1区神经元在波动期间的相互作用，发现学习后其沟通方式发生重组。通过使用广义线性模型解码器，我们证明了ACC与CA1之间的沟通在学习后训练睡眠期间减弱，表明ACC活动在记忆形成过程中重新分配了CA1神经元的贡献。特别地，这种重组在一部分任务不活跃的CA1浅层（CA1sup）神经元中表现出独特性，而ACC与CA1深层神经元之间的沟通保持不变。这些发现有助于理解海马在记忆巩固中的功能异质性及其在新学习后的适应机制。
items.l1_lead: 本研究发现，学习后前扣带皮层与海马CA1区的沟通方式重组，ACC活动在记忆形成中重新分配CA1神经元的贡献，揭示了海马在记忆巩固中的功能异质性。
items.l2_summary: 本研究探讨了前扣带皮层（ACC）与海马CA1区神经元在波动期间的相互作用，重点关注学习后其沟通方式的重组。研究发现，在学习后训练睡眠期间，ACC与CA1之间的沟通显著减弱，这一现象表明ACC活动在记忆形成过程中重新分配了CA1神经元的贡献。具体而言，这种重组主要体现在一部分任务不活跃的CA1浅层（CA1sup）神经元中，而ACC与CA1深层神经元之间的沟通则保持不变。这一发现揭示了海马在记忆巩固过程中的功能异质性，表明不同层次的神经元在学习后的适应机制中扮演着不同的角色。通过使用广义线性模型解码器，研究提供了有力的证据，支持了ACC与CA1之间的相互作用在学习后经历了重要的重组过程。这些结果为理解海马在记忆巩固中的复杂功能提供了新的视角，强调了ACC在记忆形成和巩固过程中的关键作用。

items.title: Negative affect influences the computations underlying food choice in bulimia nervosa
items.abstract: Individuals often consume tasty, calorically dense foods in response to negative emotions, a phenomenon exemplified by notions of ‘stress eating’ and ‘comfort food’. While this link between food and mood can become pathological in binge eating, the decision-making processes underlying this link are poorly understood. Here, we investigated the impact of acute increases in negative affect on when and how strongly the perceived tastiness and healthiness of foods influence food choices in healthy adults and individuals with bulimia nervosa (BN), an eating disorder characterized by cycles of over- and under-consumption of food. In a randomized crossover design, 25 women with BN and 21 healthy controls completed two sessions where they received either a neutral or negative affect induction and then completed a food choice task. Using a time-varying diffusion decision model, we assessed how negative affect influences food choice dynamics for high- and low-fat foods. In the neutral affect condition, individuals with BN considered tastiness relative to healthiness of high-fat foods sooner than healthy controls but maintained a restrictive food choice policy by reducing the weight on tastiness. After a negative affect induction, both groups showed a stronger bias toward considering tastiness before healthiness, but this bias was exaggerated in individuals with BN. This affect-induced bias for high-fat foods predicted more frequent subjective binge episodes over 3 months. These results provide insights into how negative emotion influences food choices and may explain why binge eating in BN is more likely during high negative affect, while dietary restriction is more likely during low negative affect.

items.title: Genome-wide discovery of cis- regulatory elements in a large genome
items.abstract: Identifying cis- regulatory elements typically relies on trial and error to test the activity of DNA fragments using reporter constructs. This approach is particularly challenging in large eukaryotic genomes, where cis- regulatory elements can be dispersed over long distances, separated by large stretches of non-functional DNA. Here, we generate two types of resources that can be used to narrow the search for such elements in the 3.6 Gbp genome of Parhyale hawaiensis . First, we use bulk ATAC-seq to uncover genome-wide patterns of chromatin accessibility in Parhyale embryonic and adult tissues, and single-nucleus ATAC-seq to identify regions of open chromatin in diverse cell types. Second, by sequencing the genomes of three congeneric species – P. darvishi , P. aquilina , and P. plumicornis – we identify islands of sequence conservation across the genome, likely corresponding to functionally constrained DNA. We find that low-coverage (10–15×) short-read genome sequencing, without genome assembly, is sufficient to provide reliable maps of sequence conservation. This approach cuts the cost and labour required to generate these maps, making the identification of cis- regulatory elements more widely accessible. We demonstrate the utility of these resources by identifying cis- regulatory elements that drive robust expression of fluorescent reporters ubiquitously and in specific cell types.
items.title_zh: 大基因组中顺式调控元件的全基因组发现
items.summary_zh: 本研究旨在识别大真核生物基因组中的顺式调控元件，特别是在Parhyale hawaiensis的3.6 Gbp基因组中。我们首先利用大规模ATAC-seq技术揭示了Parhyale胚胎和成体组织的全基因组染色质可及性模式，并通过单核ATAC-seq识别了多种细胞类型中的开放染色质区域。其次，通过对三种同属物种（P. darvishi、P. aquilina和P. plumicornis）基因组的测序，我们识别出基因组中的序列保守岛，可能对应于功能受限的DNA。研究发现，低覆盖率（10-15×）的短读长基因组测序无需组装即可提供可靠的序列保守图谱。这一方法降低了生成这些图谱的成本和劳动强度，使得顺式调控元件的识别更加广泛可及。我们通过识别驱动荧光报告基因在特定细胞和全局表达的顺式调控元件，展示了这些资源的实用性。
items.l1_lead: 本研究通过大规模ATAC-seq技术识别了大真核生物基因组中的顺式调控元件，揭示了低覆盖率基因组测序在序列保守图谱生成中的有效性。
items.l2_summary:
本研究聚焦于识别大真核生物基因组中的顺式调控元件，特别是在Parhyale hawaiensis（夏威夷海洋小虾）的3.6 Gbp基因组中进行探索。研究首先采用大规模ATAC-seq（转录组开放染色质测序）技术，揭示了Parhyale胚胎和成体组织的全基因组染色质可及性模式，并通过单核ATAC-seq识别了多种细胞类型中的开放染色质区域。这一过程为理解基因组调控提供了重要的基础数据。

进一步地，研究团队对三种同属物种（P. darvishi、P. aquilina和P. plumicornis）的基因组进行了测序，识别出基因组中的序列保守岛，这些区域可能对应于功能受限的DNA。研究表明，低覆盖率（10-15×）的短读长基因组测序在无需组装的情况下，依然能够提供可靠的序列保守图谱。这一创新方法显著降低了生成这些图谱的成本和劳动强度，从而使得顺式调控元件的识别变得更加广泛可及。

最后，研究通过识别驱动荧光报告基因在特定细胞和全局表达的顺式调控元件，展示了这些资源的实用性。这些发现不仅为大真核生物基因组的功能研究提供了新的视角，也为未来的基因组学研究奠定了基础，推动了对基因调控机制的深入理解。

items.title: Bidirectional redistribution of actomyosin drives epithelial invagination in ascidian siphon tube morphogenesis
items.abstract: How epithelia perform a spatiotemporal heterogeneous force-generating program to drive a sequential tissue morphogenesis remains unclear, particularly the underlying precise mechanical mechanisms. This study investigated dynamic actomyosin reorganization between apical and lateral membrane cortex regions during two sequentially invaginated stages of atrial siphon tube morphogenesis in the ascidian Ciona . At the initial invagination stage, the originally lateral-located actomyosin redistributed to the apical domains, while that actomyosin redistributed back to lateral domains at the accelerated invagination stage. Using genetic mutants to modulate myosin activities, the initial invagination was strengthened or abolished, indicating invagination is apical constriction-dependent. Optogenetic inhibition of myosin activities in lateral domains after initial invagination stage blocked the further processes, suggesting lateral constriction of actomyosin is required for the accelerated invagination. Vertex model simulations uncovered a coupled mechanism underlying epithelial invagination driven by apicobasal tension imbalance and lateral contraction. We thus propose an actomyosin redistribution mechanical model: lateral actomyosin first redistributes apically to drive apical constriction and shape the initial invagination, then apical actomyosin redistributes laterally to promote lateral contractility and accelerate invagination. Our findings reveal a bidirectional reorganization of the actomyosin network as a central mechanism driving epithelial invagination, providing insights on epithelial invagination and organ morphogenesis during development.

items.title: Zinc is a key regulator of the sperm-specific K + channel (Slo3) function
items.abstract: The voltage- and pH-gated Slo3 potassium channel is exclusively expressed in mammalian spermatozoa. Its sensitivity to both voltage and alkalization plays a crucial role in sperm fertility, which is tightly coupled to the capacitation process. Here, we show that sperm-enriched divalent cation Zn 2+ undergoes dynamic alteration in spermatozoa during capacitation. We also found that intracellular Zn 2+ regulates alkalinization-induced hyperpolarization in mouse spermatozoa, which is mediated by the Slo3 channel. Further examination of zinc regulation in mouse Slo3 (mSlo3) revealed that, in the Xenopus oocyte expression system , intracellular zinc directly inhibits mouse Slo3 currents in a dose-dependent manner at micromolar concentrations, with exceptionally slow dissociation. By combining MD simulations and electrophysiology, we also identified amino acid residues contributing to the Zn 2+ slow dissociation from Slo3 channels. Our studies uncover the importance of intracellular zinc dynamics and its regulatory role in ion channels during sperm capacitation.

items.title: Learning is a fundamental source of individuality
items.abstract: Learning and memory are essential components of our individuality. While it is established that behaviour can vary across genetically identical individuals, it remains unknown how much of this variation stems from momentary experience during learning compared to genetics and its past interactions with the environment. To address this, we measured behaviour in thousands of flies from 90 genetic backgrounds while they performed tasks in conditions that either did or did not require learning. Flies that were genetically identical, raised under the same conditions, and tested simultaneously in the same environment persistently modified the extent of expressed individuality when they could learn. This learning-induced residual expression of individuality and its dynamics were subdued or absent in innate, learning-independent behaviours. We could quantify and then recreate this phenomenon in computer simulations. The emergence of in silico behaviour individuality was most consistent with the individuality of real flies once we enabled reinforced learning in simulated agents. Moreover, we showed that minor differences in initial conditions of the experiment can exacerbate the expression of individuality within a genotype in a learning-dependent manner. Our results establish that besides the classical genotype × environment (G × E) interactions shared between individuals in the past, learning from individual momentary experience further extends the expression of individuality.

items.title: Biophysically inspired mean-field model of neuronal populations driven by ion-exchange mechanisms
items.abstract: Whole-brain simulations are a valuable tool for gaining insight into the multiscale processes that regulate brain activity. Due to the complexity of the brain, it is impractical to include all microscopic details in a simulation. Hence, researchers often simulate the brain as a network of coupled neural masses, each described by a mean-field model. These models capture the essential features of neuronal populations while approximating most biophysical details. However, it may be important to include certain parameters that significantly impact brain function. The concentration of ions in the extracellular space is one key factor to consider, as its fluctuations can be associated with healthy and pathological brain states. In this paper, we develop a new mean-field model of a population of Hodgkin–Huxley-type neurons, retaining a microscopic perspective on the ion-exchange mechanisms driving neuronal activity. This allows us to maintain biophysical interpretability while bridging the gap between micro- and macro-scale mechanisms. Our model is able to reproduce a wide range of activity patterns, also observed in large neural network simulations. Specifically, slow-changing ion concentrations modulate the fast neuroelectric activity, a feature of our model that we validated through in vitro experiments. By studying how changes in extracellular ionic conditions can affect whole-brain dynamics, this model serves as a foundation to measure biomarkers of pathological activity and provide potential therapeutic targets in cases of brain dysfunctions like epilepsy.
items.title_zh: 基于生物物理的神经元群体均值场模型研究
items.summary_zh: 全脑模拟是理解调节脑活动的多尺度过程的重要工具。由于大脑的复杂性，模拟中无法包含所有微观细节，因此研究者通常将大脑视为耦合神经质量的网络，每个神经质量由均值场模型描述。本文开发了一种新的霍奇金-赫克斯利型神经元群体均值场模型，保留了对驱动神经活动的离子交换机制的微观视角。该模型能够再现广泛的活动模式，特别是缓慢变化的离子浓度调节快速神经电活动，这一特征通过体外实验得到了验证。我们的研究表明，细胞外离子条件的变化对整体脑功能有显著影响。
items.l1_lead: 研究表明，细胞外离子浓度的变化显著影响整体脑功能，开发的均值场模型成功再现了多种神经活动模式。
items.l2_summary: 全脑模拟是理解调节脑活动多尺度过程的重要工具，但由于大脑的复杂性，模拟中无法包含所有微观细节。因此，研究者通常将大脑视为耦合神经质量的网络，每个神经质量由均值场模型（mean field model）描述。本文开发了一种新的霍奇金-赫克斯利型（Hodgkin-Huxley type）神经元群体均值场模型，旨在保留对驱动神经活动的离子交换机制的微观视角。该模型能够再现广泛的活动模式，尤其是缓慢变化的离子浓度对快速神经电活动的调节能力，这一特征通过体外实验得到了验证。研究结果表明，细胞外离子条件的变化对整体脑功能有显著影响，强调了离子浓度在神经活动中的重要性。这一发现为理解大脑的动态调节机制提供了新的视角，并可能为未来的神经科学研究和临床应用提供理论基础。

items.title: Gβγ engages PLCβ3 at multiple sites to reorient and facilitate its activation
items.abstract: Phospholipase C β (PLCβ) enzymes are activated by heterotrimeric G protein subunits, increasing hydrolysis of phosphatidylinositol-4,5-bisphosphate (PI(4,5)P2) at the plasma membrane. All four human PLCβ isoforms (PLCβ1–4) are activated by Gα q , whereas PLCβ1–3 are activated to varying extents by Gβγ. The binding sites for Gα q on PLCβ are well established, and much has been learned about its mechanism of activation, but comparatively little is known about Gβγ-dependent activation. In this work, we used cryo-electron microscopy single-particle analysis, functional assays, and bioluminescence resonance energy transfer to investigate how Gβγ interacts with PLCβ3 in concert with activated Gα q to regulate phospholipase activity. Gβγ heterodimers bind multiple surfaces of PLCβ3 to promote activation, but alone do not recruit the enzyme to the plasma membrane. Instead, Gβγ facilitates activation by Gα q , most likely by reorienting the phospholipase catalytic site at the membrane to maximize PI(4,5)P2 hydrolysis and downstream Ca 2+ release. Cell-based functional assays demonstrate that Gβγ is required for maximal PLCβ3 activation, even when G q heterotrimers are the sole source of Gβγ. Together, these findings demonstrate that Gβγ acts as a critical positive allosteric modulator that regularly acts in concert with Gα q to activate PLCβ3 at the plasma membrane.

items.title: PKD2L1 channels segregated to the apical compartment are the dual-mode pH sensor in cerebrospinal fluid-contacting neurons
items.abstract: Cerebrospinal fluid-contacting neurons (CSFcNs) are GABAergic cells that surround the central canal (cc) of the spinal cord. Their soma is located sub-ependymally and they have a dendritic-like process that ends as a bulb (the so-called ‘apical process’; ApPr) inside the cc. It remains unclear how this unique anatomical organization, with the soma and the ApPr located in different extracellular environments, relates to their function as a multimodal sensor of cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) composition. One of the main physiological features of CSFcNs is a prominent spontaneous electrical activity mediated by PKD2L1 channels, a non-selective cation channel of the TRP family. PKD2L1 channels have a high single-channel conductance (around 200 pS) and can be modulated by protons and mechanical forces. In this work, we investigate PKD2L1 channel sensitivity to pH and its effects on CSFcNs excitability. We demonstrate that PKD2L1 spontaneous activity generates not only phasic inward currents, but also a sustained current, both of which are modulated bidirectionally by pH with a high sensitivity around physiological values. By combining electrophysiology (direct recordings from intact and isolated ApPrs) with optical methods (laser photolysis of protons), we further show that functional PKD2L1 channels are specifically localized in the ApPr. The spatial segregation of PKD2L1 channels, along with their biophysical properties (high single-channel conductance and pH sensitivity) and the ApPr’s unique membrane properties (very high input resistance), renders CSFcN excitability exquisitely sensitive to PKD2L1 modulation. Altogether, our findings illustrate how the ApPr’s properties are finely tuned to support its sensory role.

items.title: Single-cell spatial mapping reveals reproducible cell type organization and spatially dependent gene expression in gastruloids
items.abstract: Gastruloids are stem-cell-based models that recapitulate key aspects of mammalian gastrulation, including the formation of an anterior-posterior axis. However, we do not have detailed spatial information about gene expression and cell type organization, particularly at the level of individual gastruloids. Here, we report a spatially resolved, single-cell molecular catalog of the transcriptomes of 26 individual gastruloids. We found that cell type composition and tissue-scale spatial organization were largely consistent across gastruloids, but meso-scale patterning of specific cell types varied between samples. Posterior cell types formed distinct, organized clusters, while anterior cell types were more disorganized. To distinguish progressive differentiation from cell type differences, we developed the L-score, a parameter-free quantification of mutually exclusive gene expression. This analysis revealed spatial organization without explicit encoding, recapitulated known cell type relationships, and identified novel gene expression states and spatial subclusters within cell types. We confirmed that in gastruloids, neuromesodermal precursor differentiation occurred through a continuous, spatially coordinated process. We also showed that endothelial precursors exhibited unique spatial organization and had distinct gene expression profiles dependent on their association with anterior somitic or posterior endodermal tissues. This work enables the rigorous use of gastruloids as models for studying the molecular mechanisms underlying mammalian development and tissue organization and introduces new computational tools for analyzing spatially resolved single-cell datasets.
items.title_zh: 单细胞空间映射揭示胃肠体中细胞类型组织与基因表达的空间依赖性
items.summary_zh: 胃肠体是基于干细胞的模型，重现了哺乳动物胚胎发育的关键方面，包括前后轴的形成。然而，我们缺乏关于基因表达和细胞类型组织的详细空间信息，尤其是在单个胃肠体层面。本文报告了26个单独胃肠体的空间分辨单细胞转录组分子目录。研究发现，细胞类型组成和组织尺度的空间组织在胃肠体之间大致一致，但特定细胞类型的中尺度模式在样本间存在差异。后部细胞类型形成了明显的、有序的簇，而前部细胞类型则较为无序。为区分渐进分化与细胞类型差异，我们开发了L-score，这是一种无参数的互斥基因表达量化方法。分析结果揭示了空间组织，重现了已知的细胞类型关系，并识别了细胞类型内的新型基因表达状态和空间亚簇。我们确认在胃肠体中，神经中胚层前体的分化是通过连续的、空间协调的过程进行的，并且内皮前体表现出独特的空间组织及其基因表达谱依赖于与前部的关联。
items.l1_lead: 研究揭示胃肠体中细胞类型的空间组织与基因表达存在依赖性，特定细胞类型在样本间表现出中尺度模式差异，且神经中胚层前体的分化过程具有空间协调性。
items.l2_summary:
本研究聚焦于单细胞空间映射技术在胃肠体（organoid）中的应用，旨在揭示细胞类型组织与基因表达的空间依赖性。胃肠体是基于干细胞的模型，能够重现哺乳动物胚胎发育的关键过程，尤其是前后轴的形成。然而，关于其细胞类型和基因表达的空间分布信息仍然相对缺乏。为此，研究团队对26个单独的胃肠体进行了空间分辨的单细胞转录组（single-cell transcriptome）分析，构建了分子目录。

研究结果显示，胃肠体之间的细胞类型组成和组织尺度的空间组织大致一致，但在特定细胞类型的中尺度模式上却存在显著差异。具体而言，后部细胞类型形成了明显的、有序的簇，而前部细胞类型则表现出较为无序的分布。为了进一步区分渐进分化与细胞类型差异，研究者们开发了一种名为L-score的无参数互斥基因表达量化方法。通过这一方法的分析，研究揭示了细胞的空间组织特征，重现了已知的细胞类型关系，并识别出细胞类型内的新型基因表达状态和空间亚簇。

此外，研究确认在胃肠体中，神经中胚层前体的分化是通过一个连续且空间协调的过程进行的。同时，内皮前体的空间组织及其基因表达谱显示出与前部细胞的关联性，表现出独特的空间依赖性。这些发现不仅为理解胃肠体的发育机制提供了新的视角，也为未来的研究奠定了基础，尤其是在细胞类型的空间组织与功能之间的关系方面。整体而言，本研究为胃肠体的细胞类型和基因表达的空间特征提供了重要的实验数据和理论支持。

items.title: Dissociable roles of reward prediction error in the contrasting mood dynamics of depression and anxiety
items.abstract: Mood fluctuations, central to human experience, are profoundly influenced by reward prediction errors (RPE). Although depression and anxiety traditionally exhibit contrasting mood fluctuations, their interrelated nature has made it challenging to pinpoint their specific roles in RPE-induced mood variations. In this study, we employed a computational model of momentary mood within a gambling task, involving 2043 participants across five experiments. Participants also completed a battery of questionnaires designed to allow us to dissociate anxiety- and depression-specific traits through bifactor modeling. Results showed that depression was associated with dampened mood fluctuations due to mood hyposensitivity to RPE. Importantly, this pattern was also found in patients with affective disorders. In contrast, anxiety correlated with heightened mood fluctuations stemming from mood hypersensitivity to RPE in non-clinical participants. Moreover, the shared depression/anxiety component was linked to lower affective baseline and greater risk aversion. Collectively, our results uncover computational dissociation of depression vs. anxiety using RPE-based mood modeling and present multi-dimensional computational signatures for these symptoms, with clinical relevance for management of mood disorders.

items.title: A real-time, multi-animal model for automatic face detection and identification of freely moving common marmosets based on YOLOv8 algorithms
items.abstract: Precise and up-to-date information about animal location and identity allows us to better quantify individual behaviors in studies of neural activity, cognition, and animal health. In socially housed laboratory animals, identification is usually defined by observation or invasive markers, making the data collection time-consuming, variable across experimenters, and disruptive to animals. We established an automatic pipeline for real-time identification of common marmosets in captivity using a close-view camera. It uses the supervised deep-learning YOLOv8 model to localize individuals, detect faces, and classify identities. Moreover, we use recognition of uniquely color-coded collar beads to improve detection accuracy among visually similar individuals. Across adult and juvenile marmosets, our system automatically identifies marmosets with 82.9% precision and 91.5% recall, achieving human-level performance. This pipeline is designed to be easy to use and generalizable across non-human primate species, ages, and recording hardware, providing rapid and automatic identity recognition from real-time video.

items.title: From East to West – an early-career researcher’s voyage across continents
items.abstract: One scholarship can open a research career. It can also start a years-long negotiation with loneliness, ambiguous job titles, and the quiet arithmetic of underfunded postdoctoral life. Early-career researchers who have made the journey from West Africa to East Germany and on to Western Canada describe what rarely makes it into the acceptance letter, and what institutions on both sides of the Atlantic could do differently.

items.title: Tau hyperphosphorylation impairs cooperative binding to microtubules and perturbs organelle trafficking in neurons
items.abstract: Tau, a neuronal microtubule-associated protein (MAP), organizes the axonal cytoskeleton, and regulates intracellular transport. Tau hyperphosphorylation is linked to neurodegeneration in tauopathies, including Alzheimer’s disease. Tau binds microtubules cooperatively to form cohesive envelopes, which are thought to control access to the microtubule lattice and regulate the activity of motor proteins and other MAPs. However, how disease-related perturbations affect tau dynamics and its function as a selective barrier to intracellular transport remains unclear. Using tau phospho-variants in vitro and in live neurons, we show that tau hyperphosphorylation disrupts cooperative microtubule binding and dysregulates lysosome transport. Hyperphosphorylated tau does not form envelopes, distributes more uniformly along the axon, and dissociates faster from microtubules. Tau weakly inhibits KIF5C motility, but strongly inhibits KIF1A. Hyperphosphorylation reduces KIF5C inhibition but increases KIF1A inhibition by decreasing processivity and accelerating detachment. Consistent with these effects, hyperphosphorylated tau alters lysosome transport in neurons. While phospho-resistant tau inhibits processive lysosome motility, hyperphosphorylated tau weakens tau-mediated regulation of lysosome transport, mimicking tau knockout neurons that exhibit enhanced processivity. Altogether, these findings show that hyperphosphorylation disrupts tau envelopes and impairs lysosome trafficking, likely contributing to early defects in degradative pathways that drive neurodegeneration.
items.title_zh: Tau蛋白过度磷酸化影响微管结合与细胞器运输
items.summary_zh: Tau蛋白是一种神经元微管相关蛋白，负责组织轴突细胞骨架和调节细胞内运输。Tau的过度磷酸化与阿尔茨海默病等tau病的神经退行性变相关。研究表明，过度磷酸化的Tau破坏了其与微管的协同结合，导致溶酶体运输失调。过度磷酸化的Tau无法形成包膜，沿轴突分布更均匀，并且从微管上解离的速度更快。过度磷酸化的Tau对KIF5C的运动抑制较弱，但对KIF1A的抑制较强。过度磷酸化降低了KIF5C的抑制作用，但通过降低过程性和加速解离增加了对KIF1A的抑制。与这些效应一致，过度磷酸化的Tau改变了神经元中的溶酶体运输，模仿了表现出增强过程性的Tau基因敲除神经元。
items.l1_lead: Tau蛋白的过度磷酸化破坏其与微管的结合，导致细胞器运输失调，进而与阿尔茨海默病等神经退行性疾病相关。
items.l2_summary:
Tau蛋白是一种重要的神经元微管相关蛋白，主要负责组织轴突细胞骨架并调节细胞内的运输过程。然而，Tau蛋白的过度磷酸化与阿尔茨海默病等tau病的神经退行性变密切相关。研究发现，过度磷酸化的Tau蛋白会破坏其与微管的协同结合能力，从而导致溶酶体运输的失调。具体来说，过度磷酸化的Tau无法有效形成包膜，导致其在轴突中的分布更加均匀，并且从微管上解离的速度显著加快。

在对细胞器运输的影响方面，过度磷酸化的Tau对KIF5C（Kinesin-5C）的运动抑制作用较弱，而对KIF1A（Kinesin-1A）的抑制作用则较强。这一现象表明，过度磷酸化降低了KIF5C的抑制作用，但通过降低过程性和加速解离的方式，增强了对KIF1A的抑制。与这些效应相一致，过度磷酸化的Tau蛋白改变了神经元中的溶酶体运输模式，表现出与Tau基因敲除神经元相似的增强过程性。

综上所述，过度磷酸化的Tau蛋白不仅影响其与微管的结合，还显著改变了细胞器的运输机制，这些变化可能是导致神经退行性疾病的重要因素。通过深入理解Tau蛋白的功能及其磷酸化状态对细胞运输的影响，有助于为阿尔茨海默病等相关疾病的治疗提供新的思路。

items.title: Bifunctional architecture enables substrate catalysis and channeling in Paracoccus TMAO demethylase
items.abstract: Substrate channeling enhances efficiency and prevents toxicity by directing unstable intermediates between active sites. Trimethylamine N-oxide demethylase (TDM) degrades trimethylamine N-oxide (TMAO) to dimethylamine and formaldehyde (HCHO), but the fate of HCHO has remained unclear. We report cryo-EM structures of TDM in apo, substrate-, and product-bound states that reveal a previously unknown channeling pathway. Combined structural, biochemical, and target molecular dynamics analyses show that HCHO is generated in a catalytic core and guided through a tunnel to a remote tetrahydrofolate (THF)-binding site, where it forms methylene-THF. Thus, TDM emerges as a bifunctional enzyme that unites TMAO demethylation with one-carbon transfer, providing a mechanistic explanation for its role in metabolic efficiency and detoxification.

items.title: Selective lifelong suppression of an odor processing channel in response to critical period experience
items.abstract: Sensory circuits undergo experience-dependent plasticity during early-life critical periods, attuning the nervous system to levels of key environmental stimuli. During a critical period in the Drosophila olfactory system, we found that exposure to ethyl butyrate (EB) induces glial phagocytosis of odorant receptor Or42a-positive olfactory sensory neuron (OSN) axon terminals which terminate in the VM7 glomerulus (Leier et al., 2025). Here, we extend these findings by establishing functional significance and circuit selectivity in this critical period paradigm. First, using a combination of two-photon Ca 2+ imaging and the genetically-encoded voltage indicator ASAP5, we find that Or42a OSN odor-evoked responses are permanently suppressed in animals with critical period odor exposure. Thus, critical period odor exposure results in long-term changes to odor sensitivity in Or42a OSNs. Second, to establish the selectivity of glial pruning for Or42a axon terminals, we examined projection neurons (PNs) postsynaptic to Or42a OSNs as well as a second population of highly EB-responsive OSNs, called Or43b OSNs. We find that (1) within VM7, glial pruning is selective for Or42a terminals, and (2) while Or43b OSNs appear modestly pruned, they maintain their sensitivity to EB. To elucidate this difference, we turned to the Drosophila connectome.
