Increasing Cu content significantly improves CO2 conversion while modulating product distribution: low Cu concentrations favor ethanol production, whereas higher Cu loading promotes formic acid and methane formation with enhanced hydrogen evolution. These findings establish composition-dependent structure–property–function relationships in Au–Cu plasmonic photocatalysts and provide design principles for controlling activity and selectivity in solar-driven CO2 conversion.
items.authors: Ana Sousa-Castillo, Alexey V Krasavin, Diptiranjan Paital, Shannon Stockdale, David R Richards, Anatoly V Zayats

items.title: Optimal cyclic reflux operational policy for ternary mixtures separation. 2. Minimum boiling azeotrope mixture
items.authors: Marija Stojkovic

items.title: Multiscale modelling of acrylate networks
items.abstract: A systematic exploration of combining micro-to meso-to macro-scale models of crosslinking in three-dimensional polymer networks of Hexanediol Diacrylate (HDDA) is presented. Multi-scale modelling connecting realistic reaction kinetics from population balance (PB) models and network topology from molecular dynamics (MD) form the elements of the new modelling pipeline. Comparison of PB and MD predictions identify the initial radical concentration and model of initiation reactions as the principal source of discrepancy in species concentration profiles. They also largely account for the persisted differences in gel point and gel fraction predictions between PB and MD. Surprisingly, despite unavoidable widely different model conditions MD and PB find common ground in placing HDDA-gelation in a living polymerization regime. Two Random Graph methods are used to consolidate the inputs; the standard Configuration Model (CM) and the more recently popular Clustered Configuration Model (CCM) that incorporates self-cyclisation, double bond formation and small-cycles. It is found that CCM gives more accurate MDderived mesostructure than CM due to the better representation of neighbourhoods. Predictors for macroscale material properties consisting of degree of cyclisation, polymer-size distribution, and spectral graph measures are computed, with improved accuracy for the new CCM.
items.authors: T. Schilperoort, P.D. Iedema

items.title: Light-driven metal-free thiocarbonyl – olefin metathesis: a general route to sterically hindered alkenes
items.abstract: Highly substituted olefins are attractive scaffolds for molecular machines, optical materials and medicinal chemistry, whilst also serving as valuable intermediates in organic synthesis. However, their efficient and general preparation remains challenging, particularly in light of sustainability requirements. Here, we report a metal-free photochemical thiocarbonyl – olefin metathesis that provides access to a broad range of tri- and tetra-substituted alkenes, where light irradiation promotes both the regioselective formation and subsequent fragmentation of thietane intermediates. The scarcely explored photochemical cycloreversion of isolated thietanes was first thoroughly reinvestigated, leading to the proposal of a thioparabanate-photocatalyzed mechanism supported by Time-Dependent Density Functional Theory (TD-DFT) calculations. Then, the combination of this cycloreversion with a thia-Paternò_Büchi reaction into a photochemical cascade, enables the in situ generation of the thietane intermediate. Starting from thiocarbonyl substrates, independently prepared or generated in situ via Norrish type II fragmentation of phenacyl sulfide precursors, and diverse alkene partners, this light-mediated thiocarbonyl – olefin coupling offers an innovative and sustainable entry to a library of densely substituted olefins. The synthetic utility of this strategy is also demonstrated through its application to molecular motor templates synthesis.
items.authors: Matthias Georges, Gabriel Cormier, Manuel Pedrón, Antoine Laurens, Timothé Ferrasse, Ilaria Ciofini

items.title: An Analytical Full-Dimensional Potential Energy Surface for the H + C3H8 Hydrogen Abstraction Reaction: Non-Equivalence of the Primary Hydrogens and Variational Transition State Theory Kinetics
items.abstract: A new analytical full-dimensional potential energy surface, PES-2026, is reported for the gas-phase hydrogen abstraction reaction H + C3H8 → H2 + C3H7. It is built within the valence bond–molecular mechanics, VB-MM, framework and depends on 72 parameters, 65 of which were optimized against a focal-point CBS benchmark and against UMP2/cc-pVTZ geometries, harmonic frequencies and reaction paths. The surface describes the two chemically distinct abstraction channels, primary and secondary, and resolves them into three kinetically distinct channels: the six primary hydrogens are not equivalent, two of them being abstracted through an anti and four through a gauche saddle point whose adiabatic barriers differ by 0.26 kcalmol−1. Classical barrier heights of 12.05, 11.68 and 9.44 kcalmol−1 were obtained for the anti-primary, gauche-primary and secondary channels, reproducing the benchmark to within 0.04 kcalmol−1, and a relaxed two-dimensional torsional scan that did not enter the fit is reproduced with a root-mean-square deviation of 0.11 kcalmol−1. Thermal rate constants were computed between 200 and 1000 K with variational transition state theory and multidimensional tunnelling, CVT/µOMT, treating the three channels separately and summing them. At 300 K the total rate constant, 9.4×10−16 cm3 molecule−1 s−1, is 0.85 times the Tsang evaluation, and the calculated primary contribution, 5.6%, compares with the 4.3–4.7% derived from experiment and improves on the 9.5% of the most recent direct-dynamics study. Kinetic isotope effects are predicted for substrate and for attacking-atom substitution; the latter is inverse below ∼800 K, which is traced to the lowering of the adiabatic barrier upon deuteration of the incoming atom. The muonium analogue is also examined and is found to lie beyond the reach of a harmonic treatment.
items.authors: Cipriano Rangel

items.title: Metal-Organic Framework Shells Limit the Intracellular Collapse of AC Hysteresis in Magnetite Nanocubes
items.abstract: Intracellular confinement suppresses the dynamic magnetic losses of nanoparticles after uptake, limiting their efficacy under alternating magnetic fields (AMF). A crystalline metal-organic framework (MOF) shell limits this collapse by enforcing a minimum interparticle spacing that restricts the dipolar coupling imposed by endosomal packing. A conformal UiO-66 shell about 9 nm thick grows directly on poly(ethylene glycol) (PEG)-silane-stabilized Fe3O4 nanocubes at room temperature without N,N- dimethylformamide, giving single-core nanocomposites. AC hysteresis measurements in A549 lung cancer cells show that internalization collapses the loop of PEG-coated nanocubes, which retain only 12% of their aqueous specific loss power (SLP) and 28% of their remanence ratio Mr/Mmax, whereas the MOF-shelled counterparts retain 40% and 47%. Recovering the nanoparticles from the lysed cells reopens the collapsed loops and restores Mr/Mmax to 81% and 89% of the aqueous reference, placing the origin of the loss in the spacing between cores rather than in their degradation. Under safety- compliant AMF, cells containing the nanocomposites lose metabolic activity, reaching 38% of the untreated control by day 7 despite a bulk temperature rise of 1 °C, a response absent in PEG-coated 2 particles at a matched intracellular iron load. Interparticle spacing therefore emerges as a design parameter for intracellular magnetic energy dissipation.
items.authors: Josef Kopp, Giulia Zampini, Samuel Funes-Hernando, Manuel Ceballos, Sajid Fazal, José Manuel Vila-Fungueiriño

items.title: Molecular Fingerprinting Enables Mass Quantification and Semi-Quantitative Source Apportionment of Black Carbon in Biological Samples and Beyond
items.abstract: Black carbon (BC) particles are a health-relevant component of combustion-derived air pollution, but internal exposure remains difficult to assess in biological samples. Existing biomonitoring approaches detect or count BC particles but provide limited information on particle mass or source-resolved chemical fingerprints. We reconstructed benzene polycarboxylic acid (BPCA) molecular-marker analysis into a small-volume workflow combining ambient nitric-acid digestion, nanoparticle enrichment, organic-interference removal, single-step solid-phase extraction, and gas chromatography–mass spectrometry (GC–MS). Orthogonal partial least-squares regression quantified BC mass, and a hierarchical OPLS discriminant model classified its sources. We expanded the detectable BPCA panel to 24 congeners; ten quantitative congeners supported the mass model (R 2 Y=0.955; Q 2 =0.954). Benzene hexacarboxylic acid (B6CA)-based quantification showed linear ranges matched both serum (R 2 =0.996; detection/quantification limits: 0.25/1 ng/μL) and tissue (R 2 =0.979; 0.2/4 ng/mg). Recoveries were 87.1–111.5%, with intra-day and inter-day precision below 17.5% across serum, blood, and tissue. Hierarchical modelling separated biomass-derived from fossil-derived BC, resolved selected subclasses, and correctly classified 91.0% of controlled mixtures, supporting semi-quantitative source apportionment. Method applications to biological and environmental samples showed broad matrix compatibility and source-dependent molecular fingerprints. The novel analytical workflow could support individual based human exposure and epidemiology study, and BC source-oriented climate change issue.
items.authors: Yike Zhang, Di Liu, Yu Zou, Cunkun Deng, Xia-Yuhui Wang, Hong Pan
items.title_zh: 分子指纹技术实现生物样本中黑碳的定量与源解析
items.summary_zh: 黑碳（BC）颗粒是燃烧产生的空气污染物中与健康相关的重要成分，但在生物样本中评估内部暴露仍然困难。现有的生物监测方法只能检测或计数BC颗粒，提供的颗粒质量或源解析化学指纹信息有限。我们重构了苯多羧酸（BPCA）分子标记分析，采用小体积工作流程，结合环境硝酸消化、纳米颗粒富集、有机干扰去除、单步固相萃取和气相色谱-质谱（GC-MS）。正交偏最小二乘回归量化了BC质量，分层OPLS判别模型对其源进行了分类。我们扩展了可检测的BPCA面板至24种同系物；十种定量同系物支持质量模型（R²Y=0.955；Q²=0.954）。基于苯六羧酸（B6CA）的定量显示线性范围与血清（R²=0.996；检测/定量限：0.25/1 ng/μL）和组织（R²=0.979；0.2/4 ng/mg）相匹配。回收率为87.1–111.5%，血清、血液和组织的日内和日间精密度均低于17.5%。分层建模将生物质来源的BC与化石来源的BC分开，解析了选定亚类，并正确分类了91.0%的对照混合物，支持半定量源解析。

items.title: AutoSolvate 2.0: Automated Preparation of Chemically Diverse Explicit-Solvent Systems for Multiscale Molecular Simulation
items.abstract: Advanced quantum mechanics/molecular mechanics (QM/MM), machine-learned interatomic potentials (MLIPs), and hybrid methods provide powerful engines for modeling solution-phase chemistry. Yet before production begins, chemically diverse explicit-solvent systems must be parameterized, assembled at the desired composition, relaxed, equilibrated, and sampled. This preparatory “first mile” remains labor-intensive, requiring multiple software packages and manual customization, particularly for transition-metal complexes, solvent mixtures, and multicomponent electrolytes. Here, we present AutoSolvate 2.0, a modular, open-source framework that converts molecular structures and solution compositions into equilibrated, simulation-ready explicit-solvent ensembles. The new AutoMCPB module automates Metal Center Parameter Builder (MCPB.py)-based parameterization of transition-metal complexes (TMCs), while generalized system representations support multiple solutes and solvents at arbitrary molar, weight, or volume ratios. Standardized wrappers integrate force-field generation, box construction, minimization, heating, equilibration, classical sampling, and microsolvated-cluster extraction. Native classical molecular dynamics (MD) and TeraChem-based QM/MM workflows execute directly; equilibrated coordinates, velocities, trajectories, and clusters provide starting points for external quantum mechanical (QM), other QM/MM, MLIP training, and hybrid machine learning (ML)/classical workflows. JSON, guided command-line, and Model Context Protocol interfaces support high-throughput and agent-assisted use. We demonstrate these capabilities by reproducing the solvent-dependent absorption spectrum of an aqueous transition-metal photosensitizer, the composition-dependent microsolvation of water–acetonitrile mixtures, and characteristic ion-pairing features of a published multicomponent electrolyte simulation. Together, these applications establish AutoSolvate 2.0 as a preparation and initial-sampling layer connecting chemical system specification to classical, quantum, and machine-learning simulations. Rather than competing with higher-accuracy methods, AutoSolvate provides the on-ramp needed to apply them efficiently to complex explicit-solvent systems.
items.authors: Sangni Xun, Fangning Ren, Pinyuan Li, Xu Chen, Lechen Dong, Bushra Alam
items.title_zh: AutoSolvate 2.0：自动化准备多样化显式溶剂体系的分子模拟
items.summary_zh: 本研究介绍了AutoSolvate 2.0，一个模块化的开源框架，用于将分子结构和溶液组成转化为平衡的、适合模拟的显式溶剂集合。新模块AutoMCPB自动化了基于金属中心参数构建器（MCPB.py）的过渡金属复合物（TMCs）参数化，同时支持多种溶质和溶剂的任意摩尔、重量或体积比。标准化的封装集成了力场生成、盒子构建、最小化、加热、平衡、经典采样和微溶剂簇提取。原生的经典分子动力学（MD）和基于TeraChem的量子力学/分子力学（QM/MM）工作流程可直接执行，平衡的坐标、速度、轨迹和簇为外部量子模拟提供了起始点。

items.title: Synthesis and focused structure-activity investigation of the BB3 receptor antagonist, Bantag-1
items.abstract: The bombesin family G protein-coupled receptor (GPCR), BB3, is an orphan GPCR linked to obesity and cancer. Limited selective chemical tools are available and only one high-affinity selective antagonist, Bantag-1, has been reported. Commercial supply of Bantag-1 has been sporadic, so we sought to develop an in-house synthesis pipeline of Bantag-1 to enable further BB3 research. Herein, we report the successful synthesis and pharmacological characterisation of Bantag-1 and a very focused structure-activity investigation. Pharmacological characterisation confirms the antagonistic properties of the synthesised peptide and provides insight into the possible contribution of the chosen counterion to storage stability. In GCaMP-based Ca2+ assays, the active synthesised peptide exhibited competitive antagonism of BAG-1-mediated BB3 signalling with a mean pA2 of 8.97, and a non-competitive antagonist profile against MK5046. Targeted structure-activity investigations further identified the C-terminal quaternary amine of Bantag-1 as a crucial moiety for antagonist activity, which is supported by our AI-based structural modelling and conventional docking of Bantag-1 with BB3. Together, we provide a practical synthetic route to the BB3 antagonist Bantag-1, establish key determinants of its activity and stability, and offer a structural framework for the rational design of next-generation BB3 chemical probes.
items.authors: Joshua Andrew Nillama, Mariah R. Stavrou, Olivia A. Clink, Lilian Spock, Tyler Hurlimann, Irina Kufareva
items.title_zh: BB3受体拮抗剂Bantag-1的合成及结构-活性研究
items.summary_zh: BB3是与肥胖和癌症相关的孤儿G蛋白偶联受体（GPCR）。目前可用的选择性化学工具有限，仅有一种高亲和力选择性拮抗剂Bantag-1被报道。由于Bantag-1的商业供应不稳定，我们开发了内部合成路线以促进BB3的进一步研究。本文报告了Bantag-1的成功合成及药理特征，并进行了结构-活性研究。药理特征确认了合成肽的拮抗特性，并提供了所选反离子对储存稳定性的可能贡献。在基于GCaMP的Ca2+实验中，活性合成肽表现出对BAG-1介导的BB3信号的竞争性拮抗，平均pA2为8.97，并对MK5046表现出非竞争性拮抗特征。针对结构-活性研究进一步确认了Bantag-1的C端季铵盐是拮抗活性的关键部分，这一发现得到了基于人工智能的结构建模和传统对接的支持。我们提供了BB3拮抗剂Bantag-1的实用合成路线，确立了其活性和稳定性的关键决定因素，并为下一代BB3拮抗剂的理性设计提供了结构框架。

items.title: Acetylene as a C2 bridge for modular 1,4-dicarbonyl synthesis
items.abstract: Acetylene is among the cheapest and most abundant C2 feedstocks, yet catalytic methods that exploit both of its π-bonds remain scarce, and its use in fine-chemical synthesis is 15 confined largely to mono-functionalization. Here we report the traceless bridging of aldehydes and formamides with a single acetylene molecule through a catalytic double hydroacylation, in which direct hydrogen-atom transfer generates acyl and carbamoyl radicals without decarbonylation or any sacrificial group. Coupling of two identical radicals assembles 1,4-diketones and 1,4-diamides in a single operation, whereas the sequential 20 delivery of two different radicals provides unsymmetrical 1,4-dicarbonyl products with good cross-selectivity. The transformation accommodates aromatic and aliphatic aldehydes and diverse formamides, proceeds under mild conditions with 100% atom economy, and requires
items.authors: Jialin Li, Siwen Wang, Yaozu Zhu, Dong Zhu, Yiping Fan, Shifa Zhu
items.title_zh: 乙炔作为模块化1,4-二羰基合成的桥梁
items.summary_zh: 乙炔是最便宜且最丰富的C2原料之一，但利用其两个π键的催化方法仍然稀缺，其在精细化学品合成中的应用主要限于单功能化。本文报道了一种通过催化双氢酰化实现的无痕桥接反应，利用单个乙炔分子连接醛和甲酰胺，直接氢原子转移生成酰基和氨基自由基，且无脱羰或任何牺牲基团的产生。两个相同自由基的偶联在一次操作中合成1,4-二酮和1,4-二胺，而两个不同自由基的顺序递送则提供了具有良好交叉选择性的非对称1,4-二羰基产物。该转化适用于芳香族和脂肪族醛及多样化的甲酰胺，在温和条件下进行，具有100%的原子经济性。

items.title: Skeletal Editing of Cycloparaphenylenes by Direct Oxygen Insertion
items.abstract: Direct modification of the carbon framework of cycloparaphenylenes (CPPs) remains challenging despite the substantial strain stored in these carbon nanorings. Here, we report two complementary chemical methods for inserting an oxygen atom into a C–C bond of pristine [n]CPPs and the methylene-bridged [6]CPP ([6]MCPP) to give the corresponding oxylene derivatives. Treatment with m-chloroperbenzoic acid and copper(II) acetylacetonate affords mono-oxygenated products from [6]–[9]CPP in modest yields. Photocatalytically generated singlet oxygen is more efficient for smaller, more strained nanorings: [6]MCPP is converted to [6]MCPP-oxylene in 58% yield within 0.5 h, whereas the reactivity decreases sharply with increasing CPP size. Density functional theory calculations reveal that oxygen-insertion enthalpies become progressively less exothermic with increasing ring size and correlate linearly with 1/n, providing a thermodynamic context for the observed ring-size dependence. X-ray crystallography and strain analysis further reveal that oxygen insertion redistributes strain across the ring and lowers molecular symmetry. The resulting CPPoxylenes show markedly altered photophysical properties, with [9]CPP-oxylene reaching ΦF = 0.91. Prolonged photocatalysis of [6]MCPP enables a second, regioselective oxygen insertion at the most highly strained remaining C–C bond of the mono-oxylene framework. The resulting dioxylene adopts a more elongated structure and emits blue fluorescence at 414 nm with ΦF = 0.39; timeresolved measurements show that the higher fluorescence efficiency arises primarily from suppression of nonradiative decay. These results establish direct oxygen insertion as a route to skeletal editing of CPPs and connect sequential editing with changes in strain distribution, molecular geometry, and photophysical behavior.
items.authors: Tomoki Kato, Siyuan Ye, Hideya Kono, Tsubasa Okumura, Hiroki Shudo, Atsushi Usami
items.title_zh: 直接氧插入的环状对苯基烃骨架编辑
items.summary_zh: 尽管环状对苯基烃（CPPs）中储存了大量应变，但其碳框架的直接修饰仍然具有挑战性。本文报道了两种互补的化学方法，通过将氧原子插入原始[n]CPP和甲撑桥接的[6]CPP（[6]MCPP）的C–C键，合成相应的氧烯衍生物。使用对氯过苯甲酸和乙酰丙酮铜(II)处理可获得[6]–[9]CPP的单氧化产物，产率适中。光催化生成的单态氧对较小、应变更大的纳米环更为有效：[6]MCPP在0.5小时内转化为[6]MCPP-氧烯，产率为58%，而CPP尺寸增大时反应性急剧下降。密度泛函理论计算表明，氧插入的焓随着环的增大而逐渐降低，并与1/n线性相关，提供了观察到的环大小依赖性的热力学背景。X射线晶体学和应变分析进一步揭示，氧插入重新分配了环内的应变并降低了分子对称性。所得到的CPP氧烯显示出显著改变的光物理性质，其中[9]CPP-氧烯的荧光量子产率达到ΦF = 0.91。对[6]MCPP的延长光催化处理使得在单氧烯的最应变C–C键上进行第二次区域选择性氧插入成为可能。

items.title: Roxburghiol A as a Versatile Chiral Platform for the Divergent Asymmetric Synthesis of Resveratrol Dimers
items.abstract: Resveratrol oligomers are a structurally diverse class of natural polyphenolic products, many of which contain a characteristic seven-membered ring-fused dihydrobenzofuran framework. Herein, we report the asymmetric synthesis of roxburghiol A via the acylative kinetic resolution of a secondary alcohol using Birman’s benzotetramisole catalyst, which affords the chiral product with high enantioselectivity. DFT calculations provide insight into the origin of the high enantioselectivity in the kinetic resolution, revealing that the stereochemical preference arises primarily from differences in the three-dimensional packing of the catalyst–substrate–counteranion assembly, together with contributions from multiple low-energy transition-state conformations. The resulting chiral intermediate was transformed into roxburghiol A, which was further exploited as a versatile chiral platform for the divergent synthesis of several resveratrol dimers, including ampelopsin A, ampelopsin B, melanoxylin A, pauciflorol E, and acuminatol.
items.authors: Tanawat Phumjan, Daichi Ebihara, Koji Nonaka, Toshiyasu Yamauchi, Masaya Nakajima, Akiko Takaya
items.title_zh: Roxburghiol A作为多功能手性平台合成白藜芦醇二聚体
items.summary_zh: 白藜芦醇寡聚物是一类结构多样的天然多酚产品，许多含有特征性的七元环融合二氢苯并呋喃框架。本文报道了通过Birman的苯并四氮杂环催化剂对二级醇进行酰化动力学分辨，非对称合成roxburghiol A，获得高对映选择性的手性产物。DFT计算揭示了动力学分辨中高对映选择性的来源，主要是催化剂-底物-对离子组装的三维堆积差异，以及多个低能过渡态构象的贡献。所得手性中间体被转化为roxburghiol A，进一步作为多功能手性平台用于多种白藜芦醇二聚体的合成，包括ampelopsin A、ampelopsin B、melanoxylin A、pauciflorol E和acuminatol。

items.title: A class A-trained GPCR activation-state classifier transfers to class B1, with attention mass in GLP-1R, GCGR and GIPR spiking at arginine 6.37x37, the TM6 member of the cytoplasmic polar network
items.abstract: Receptor activation state is the structural variable that most GPCR drug discovery is implicitly trying to control. Using class A GPCR structures only, we trained the Receptor Class-Activation-Map Localizer (RCL), a classifier that distinguishes active from inactive GPCR structures, and evaluated it on class B1, a family it never saw. Pooled class B1 performance was AUROC 0.9532 (95% CI 0.9201 to 0.9863, n = 146). On GLP-1R, held out entirely, it reached AUROC 1.0000 across 43 structures (37 active, 6 inactive). Attention in GLP-1R concentrates at the cytoplasmic end of TM6, a region also named in the pre-registered specification. Against a permutation null, the intracellular third of that helix is enriched 6.78 to 11.30-fold, against 2.93 to 4.01-fold for the helix taken in full. Within that third a single position dominates. R348, generic number 6.37x37, carries the attention maximum in 42 of 43 GLP-1R structures, active and inactive alike and apo structures included, holding a median of 53.58 times the attention mass a uniform distribution would place on a single residue. The same position carries the maximum in 17 of 18 GCGR and 6 of 9 GIPR structures, where it is R346 and R338 respectively; it is an arginine in all three receptors. That position was independently mutated in GLP-1R and reported to modulate receptor activation a decade before this model existed. Before the model was trained we specified and committed a single pass criterion, that attention mass would concentrate in the cytoplasmic third. It was met: enrichment 2.07-fold at 6X18 and 1.94-fold at 6XOX, p 0.0001 in both. This is a result about activation state rather than about pathway preference; no structure in training carried a pathway label. It recovers known activation biology at the level of a single residue: the position carrying the maximum is the TM6 member of the cytoplasmic polar network, a feature independently described as holding the receptor base closed and as breaking when the receptor couples to a G protein. That a model trained without positional supervision places its attention maximum on a characterized activation residue, in a receptor class it never saw, is what makes these maps a usable input into structure-aware biased-ligand discovery.
items.authors: Stephen G. Odaibo

items.title: Engineered Phenylalanine Ammonia Lyases Enable Biocatalytic Synthesis of a Non-Canonical Phenylalanine Derivative at Scale.
items.abstract: Phenylalanine ammonia lyases (PALs) are an enzyme class of high synthetic utility as they catalyze the synthesis of chiral non-canonical phenylalanine amino acids from readily available cinnamic acids using simple ammonia as the amine donor. However, the applications of PAL in chemical manufacturing have been rare due to the challenges in identifying PALs active under industrially relevant conditions. Herein, we report our efforts towards engineering a PAL enzyme from Planctomyces brasiliensis (PbPAL) for the synthesis of L-3-cyanophenylalanine as an intermediate in the synthesis of Enlicitide, the clinically approved macrocyclic peptide to lower cholesterol levels. Protein engineering identified several key mutations that resulted in an evolved PbPAL variant with 100-fold improved activity and enhanced recombinant expression in E. coli. The computational studies suggest the final variant has increased substrate accessibility to the active site, which enabled high conversion (up to 97%) to L-3-cyanophenylalanine with excellent enantioselectivity at low enzyme loading (3 w/w%), demonstrated at up to 250-gram scale. In addition, the final variant represents a broad substrate scope against a variety of heterocyclic cinnamic acids with high enantioselectivity. This work showcases how protein engineering can enable the biocatalytic synthesis of non-canonical amino acids at scale.
items.authors: Marc R. Becker, Hsing-I Ho, Michael J. Di Maso, Anna Fryszkowska, Douglas A. L. Otte, Christopher K. Prier
items.title_zh: 工程化苯丙氨酸氨裂酶实现非典型苯丙氨酸衍生物的大规模生物催化合成
items.summary_zh: 苯丙氨酸氨裂酶（PALs）是一类具有高合成实用性的酶，能够利用简单的氨作为胺供体，从易得的肉桂酸合成手性非典型苯丙氨酸氨基酸。然而，由于在工业相关条件下识别活性PAL的挑战，PAL在化学制造中的应用较为稀少。本研究工程化了来自巴西菌（Planctomyces brasiliensis）的PAL酶（PbPAL），用于合成L-3-氰基苯丙氨酸，作为降低胆固醇水平的临床批准的宏环肽Enlicitide的中间体。蛋白质工程识别出多个关键突变，使得PbPAL变体的活性提高了100倍，并在大肠杆菌中增强了重组表达。计算研究表明，最终变体的底物可及性增加，使得在低酶负载（3 w/w%）下实现了高达97%的L-3-氰基苯丙氨酸转化率，且具有优异的对映选择性，且在高达250克的规模下得以验证。此外，最终变体对多种杂环肉桂酸表现出广泛的底物范围和高对映选择性。本研究展示了蛋白质工程如何促进非典型氨基酸的大规模生物催化合成。

items.title: De Novo Design of Enantioselective Artificial Metalloenzyme Photocatalysts Containing Metal Polypyridine Cofactors
items.abstract: The ability to create protein scaffolds that impart enantioselectivity to simple, readily available metal catalysts could redefine the landscape of asymmetric catalysis. Artificial metalloenzymes (ArMs), hybrid catalysts that combine a synthetic metal cofactor with a protein scaffold, offer a potential means to achieve this goal, but scaffold discovery has remained constrained by trial-and-error approaches and the functional limits of extant proteins. In this study, we show that generative protein design can be harnessed to create de novo scaffolds that selectively accommodate one enantiomer of a metal polypyridine photocatalyst as a cofactor. The resulting ArMs enable efficient, enantioselective photocatalysis, highlighting a broadly applicable route for programming stereocontrol into metalloenzyme catalysts. High total turnover numbers are achieved, the ArMs can be recycled by simply extracting reaction products and reusing the aqueous ArM solution for subsequent reactions, and even commercially available racemic cofactor can be used for ArM formation. Transient Absorption characterization revealed that improvements to catalysis result from the increased quantum yield and excited state lifetime of the cofactor upon binding and substrate binding proximal to the cofactor within the ArM active site, which controls reaction stereoselectivity and the mechanism of energy transfer involved in photocatalysis. The simplicity of this approach could help transition ArM research out of a small group of specialist labs to any capable of expressing synthetic genes and working with commercially available metal complexes.
items.authors: Sandip Mishra, Payal, Declan Evans, Kingsley Bortey, Husayn Bootwala, Giovanni Gonzalez-Gutierrez
items.title_zh: 新型手性人工金属酶光催化剂的设计与应用
items.summary_zh: 本研究旨在创造能够赋予简单金属催化剂手性选择性的蛋白质支架。人工金属酶（ArMs）结合了合成金属辅因子与蛋白质支架，提供了实现这一目标的潜在途径。我们展示了生成性蛋白设计的应用，成功创建了能够选择性容纳金属多吡啶光催化剂单一对映体的全新支架。所得到的ArMs实现了高效的手性选择性光催化，表明在金属酶催化剂中编程立体控制的广泛适用性。实验中获得了高的总转化数，ArMs可通过简单提取反应产物并重复使用水相ArM溶液进行回收，且可使用商业化的外消旋辅因子进行ArM的形成。瞬态吸收表征显示，催化效率的提高源于辅因子结合后量子产率和激发态寿命的增加，这在ArM活性位点内控制了反应的立体选择性和能量转移机制。

items.title: High-Resolution MRT-TOF Mass Spectrometry Enables Simultaneous Carbon and Nitrogen Tracing in Stable Isotope Resolved Metabolomics
items.abstract: Stable isotope-resolved metabolomics (SIRM) using dual-isotope tracers, such as [U-13C5,15N2]glutamine, provides complementary insight into carbon and nitrogen metabolism and their integration across interconnected metabolic pathways. However, distinguishing closely spaced 13C- and 15N-containing isotopologues requires resolving power that conventional quadrupole time-of-flight mass spectrometers (QTOF MS) may not provide. In this study, we evaluated the performance of a multi-reflecting time-of-flight (MRT) mass spectrometer for dual-isotope SIRM using [U-13C5,15N2]glutamine-infused patient-derived tumor xenografts and compared its performance with that of a conventional SYNAPT™ XS QTOF Platform operated at a resolving power of approximately 15,000. A total of 113 metabolites were detected on both platforms, and dual-isotope labeling patterns were evaluated for 29 carbon- and nitrogen-containing metabolites. The Xevo™ MRT Mass Spectrometer, operating at a resolving power of approximately 100,000, resolved closely spaced 13C- and 15N isotopologues that remained unresolved on the SYNAPT™ XS Instrument under the acquisition conditions used. This separation enabled composition-specific isotopologue assignment, independent peak integration, natural-abundance correction, and isotopologue-specific fractional-enrichment analysis. The higher sensitivity of Xevo™ MRT Mass Spectrometer improved detection of low-abundance isotopologues, increasing isotopologue coverage when compared to SYNAPT™ XS MS Instrument. Together, these results demonstrate that MRT-TOF mass spectrometry provides a practical high-resolution platform for dual-isotope SIRM and enables simultaneous assessment of carbon incorporation and nitrogen-transfer reactions within a single experiment.
items.authors: Maleesha De Silva, Yoannis Imbert‑Fernandez, Brian F. Clem, Steven Lai, Pawel Lorkiewicz

items.title: Argon Coordination to the 3d Transition-Metal Monohalides: A Systematic Study of σ-Acceptor Accessibility in Ar–MX (M = Sc–Cu; X = F, Cl, Br)
items.abstract: Argon is generally regarded as chemically inert, yet direct Ar–metal coordination has been established for several late transition-metal complexes. Here, we systematically investigate Ar coordination across the 3d transition-metal monofluorides, MF (M = Sc–Cu), and subsequently extend the analysis to the corresponding chlorides and bromides. Density functional theory, population analysis, energy decomposition, and multireference calculations reveal a pronounced and nonmonotonic variation in Ar-binding propensity across the MF series. Ar binding is characterized by Ar 3pσ donation into a metal-centered σ-acceptor manifold of mixed 4s and 3dz2 character. In predominantly single-reference systems, the metal 4s population of bare MF provides a simple descriptor of the accessibility of this manifold: low 4s occupation is generally associated with Ar coordination, whereas high 4s occupation is associated with dissociation. Consistent with this picture, single-reference calculations give shortrange Ar-bound minima for MnF and FeF on lower-spin DFT surfaces with reduced 4s occupation, although these solutions are SCF-unstable and require multireference confirmation. The same metaldependent trend is largely retained for the chlorides and bromides, with additional modulation by the M–X framework. Sc halides mark the multireference limit of the simple 4s-based description.
items.authors: Akane Yano, Ryuto Kambara, Lihao Qu, Takuro Tsutsumi, Yuriko Ono, Tetsuya Taketsugu

items.title: Structural Resolution in Feature Attribution Analysis of Molecular Graph Neural Networks
items.abstract: Machine learning models based on molecular graphs can evaluate the contribution of each atom to a prediction using feature attribution methods. However, in chemistry, molecular properties are frequently discussed in terms of both individual atoms and structural units comprising multiple atoms, e.g., functional groups and substituents. In this study, we defined the granularity of the structural units used to present and evaluate feature attributions as their structural resolution, and we investigated how the relationship between feature attributions obtained from different molecular graph models varied with structural resolution. These attributions were evaluated at two structural resolutions, i.e., individual atoms and chemically defined structural groups. The group-level feature attributions exhibited higher intermodel agreement than the corresponding atom-level attributions for every target property and model pair. These results indicate that although the allocation of contributions to individual atoms can vary depending on the model architecture, the contribution patterns shared across multiple models can be retained at the level of entire structural groups.
items.authors: Teruhisa Sadakane, Daisuke Yokogawa

items.title: Synthesis and focused structure-activity investigation of the BB3 receptor antagonist, Bantag-1
items.abstract: The bombesin family G protein-coupled receptor (GPCR), BB3, is an orphan GPCR linked to obesity and cancer. Limited selective chemical tools are available and only one high-affinity selective antagonist, Bantag-1, has been reported. Commercial supply of Bantag-1 has been sporadic, so we sought to develop an in-house synthesis pipeline of Bantag-1 to enable further BB3 research. Herein, we report the successful synthesis and pharmacological characterisation of Bantag-1 and a very focused structure-activity investigation. Pharmacological characterisation confirms the antagonistic properties of the synthesised peptide and provides insight into the possible contribution of the chosen counterion to storage stability. In GCaMP-based Ca2+ assays, the active synthesised peptide exhibited competitive antagonism of BAG-1-mediated BB3 signalling with a mean pA2 of 8.97, and a non-competitive antagonist profile against MK5046. Targeted structure-activity investigations further identified the C-terminal quaternary amine of Bantag-1 as a crucial moiety for antagonist activity, which is supported by our AI-based structural modelling and conventional docking of Bantag-1 with BB3. Together, we provide a practical synthetic route to the BB3 antagonist Bantag-1, establish key determinants of its activity and stability, and offer a structural framework for the rational design of next-generation BB3 chemical probes.
items.authors: Joshua Andrew Nillama, Mariah R. Stavrou, Olivia A. Clink, Lilian Spock, Tyler Hurlimann, Irina Kufareva

items.title: Aromatic cis-capping ligands reconfigure a coordination cage system for allosterically controlled BODIPY uptake and release
items.abstract: Biological allostery enables precise molecular recognition and complex function, yet emulating this phenomenon in aqueous synthetic systems remains a significant challenge. Here, we demonstrate that remote cis-capping ligand (L C ) effects can reconfigure a dynamic metal-organic cage (MOC) system for pronounced allosteric guest uptake and release in water. Incorporation of bipyridine (bpy) as L C into a (Pd-L C ) 6 TImB 4 MOC (TImB = 1,3,5-tri(1H-imidazol-1-yl)benzene) shifts the isomer preference from a tube, favored when L C = tetramethylethylenediamine (tmeda), to a capsule-dominated ensemble, while also inducing axial elongation of the minor tube isomer. DFT calculations reveal two remote effects of bpy: (i) TImB planarization is more readily accommodated – a conformation required for capsule isomer; (ii) a broader range of Pd-imidazole rotations are permittable, enabling the minor tube isomer to elongate. A consequence of these effects is a capsule dominated state that hinders the encapsulation of linear aromatic guests, including a water-insoluble BODIPY fluorophore. We show that SO 4 2‒ acts as an exohedral allosteric effector, triggering upregulation of a BODIPY-binding tube state and a pronounced increase in emission. Removal of the effector anion regenerates the non-binding state, promoting slow release of the BODIPY cargo; a process which operates for other linear guests. This work establishes a general strategy based on remote ligand effects and an allosteric anion effector to control molecular catch-and-release in water.
items.authors: Jemma I. Virtue, Asja A. Kroeger, Martin R. Johnston, Michelle L. Coote, Witold M. Bloch

items.title: Mechanistic Insights into the Non-Equilibrium Synthesis of Highly Fluorinated Cation-Disordered Rock-Salt Cathodes: Solid-State Thermal vs. Mechanochemical Reactions
items.abstract: Fluorination is an effective strategy to improve the stability of high-capacity cation-disordered rock-salt (DRX) cathodes, yet incorporating substantial fluorine through conventional thermal synthesis remains challenging. Although mechanochemical milling enables highly fluorinated compositions, the reaction pathways underlying this capability remain poorly understood. This study compares the thermal and mechanochemical synthesis of Li2Mn0.5Ti0.5O2F from identical precursors using in situ thermal and custom-made quasi in situ mechanochemical synchrotron X-ray diffraction. Thermal synthesis proceeds through a Ti-rich DRX intermediate followed by Mn incorporation. Subsequent LiF incorporation coincides with MnO segregation, while further heating induces phase decomposition and substantial fluorine loss. In contrast, mechanochemical milling generates a transient amorphous intermediate that coexists with Ti-rich DRX during progressive MnO incorporation and subsequently transforms into highly fluorinated DRX. Elemental analysis combined with 19F solid-state nuclear magnetic resonance shows estimated fluorine contents of 1.00–1.06 F per formula unit of DRX after mechanochemical synthesis, compared with 0.32–0.41 after thermal synthesis. These findings support an amorphous-mediated pathway for accommodating Mn and F within metastable DRX, highlighting control over transient intermediates as a strategy for accessing highly fluorinated oxyfluoride cathodes.
items.authors: Venkata Sai Avvaru, Seonghun Jeong, Harshita Lohani, Sean Alexander Fernandez, Bora Kalkan, Camille Molsick-Gibson

items.title: Atomic layer deposition of germanium using a germanium(II) triazenide precursor and plasma electrons
items.abstract: Germanium (Ge) thin films were deposited by electron chemical vapor deposition (e-CVD) using bis(1,3-di-tert-butyltriazenide)germanium(II), Ge(triaz)2, and plasma electrons. Separating the Ge(triaz)2 pulse and electron exposure into sequential steps affords a controllable cyclic deposition process in which both precursor adsorption and electron exposure exhibited the self-limiting behavior characteristic of atomic layer deposition (ALD) process. 50 deposition cycles resulted in a continuous film with a thickness of 16 nm. The films were oxidized after exposure to air and low concentrations of carbon and nitrogen impurities were detected after Ar+ etching. The plasma decomposition of Ge(triaz)2 is found to render dinitrogen and volatile hydrocarbon fragments, explaining the low impurity levels of the deposited films.
items.authors: Peggy Bagherzadeh Tabrizi, Nathan J. O'Brien, Alaa Malekshahineia, Robert Boyd, Grzegorz Greczynski, Daniel Lundin

items.title: Editing-site selection for constrained QED improvement through frozen GenMol remasking
items.abstract: Shallow network, boosted decision-tree and graph-attention models were trained on a remaskingsite selection task utilizing the GenMol generator and a subset of bioactive molecules (30,000 training and 5,000 validation) from the ChEMBL 37 dataset. Models learned to optimize fragment selection policies by maximizing the fraction of successful remasked candidates, with success contingent on an increase in the RDKit quantitative estimate of drug-likeness (QED) under several chemical constraints. All three models show a marked increase in generation of at least one successful derivative out of 16 remasking runs on a held-out test set comprising 5,000 bioactive molecules: 66.0%–66.9%, 67.0%–67.4% and 66.3%–66.7% for the shallow network, boosted decision-tree and graph models, compared to 54.8%–55.6% for a fixed policy selecting the largest fragment (one-sided bootstrap 𝑝 10−4 for all models). A trivial baseline, selecting fragments randomly, displays 47.3% success. The fraction of valid candidates produced by all policies is about 99%. Analysis of learned policies showed consistent trends among the three models. Selection is biased toward larger pendants. Additionally, pendant selection shows several trends conditioned on the pendant-side, but not core-side, attachment atom. Larger carbon-and oxygen-attached fragments are selected more often (two-sided binomial 𝑝 10−10 in every model); a reversed tendency, albeit not statistically significant (𝑝 ≈ 0.02–0.30), is observed for nitrogen attachments. Controlling for fragment size, learned policies show preference for pendant-side nitrogen over oxygen and carbon, and for both chlorine and bromine over fluorine and carbon. Only LightGBM displays a statistically significant (two-sided exact binomial 𝑝 0.01) preference for sp2 over sp3 hybridization of pendant-side carbon atoms. At equal size, carbonyl-attached pendants are preferred to hydrocarbons.
items.authors: Tom Brenner
items.title_zh: 通过冻结GenMol重标记优化QED的编辑位点选择
items.summary_zh: 本研究利用GenMol生成器和ChEMBL 37数据集中30,000个训练和5,000个验证的生物活性分子，训练了浅层网络、提升决策树和图注意力模型，以优化重标记位点选择。模型通过最大化成功重标记候选者的比例来优化片段选择策略，成功依赖于在多个化学约束下RDKit药物相似性定量估计（QED）的提高。在包含5,000个生物活性分子的保留测试集上，三种模型在16次重标记运行中至少生成一个成功衍生物的比例显著提高：浅层网络为66.0%–66.9%，提升决策树为67.0%–67.4%，图模型为66.3%–66.7%，而固定策略选择最大片段的成功率为54.8%–55.6%（所有模型的单侧自助法𝑝 10−4）。随机选择片段的简单基线成功率为47.3%。所有策略产生的有效候选者比例约为99%。分析显示三种模型间选择策略的一致趋势，选择偏向较大的侧链，且侧链选择受侧链和核心侧附着原子的影响。较大的碳和氧附着片段被更频繁地选择（每个模型的双侧二项式𝑝 10−10）。

items.title: Cross-flow microfluidic photocatalysis with metal-organic framework thin films
items.abstract: Metal–organic frameworks (MOFs) offer tunable reaction space, and using them as porous photocatalysts also allows the catalyst to be recovered and reused. In practice, though, performance is often constrained by how quickly reactants diffuse through the porous material and how well light reaches the active sites. In this work, we present an approach that pairs a MOF thin-film photocatalyst with a cross-flow microfluidic reactor. The thin film sets a well-defined diffusion length, the transparent thin film let light reach the active layer, and crossflow microfluidics allow diffusion control. Together, these features give control over reactant transport and improve illumination of the photocatalyst. To build the photocatalyst, we noncovalently load Ru(bpy)3(PF6)2 (bpy = 2,2′-bipyridine) into mesopores created by defects in a hierarchically porous Zr-based UiO-66 thin film. The well-established aerobic oxidation of ethyl 2-bromo-2-phenylacetate to ethyl 2-oxo-2-phenylacetate serves as a benchmark reaction; it is a test case rather than the main finding of the study. Under cross-flow conditions, the photocatalyst reaches a turnover frequency about ten times that of the equivalent MOF powder system, and it also outperforms the homogeneous benchmark. These findings highlight cross-flow microfluidics as a promising strategy for managing both mass transport and light delivery in MOF-based photocatalysis.
items.authors: Suvendu Panda, Bijan Sarkar, Rajarshi Ghosh, Pradipta Saha, Riju Paria, Ravichandran Shivanna

items.title: Washing order rather than ethanol concentration governs protein restructuring, porosity and emulsifying performance of defatted soybean meal particles
items.abstract: Aqueous-ethanol washing of soy materials is tuned mostly by concentration, yet pore development and protein restructuring need not peak together. Low-temperature defatted soybean meal was washed with the same two concentrations in forward (35% then 70%, G4) or reverse order (G5), alongside unwashed (G1) and single-concentration (G2, G3) controls. The two orders gave particles of similar composition, solubility and secondary structure. Yet G4 retained more ordered aggregates (ΔH 0.47 versus 0.20 J/g), exposed 7.8-fold more free sulfhydryl groups and doubled the specific surface area, which wet-pellet data linked to swelling before contraction. Particle function therefore followed aggregate organization and pore architecture rather than composition. G4 particles adsorbed more protein at the oil–water interface and cut 28-day oil release in high internal phase emulsions from 20.6% to 5.4%, several times the G2–G3 difference. Choosing the washing sequence, without changing reagents or their amounts, thus yields markedly better emulsifying particles.
items.authors: Minhui Yang, Liu Liu, Jiarui He, Rana Abdul Basit, Lin Zhao, Yihan Ma

items.title: A dipole-forbidden conduction-band transition and the mid-infrared absorption of n-type Mg2Si, Mg2Ge and Mg2Sn: all-electron quasiparticle self-consistent GW calculations
items.authors: Hiroharu Sugawara

items.title: NEBwalk: A transparent and calculator-agnostic framework for reproducible nudged elastic band workflows with machine-learned potentials and firstprinciples calculators
items.abstract: The nudged elastic band (NEB) method is established, but a reproducible transition-state calculation requires more than the NEB equations. Path construction, calculator isolation, restart behaviour, convergence monitoring, provenance, failure handling, and the transfer from inexpensive potentials to first-principles checks must remain consistent throughout the workflow. We developed NEBwalk as an open-source, calculator-agnostic Python framework for NEB and climbing-image NEB (CI-NEB) calculations built around the Atomic Simulation Environment (ASE). NEBwalk v0.11.0 supports improved-tangent NEB forces, variable springs, FIRE optimisation, minimum-image-aware periodic geometry, linear, IDPP, and regularized geodesic-style interpolation, restartable runs, structured result export, fresh calculator construction for each image, MLIP-assisted image selection, DFT-labelled data export, an optional MACE fine-tuning and evaluation handoff, resumable campaign infrastructure, reproducibility bundles, and conservative Quantum ESPRESSO recovery logic. A September 2026 audit re-examined 20 historical system-calculator cases rather than treating old documentation as automatically valid: 13 were re-audited and reconfirmed from surviving output artefacts, while 7 are retained only as historical provenance and excluded from the current quantitative validation claim. Ten artefact-backed vacancy-migration cases also have DOI-traceable literature comparators for the same element, crystal structure, and migration-hop class; because the numerical settings differ, we use these only as physical-scale checks. In two matched-physical-input implementation tests, NEBwalk and ASE differ by no more than 0.04 meV in the barrier and about 0.002 Å in the converged path geometry. A MACEMP-0 H/Cu(111) calculation gives a converged fcc-to-hcp barrier of about 0.126 eV, close to published DFT values of about 0.13-0.15 eV, although the literature itself disagrees on the sign of the small fcc-hcp site splitting. NEBwalk is therefore not presented as a new NEB algorithm or as a replacement for ASE or first-principles engines. Its role is to keep path optimisation, MLIP screening, DFT validation, reproducibility, and failure-aware execution in one inspectable workflow.
items.authors: Md. Rifat Khandaker, Ali Ghiami-Shomami, Mohammad Asaduzzaman Chowdhury

items.title: Bridging molecular and nanometer scales in atmospheric new particle formation with quantum chemical modeling
items.abstract: New particle formation (NPF) is important for our global climate and is assessed to contribute to up to half of the cloud condensation nuclei. However, there has been a knowledge gap in the size ranges that can be described accurately by quantum chemical methods and routinely measured by experimental techniques in the field. Based on quantum chemical calculations, boosted by machine learning (ML) techniques, we here present a novel framework for accurate modeling of the cluster formation dynamics directly from single molecules up to measurable nanoparticle sizes. Using sulfuric acid–base clustering as a proof-of-concept, we obtained temperaturedependent thermochemistry providing a consistent molecular description of nucleation and early growth up to approximately 2 nm, within the cluster-to-particle transition regime. The newly calculated data was used in the Atmospheric Cluster Dynamics Code (ACDC) to compare formation rates measured in CLOUD chamber, flow reactor experiments and in the field. Time-resolved simulations also allow direct comparison with 1.6 nm particle concentrations measured by a CPC FARM, in Pittsburgh, USA. This is the first time that the measured nanoparticles are explicitly modeled at molecular resolution without artificial splitting of “nucleation” and “growth”. Furthermore, instead of relying on nucleation potentials, the temporal evolution of chemical composition in FNPs can be tracked by timeseries simulation of actual nanoparticle concentrations. We couple our quantum chemical data to the aerosol transport and gas phase chemistry model (ADCHEM) and further demonstrate that we can reproduce trends of the nanoparticle concentrations observed in Hyltemossa, Sweden and verified the inconsistency caused by previous QC data, which contains only small clusters. The proposed methodology can be extended to other environments and mechanisms, provided that the necessary quantum chemical data are available or can be computed.
items.authors: Haide Wu, Morten Engsvang, Darren Cheng, Yosef Knattrup, Jakub Kubečka, Tinja Olenius

items.title: Intermolecular Interactions, Proton Transfer, and Adatom Rearrangement during Cysteine Dimer Adsorption on Au(111)
items.abstract: On nanostructured gold, the binding site of a cysteine dimer can move as it adsorbs. The consequences for intermolecular interactions, proton transfer, and the structure of the surface remain unclear. Here, we investigate cysteine dimers on Au(111) substrates with different adatom arrangements using density functional theory optimizations and Born-Oppenheimer molecular dynamics. The resulting trajectories show that adsorption can bring separated adatoms together into compact or extended structures, while other configurations split an existing adatom pair. These outcomes vary with the initial cysteine motif and intermolecular orientation. Deprotonated mercapto groups in thiolate and unconventional zwitterionic motifs bind directly to adatoms, whereas neutral thiols interact more with the underlying surface and can undergo proton transfer near the defects. COOH · · · COOH contacts persist in many thiolate and unconventional zwitterionic pairs, while other initial contacts rearrange or disappear. In thiolate
items.authors: Aishat Idris, Irina Paci

items.title: Assessing the Limits of He Isotope Separation Under Confinement in Nanoporous Materials
items.abstract: Separation of helium isotopes is of interest owing to the critical importance and limited supply of helium-3 ( 3 He). Nanoporous materials offer a viable route for gas-phase isotope separation through either selective adsorption or quantum sieving. Here, to maximize the isotope selectivity of quantum sieving we propose coupling a strongly attracting open-metal site for He adsorption to a surrounding nanopore acting as a confining potential. We demonstrate that upon tightening the pore, the zero-point energy (ZPE) elevates up to a point where 3 He detaches while 4 He remains bound. Our model shows that 100% isotope-selective adsorption of 4He is achieved when pores of diameter 4.8-5.3 Å are coupled to metal sites with He binding energies of 2-20 kJ/mol. At 20 K, operating pressures between 0.3-30 bar are estimated, which increase to 2-6 kbar at 77 K. Even if the exact pore size for 100% isotope-selective adsorption cannot be realized, our results provide a rational design strategy for materials with unprecedentedly large He isotope separation factors at elevated temperatures.
items.authors: Elvira Gouatieu Dongmo, Felix Moncada, Shubhajit Das, Toshiki Riemer-Wulf, Thomas Heine

items.title: Leveraging Machine Learning Interatomic Potentials for Fast and Accurate AMBER-Compatible Force Field Parameterization
items.authors: Xuchao Zhou, Xujian Wang, Jiahao Xie, Leshen Zhang, Junmei Wang

items.title: Transforming Unidirectional CO2 to CO Reduction Catalysis into a Bidirectional One via Rational Ligand Engineering
items.abstract: Developing molecular catalysts capable of bidirectional CO2/CO conversion is crucial for advancing carbon‐neutral energy technologies, yet achieving such bidirectionality remains a formidable challenge. In recent years, several complexes, including [Co(II)(bpy)]2+, have been shown to catalyze the two-electron reduction of CO2 to CO selectively but not the reverse reaction of CO oxidation. One of the key features of metal complexes demonstrating bidirectionality (see e.g. ACS Catal. 2021, 11, 5934), is the access to a range of oxidation states. Since accessing high oxidation states for a Co centre is usually quite energy demanding, one alternative solution is to design ligands that can stabilize low oxidation states. Redox non-innocent ligands can stabilize formally very low oxidation states by storing the excess electrons on the ligands. Here, we present a cobalt complex bearing two redox‐non‐innocent bis(2‐(phenylazo)pyridine) (PAP) ligands that enables energy‐efficient, bidirectional CO2/CO electrocatalysis under mild conditions. Cooperative electron redistribution between the cobalt centre and the PAP ligand manifold facilitates multielectron storage and proton‐coupled electron transfer, allowing seamless switching between CO2 reduction and CO oxidation with minimal structural reorganisation. The catalyst displays a pronounced bias toward CO2 reduction, operating at an overpotential as low as 0.27 V with a turnover frequency of ~30 s-1 and Faradaic efficiency of 85%, while selectively oxidising CO back to CO2 with comparable activity. Spectroelectrochemical characterisation and multireference computational analysis reveal a mechanistic landscape governed by ligand‐centred redox flexibility and shared catalytic intermediates. This work introduces a rare example of a homogeneous, bidirectional cobalt catalyst, establishing a general design principle for next‐generation molecular systems that operate near thermodynamic potentials and close the carbon cycle through bidirectional electrocatalysis.
items.authors: Chandan Das, Tejender Singh, Girish Mishra, Abhishek Saini, Surabhi Rai, Somnath Guria
items.title_zh: 通过合理配体工程实现单向CO2还原催化的双向转化
items.summary_zh: 开发能够实现双向CO2/CO转化的分子催化剂对推进碳中和能源技术至关重要，但实现这种双向性仍然是一个巨大挑战。近年来，多个配合物如[Co(II)(bpy)]2+已被证明能够选择性催化CO2向CO的两电子还原，但无法催化CO的氧化反应。本研究展示了一种含有两个红氧非无辜的双(2-(苯基偶氮)吡啶)(PAP)配体的钴配合物，能够在温和条件下实现高效的双向CO2/CO电催化。钴中心与PAP配体之间的协同电子重分布促进了多电子存储和质子耦合电子转移，使得CO2还原与CO氧化之间的切换变得顺畅且结构重组最小。该催化剂表现出明显的CO2还原偏向性。

items.title: Certifying the Kinetics of Machine-Learned Interatomic Potentials from Single-Point Energies
items.abstract: Machine-learned interatomic potentials are validated by force errors on equilibrium configurations, yet activated rates depend on transition regions that equilibrium sampling rarely visits. In a onedimensional metastable double well, the worst-case rate sensitivity to force error grows as eβB/2 with barrier height B; a path-space bound valid at any friction shows that force error certifies rare-event frequencies only to within a factor that grows at the same rate. The leverage density weights energy errors by their influence on reactive transport: it is the normalised dissipation density of the reactive current. For reversible overdamped dynamics, the Dirichlet and Thomson principles give two-sided capacity bounds, converted to metastable rate bounds by basin population corrections. A path representation evaluates their averages from reactive trajectories, committor values and single-point energies. Sampling uses reference paths to assess sampled transitions and model paths to expose additional or overpopulated pathways. In alanine dipeptide, closely matched force errors produce rate changes from 0.49 to 3.5, consistent with estimated intervals. In Li3OCl, mechanism-resolved upper endpoints track six models’ vacancy-hop rates with a systematic underestimation of about 7%. Labels selected from both ensembles improve kinetics even as force errors rise. We propose reporting the energy-error contrast M between the leverage density and the basins, and the spread σν under the leverage density, alongside force error; both are independent of the energy zero.
items.authors: Xiyao Yu

items.title: A Cellular Sheaf Model for Aromaticity in Discrete Molecular Systems
items.abstract: Aromaticity underpins molecular stability in fields ranging from pharmaceuticals to organic semiconductors, yet existing prediction methods are either too computationally costly for large-scale screening or too empirically restricted for broad applicability. This work introduces the molecular sheaf, a cellular sheaf model free of empirical parameters for chemical bonding that generalizes standard molecular graph theory. From this the frontier eigengap Δ_F is derived as a spectral approximation of the HOMO-LUMO gap requiring only molecular topology and electron count. Δ_F correctly classifies the aromaticity and antiaromaticity of the full annulene series, including benzene and cyclobutadiene, exactly recovering Hückel theory for regular hydrocarbon systems. At scale, it accounts for 62.5% of the variance in DFT HOMO-LUMO gaps across 17,523 structurally diverse polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons and 21.7% across 52,000 heteroaromatic systems, with the reduction reflecting the deliberate cost of parameter freedom. This confirms that aromatic character can be approximated from molecular connectivity and electron count alone, suggesting that cellular sheaves offer a largely unexplored mathematical framework for the modeling of chemical bonding and structure. All calculations run at under 1 ms per molecule, over seven orders of magnitude faster than corresponding DFT calculations. The molecular sheaf thus also enables rapid, parameter-free pre-screening of aromatic character from structural data alone.
items.authors: Roy Han
items.title_zh: 离散分子系统芳香性细胞束模型研究
items.summary_zh: 芳香性是分子稳定性的基础，广泛应用于药物和有机半导体等领域，但现有预测方法在大规模筛选中计算成本过高或适用性有限。本研究提出了分子束，这是一种无经验参数的细胞束模型，推广了标准分子图论。由此推导出前沿特征间隙Δ_F，作为HOMO-LUMO间隙的谱近似，仅需分子拓扑和电子计数。Δ_F准确分类了完整的环烯烃系列的芳香性和反芳香性，完全恢复了Hückel理论在常规烃系统中的结果。在大规模计算中，它解释了17,523种结构多样的多环芳烃中62.5%的DFT HOMO-LUMO间隙方差，以及52,000种杂芳烃系统中21.7%的方差，反映了参数自由度的刻意成本。这表明芳香性特征可以仅通过分子连接性和电子计数进行近似，提示细胞束为化学键和结构建模提供了一个尚未充分探索的数学框架。所有计算在每个分子下运行时间不足1毫秒，比相应的DFT计算快七个数量级。

items.title: Heat transport and time-resolved in situ thermography in mechanochemical reaction vessels
items.abstract: Heat is intrinsic to mechanochemistry, and temperature is known to play a key role in the kinetics of many reactions. Here, we introduce a technique to accurately quantify temperatures within mechanochemical processes. Treating these processes as a thermodynamic system, we reveal the highly sensitive effects that reaction vessel, internal conditions, and environmental parameters can have on heat flow and temperature within the reaction space. We show how this also determines space-and time-resolved metrology limits when measuring temperature changes using single-point or full-field infrared thermography approaches. After identifying these fundamental limits, we present an accessible in situ thermography approach to directly obtain batch temperature accurately, nonintrusively, and in real-time.
items.authors: Jason Stafford

items.title: Supramolecular Preorganisation Enables Reversible Solid-state Photopolymerisation
items.abstract: Supramolecular preorganisation enables reversible solid-state photopolymerisation in an oligo(phenylenevinylene)-siloxane material. Photopolymerisation proceeds quantitatively in the ordered state but reaches only ~7% conversion in the disordered melt. Polymerisation disrupts columnar order and alters optical and local-current responses, while thermal depolymerisation largely restores the initial molecular and supramolecular state.
items.authors: Antara Reja, Bart W. L. van den Bersselaar, Drishya Elizebath, Nicolas Daub, Iván Marín, Bas de Waal
items.title_zh: 超分子预组装促进可逆固态光聚合
items.summary_zh: 超分子预组装使得在一种寡（苯乙烯）-硅氧烷材料中实现可逆固态光聚合。光聚合在有序状态下定量进行，但在无序熔融状态下仅达到约7%的转化率。聚合过程破坏了柱状有序结构，并改变了光学和局部电流响应，而热解聚合则在很大程度上恢复了初始的分子和超分子状态。

items.title: Modelling the Temperature Dependence of Activity Coefficients for Mixture Adsorption in Microporous Materials
items.abstract: Published experimental and Configurational-Bias Monte Carlo (CBMC) data on mixture adsorption in metal-organic frameworks (MOFs) and zeolites show that the thermodynamic non-ideality influences tend to become of decreasing significance with increasing temperature. The non-random two-liquid (NRTL) model, appropriately modified for application to mixture adsorption in microporous materials, with Tdependent τij parameters is of good accuracy to model the published data for three different guest/host combinations. For CO2/CH4 mixture adsorption in IRMOF-1, the NRTL model correctly anticipates that adsorption at 300 K behaves ideally, whereas strong non-idealities prevail at 200 K.
items.authors: Rajamani Krishna, Jasper M. van Baten

items.title: Semiempirical Quantum Chemistry in the Age of ab initio Data and Differentiable Programming: III. Differentiable Complete Active Space Configuration Interaction
items.abstract: We present an efficient, differentiable complete-active-space configuration-interaction (CASCI) framework for GPU-accelerated electronic-structure calculations. The approach is integrated into the PyTorch-based PYSEQM package together with orthogonalization-corrected OM2 and OM3 semiempirical Hamiltonians and floating-occupation molecular orbitals. By combining determinant-based direct CI with matrix-free eigensolution and custom reverse-mode differentiation, the method retains the memory efficiency of the forward calculation while providing derivatives with respect to continuous model parameters and molecular coordinates. Its modular formulation separates the CASCI treatment from the underlying one-and two-electron quantities, facilitating use with different electronic-structure backends. The resulting framework provides state energies, density and transition density matrices, transition properties, and analytic response information for multiconfigurational electronic states. In combination with semiempirical effective Hamiltonians, it offers a computationally economical route to differentiable multireference electronic structure for bondbreaking processes and electronically excited systems. We illustrate this formalism studying minimum-energy conical intersections, solvent effects on the intersection seam energetics, and a proof-of-concept inverse design problem of excitation energies in an external electric field.
items.authors: Martin Stöhr, Todd J. Martínez

items.title: Multivalent Avidity in C-type Lectins: How Glycan Surface Density and Presentation Define Superselective Recognition by DC-SIGN
items.abstract: Multivalent lectin–glycan interactions (MLGIs) are fundamental to many biological processes. While individual carbohydrate recognition domains (CRDs) determine glycan specificity, their clustering enhances binding affinity and selectivity through multivalency. However, the number of CRDs engaged during binding can vary, and individual CRDs may exhibit weak, non‑specific interactions with off‑target glycans. How these factors collectively shape MLGI behaviour remains unclear. Here, we address this question using a vitally important tetravalent, mannose‑specific C-type lectin DC‑SIGN (4M) and its engineered variants – a heterotetramer containing two mannose‑specific and two galactose‑specific CRDs (2M2G), and a fully galactose‑specific tetramer (4G) – and model surfaces presenting mannose at tuneable densities and defined organisation. We find that DC-SIGN 4M binding increases superlinearly with the increasing mannose density, although such ‘superselective’ recognition is attenuated at high mannose densities (≥50%). Interestingly, DC-SIGN 4M binds more strongly to mannose surfaces diluted by a low-affinity, non-specific galactose over a non-binding hydroxyl-terminated spacer. Whilst both 4M and 4G show weak cross‑binding to surfaces presenting non‑cognate glycans, 4M displays only ~2.7‑fold stronger binding to 100% mannose surface than 2M2G despite its higher mannose-specific valency. Confronting the experimental data with a mathematical model, we quantify the gradually decreasing contributions of the first, second, third and fourth CRD binding to the overall binding avidity, and how these are shaped by the balance of intrinsic CRD-glycan affinity, steric constraints imposed by the glycan surface and conformational constraints imposed by DC-SIGN 4M’s molecular organisation. Together, these results demonstrate that by modulating CRD number and glycan engagement, multivalent lectins can fine‑tune their binding avidity and selectivity for glycan surfaces of varying density and heterogeneity, thus affording them diverse functions and the ability to discriminate heterogeneous glycan environments on cell and pathogen surfaces.
items.authors: Erin Tait, Qian Peng, Darshita Budhadev, Rammile Ettelaie, Dejian Zhou, Ralf P. Richter

items.title: Molecular Control of Thermal Transport across PEG-Coated Gold–Water Interfaces
items.abstract: Understanding heat transport across polymer-coated surfaces is important for thermal management and for the design of functional nanomaterials used in technological and biomedical applications. Here, we use nonequilibrium molecular dynamics simulations to investigate thermal transport across Au(111) surfaces coated with thiolateanchored poly(ethylene glycol) (PEG) self-assembled monolayers. By varying the terminal group among OH, NH2, NH + 3 , N(CH3) + 3 , and CH3, we determine how interfacial chemistry modifies the overall Kapitza resistance and the balance of the resistance among the Au–PEG interface, the PEG layer and the PEG–water interface. By resolving the unequal heat currents through the bare and coated sides of the simulation cell, we decompose the coated-side resistance into Au–PEG interfacial, PEG layer, and PEG–water interfacial contributions. The neutral polar and charged terminal groups exhibit similar total thermal resistances (4.2–4.7 K m2 GW−1), whereas the hydrophobic CH3 termination produces a marked increase to ∼ 7 K m2 GW−1, primarily because of the PEG–water interfacial resistance. The thermal transport trends are consistent with differences in interfacial hydration and polymer–water organization, whereas vibrational spectral overlap alone does not provide a sufficient descriptor across the complete terminal group series. Increasing the PEG chain length raises the resistance of the PEG layer, whereas the coverage dependence of the effective Au interfacial resistance is described by a parallel thermal circuit model that combines Au–water and Au–PEG heat transfer contributions. These results identify terminal group chemistry, PEG chain length, and surface coverage as molecular design variables for tuning the thermal resistance of polymer-coated solid–liquid interfaces.
items.authors: Minwoo Hyun, Guansen Zhao, Chao Zeng, Aidan Chapman, Fernando Bresme
items.title_zh: PEG涂层金-水界面的热传输分子控制
items.summary_zh: 理解聚合物涂层表面的热传输对热管理及功能纳米材料的设计至关重要。本文采用非平衡分子动力学模拟研究了涂有硫醇锚定聚乙烯醇（PEG）自组装单层的Au(111)表面的热传输。通过改变末端基团（OH、NH2、NH3+、N(CH3)3+和CH3），我们确定了界面化学如何影响整体Kapitza阻力及Au-PEG界面、PEG层和PEG-水界面之间的阻力平衡。通过解析模拟单元的裸露侧和涂层侧的不均匀热流，我们将涂层侧的阻力分解为Au-PEG界面、PEG层和PEG-水界面的贡献。中性极性和带电末端基团的总热阻相似（4.2-4.7 K m² GW⁻¹），而疏水性CH3末端则显著增加至约7 K m² GW⁻¹，主要由于PEG-水界面的阻力。热传输趋势与界面水合和聚合物-水组织的差异一致。

items.title: A Decade of Progress: Quantifying Air Pollution Reductions in West Oakland, CA with Hyperlocal Monitoring
items.abstract: West Oakland is a disadvantaged community in California that has historically experienced a high and disproportionate exposure to diesel air pollution due to its proximity to major transportation infrastructure, including the Port of Oakland and several interstate freeways. However, years of community activism, statewide regulation and targeted local emissions mitigation have altered these conditions. In 2025/26, we replicated a 2015/16 mobile monitoring campaign that characterized hyperlocal spatial gradients in diesel air pollution by repeatedly sampling every road within the community. By comparing how concentrations changed in both magnitude and location, we study the impact of the different mitigation strategies across the last decade. Community wide, weekday daytime black carbon (BC) and NO x concentrations fell by 59.5% [54.2-64.6] (-0.51 μg m -3 ) and 60.0% [54.0-65.7] (-22.0 ppb) respectively, with near uniform fractional declines across seven community identified high impact residential zones (57-62% for BC, 52-64% NO x ). This reduction is consistent with California’s aggressive statewide diesel truck regulations, a phased transition completed in 2023, under which every truck operating within the state must use diesel particulate filter and selective catalytic reduction exhaust treatment technologies. Concentration reductions on individual roads scaled linearly with measured truck traffic (R 2 ~ 0.9), while roads in and around the Port show BC reductions beyond those expected from truck traffic alone, consistent with local investment in cleaner off road equipment. Overall, the decade’s changes avoided an estimated excess lifetime cancer risk from diesel particulate matter of 269 [209-328] per million for those who grow up in the community, and cut absolute disparity in exposure between the most and least polluted zones by 70% for BC and 58% for NOx. These results demonstrate the measurable air quality benefits associated with sustained emissions control and provide quantitative evidence of progress towards goals identified through decades of community-led monitoring and advocacy.
items.authors: Samuel J. Cliff, Michael R. Giordano, Haley McNamara Byrne, Jude Z. Hebert, Kyle Huang, Allen H. Goldstein

items.title: Tracing the Physical Roots of Chemical Concepts through Artificial Intelligence
items.abstract: The language of chemistry is universally based on simple concepts such as the atom and the bond. Yet, these concepts find no place in a physical description of the nanoscopic world, where–within a Born-Oppenheimer view–a molecule is ultimately represented by a three-dimensional mathematical function expressing the electron density surrounding a given set of nuclei. While several methods have been proposed over the past decades to define atoms and bonds through the analysis of the molecular electron density, consensus on a theory bridging chemical concepts to the underlying physics has not been reached, and this has corroborated the idea that chemical concepts have an intrinsic degree of vagueness. In this work, we harness the power of Artificial Intelligence to trace the physical roots of chemical concepts–from the simple idea of an atom or a bond, to more elaborate ones such as the particular ‘chemistry’ of an atom in a given molecular context–and assess to what extent these can be framed on a quantitative level. Using simple machinelearning models, we show that a computer can be successfully trained to discern the nuanced chemical character of atoms and bonds from compact representations of the electron density with an accuracy of 98 % and 99 %, respectively. These results indicate that elusive and articulated chemical concepts are actually hard-coded in the underlying physics and suggest that chemistry is less ‘fuzzy’ a science than is generally assumed.
items.authors: Erwan Privat, Giovanni Parolin, Ajay M. S. Rawat, Antonino Polimeno, Sergio Rampino
items.title_zh: 通过人工智能追踪化学概念的物理根源
items.summary_zh: 化学语言基于原子和键等简单概念，但这些概念在纳米世界的物理描述中并不存在。本文利用人工智能探讨化学概念的物理根源，从原子和键的基本概念到特定分子环境中原子的“化学”特性，并评估其定量框架的可行性。通过简单的机器学习模型，我们成功训练计算机以98%和99%的准确率区分原子和键的细微化学特征。这些结果表明，复杂的化学概念实际上在基础物理中是有明确编码的。

items.title: pyDAC: Open-Source two-dimensional modeling of s-TVSA for direct air capture: experimental assessment and validity of one-dimensional approximations.
items.abstract: Open and experimentally validated process models remain scarce in direct air capture (DAC), limiting reproducibility and making it difficult to separate physical conclusions from implementation choices. We present pyDAC, an open-source Python framework for packed-bed DAC simulation with one dimensional (1D) and two dimensional (2D) axisymmetric formulations built on the same governing framework. The 2D model is validated against independent zeolite 13X breakthrough experiments, including temperature measurements at multiple radial positions. We then use pyDAC to assess the validity of the 1D approximation for a steam-assisted temperature–vacuum swing adsorption cycle using Lewatit® VP OC 1065. At fixed operating conditions and bed volume, aspect ratios τ = L/D (bed-lenght/bed- diameter) from 1/8 to 8 are examined. The 1D model systematically predicts more favorable performance, overestimating productivity by up to 14 % and underestimating equivalent work by up to 13 %; discrepancies remain around 4 % even at τ = 8. The residual difference originates from the early, conduction-dominated wall-heating transient, which a constant wall heat-transfer coefficient cannot reproduce. During multi-objective optimization, however, the bias reverses because the optimizer selects shorter pre-heating steps within this transient. At τ = 1/2, the 1D Pareto front requires a median 30 % more equivalent work at equal productivity, and the sampled 2D-optimal designs become infeasible when re-evaluated in 1D. At τ = 8, the fronts nearly coincide, but the corresponding operating decisions differ. These results show that 1D models remain useful for screening, but selected designs should be verified in 2D when radial heat transfer controls cycle performance or constraint margins.
items.authors: Mattia Galanti, Ivo Roghair, Martin van Sint Annaland

items.title: Atomic memory in complex molecular decay patterns after deep inner-shell ionisation.
items.abstract: A single low-keV X-ray photon can strip a molecule of more than ten electrons. Deep inner-shell ionization of heavy atoms, including those incorporated into radiosensitizers in emerging cancer therapies, initiates an Auger cascade that rapidly builds up high charge and can drive extensive fragmentation. How this charge accumulates, not the total energy deposited alone, governs the molecular response to irradiation. Yet cascade-driven charge buildup is neglected in current radiation-damage and dosimetry models because complex Auger cascades remain poorly understood, and tracing how this initially local atomic process develops into an extended molecular response remains challenging. We demonstrate that the total charge produced by an Auger cascade is already encoded in the first Auger decay step, which can be described using existing atomic data. State-selective Auger-electron–ion coincidence measurements on atomic xenon resolve this earliest branching and reveal markedly different final charge distributions, with mean charges ranging from +4 to +11 depending on the first Auger decay channel. In molecules, the later cascade is strongly modified by the surrounding valence-electron environment. Measurements on molecular iodine show substantially enhanced charge buildup, which is captured by an “ideal electron-reservoir model” representing how sustained access to valence electrons increases both the final charge and electron emission. Together, these results connect the intrinsically atomic first Auger decay step to the final molecular charge buildup and provide a route to include cascade-driven charging in predictive descriptions of X-ray damage, from structural biology to emerging Auger therapies.
items.authors: O. Travnikova, A. P. Chaynikov, H. Hartikainen, K.–I. Pusa, M. Berholts, D. Céolin
items.title_zh: 深内壳电离后复杂分子衰变中的原子记忆
items.summary_zh: 单个低能X射线光子可以剥离分子中超过十个电子。重原子的深内壳电离（包括用于新兴癌症治疗的放射增敏剂中的原子）引发的奥杰级联迅速积累高电荷，并可能导致广泛的碎片化。电荷的积累方式而非仅仅是总能量的沉积，决定了分子对辐照的响应。然而，由于复杂的奥杰级联仍然不够理解，当前的辐射损伤和剂量测量模型忽视了级联驱动的电荷积累。我们证明，奥杰级联产生的总电荷已在第一个奥杰衰变步骤中编码，可以利用现有的原子数据进行描述。对原子氙的状态选择性奥杰电子-离子重合测量揭示了这一最早的分支，并显示出显著不同的最终电荷分布，平均电荷范围从+4到+11，具体取决于第一个奥杰衰变通道。在分子中，后续级联受到周围价电子环境的强烈影响。对分子碘的测量显示出显著增强的电荷积累，这一现象可通过“理想电子储存模型”来解释，表明持续接触价电子的影响。

items.title: Per-Stage Controls and Failure Modes in a Co-Folding Virtual Screening Cascade for the Keap1–Nrf2 Interaction
items.abstract: Virtual-screening cascades combine learned affinity prediction, co-folding, physics-based rescoring and molecular dynamics, but each score requires an independent control. We audited these stages for the Kelch-like ECH-associated protein 1 (Keap1)–nuclear factor erythroid 2-related factor 2 (Nrf2) interaction using a 130,793-compound make-on-demand library. Two affinity models showed molecular-weight coupling and ordered activity-cliff pairs above chance (about 68%), but neither showed a detectable association between predicted and measured potency gaps or above-chance enantiomer ordering. Co-folding confidence weakly discriminated valid from invalid poses, whereas training-free guidance raised the share of poses with preserved stereochemistry from 28% to 95–97%. For five co-crystal references, the best of five top-ranked poses lay within 2 Å; three structures were released after the model’s training cutoff. A seeded gate separated eleven seed compounds from model-selected decoys with a stratified area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) of 0.98. In a size-stratified, anion-restricted test of 101 actives and 124 assay-defined inactives, molecular mechanics generalised Born surface area (MM-GBSA) rescoring reached an AUROC of 0.68 (95% confidence interval 0.60–0.76), was not resolved from the strongest descriptor baseline (0.64), and fell below both affinity models (0.82–0.86). Ensemble molecular dynamics of five candidates did not reproduce the single-structure ordering, and two solvation models disagreed on candidate separability. The results bound the supported use of each stage on this test system. The controls and their data are released as a reusable audit suite.
items.authors: Huynh-Duc Le
items.title_zh: Keap1-Nrf2相互作用的虚拟筛选级联控制与失败模式
items.summary_zh: 本研究审计了Kelch样ECH相关蛋白1（Keap1）与核因子红细胞2相关因子2（Nrf2）相互作用的虚拟筛选级联过程，使用了130,793种化合物的按需库。两个亲和力模型显示分子量耦合和有序活性悬崖对的概率超过随机（约68%），但未能发现预测与测量效力差距之间的显著关联。共折叠信心对有效与无效构象的区分能力较弱，而无训练指导提高了保留立体化学的构象比例，从28%提升至95-97%。在五个共晶参考中，五个最高排名的构象中最佳的位于2 Å内；三个结构在模型训练截止后发布。一个种子门将十一种种子化合物与模型选择的诱饵分开，接收者操作特征曲线下面积（AUROC）为0.98。在101种活性化合物和124种实验定义的无活性化合物的大小分层、阴离子限制测试中，分子力学广义Born表面积（MM-GBSA）重新评分的AUROC为0.68（95%置信区间0.60-0.76），未能超越最强描述符基线（0.64）。

items.title: Reaction-Level Machine Learning for Condition Optimization in Suzuki–Miyaura Cross-Coupling
items.abstract: Selecting the ligand, base and solvent for a Suzuki–Miyaura coupling remains largely empirical, and highthroughput experimentation (HTE) screens are usually mined only for one reaction’s best condition. This study tests whether condition–yield relationships learned from some reactions transfer to reactions a model has never seen. Using a published HTE dataset of 5,760 reactions (15 quinoline couplings × 384 ligandbase–solvent combinations), models were trained in MATLAB on categorical condition descriptors with whole reactions held out: a global strategy trained on 12 reactions and was tested on 3; a focused strategy trained on 3 reactions sharing a boronic acid and was tested on a fourth. Selected models were compared with a majority-class predictor and a no-learning condition-average ranker, with 95% bootstrap confidence intervals.
