Ranking transferred: high-yield (≥62%) precision–recall AUC was 0.21–0.34 where only 6–8% of conditions were high-yield and 0.92–0.96 where most were, above the base rate on every held-out reaction. However, the condition-average ranker matched the trained models within overlapping confidence intervals on all four held-out reactions, so what transfers is mainly the persistence of good-on-average conditions. At a fixed 62% cut-off, a RUSBoosted ensemble flagged 58–96% of high-yield conditions against 6–27% for the untuned average. Accuracy misled: naive Bayes scored 94.8% where always predicting low yield scores 94.3%. Exact yields did not transfer (external R2 at or below zero on most reactions), and focusing the training set left ranking unchanged (PR-AUC 0.943 vs 0.942). Reaction-level splits, minority-class metrics and a condition-average baseline should be standard when evaluating models on HTE data.
items.authors: Pranav Manne

items.title: Intermediate Precision of Single-Molecule Break-Junction Conductance: Measurement, Uncertainty Budget, and Design Rules
items.abstract: A break-junction experiment records thousands of single-molecule junctions in one session and reports a feature of their conductance histogram as the molecule’s conductance, with an uncertainty from resampling the traces. That is a withinsession sampling figure; how far the value moves between sessions is not measured or budgeted. We measure it in ISO 5725 and GUM form on archived STM-BJ recordings of DNA:RNA hybrid duplexes with repeat sessions at identical settings. On seven single-duplex groups, each two sessions from different recording rounds or dates, the intermediate-precision standard deviation of a session’s median is a factor of 1.46 (95% interval 1.28 to 2.15). Read in recording order, the median also wanders within a session with a correlation length near a hundred traces, so resampling understates the within-session uncertainty about threefold; counted consistently, the between-session term holds 74% of a single-session variance budget, and on records of this length it cannot be separated from slow drift. Five candidate remedies, tested under pre-registration, do not remove it. The expanded uncertainty of a single-session value, a lower bound that excludes calibration terms, is a factor of 2.4; spreading a fixed number of traces over more sessions reduces it, and a design rule gives the sessions a comparison needs. Public deposits from a second laboratory show a between-occasion component and the same within-session dependence. The figures are specific to the system; the method is not.
items.authors: Viraaj Minhas
items.title_zh: 单分子断裂接头导电性的中间精度研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究通过断裂接头实验记录了成千上万个单分子接头，并将其导电性直方图的特征作为分子的导电性，伴随有重采样带来的不确定性。我们在ISO 5725和GUM框架下，对DNA:RNA杂交双链的存档STM-BJ记录进行了测量，重复实验在相同设置下进行。对七组单链双体的分析显示，单次实验中中位数的中间精度标准差为1.46（95%区间为1.28至2.15）。在实验中，中位数在会话内也会波动，相关长度接近一百条记录，因此重采样低估了会话内的不确定性约三倍；在一致计数下，会话间的贡献占单次实验方差预算的74%。五种候选补救措施在预注册下测试未能消除该问题。单次实验值的扩展不确定性为2.4，固定数量的记录分布在更多会话中可降低此值，并提出了设计规则以满足会话间的比较需求。

items.title: Metasurface information processor based on 4D bionic hardware and software for ultralow energy consumption computing
items.abstract: As AI technology faces an energy crisis, one promising solution is bionic ultra-low energy computing hardware, which can operate at a power level as low as sub-20-watt based on the 4D model of Ca 2+ channels recently verified in brain information processing. Inspired by this model, here we design and fabricate a 4D bionic computing system based on information metasurface array with the powerful capability of electromagnetic controls. Paired with specific algorithms, each metasurface cell functions as a multifunctional unit, capable of storing, regulating, transmitting, and computing information simultaneously. The metasurface array also has high energy efficiency and precision required for high-performance bionic computing. Integrated with the DNA computing, this system is expected to achieve a variety of functions including DNA replication, DNA logical computation, and DNA produce/readout. We aim to pave the way for a new paradigm in advanced computational materials that meet the evolving demands of AI and robotics.
items.authors: Qian Ma, Xiangyu Kong, Zirui Feng, Bo Song, Tie Jun Cui, Lei Jiang

items.title: Radical Cross-Coupling Delivers Complete Sets of Saturated-Heterocyclic Regio- and Stereoprobes for Chemoproteomic Discovery
items.abstract: Three-dimensional molecular shape is a fundamental determinant of protein recognition, yet chemical discovery is often biased toward regio- and stereoisomers that are more readily accessible by synthesis. Here we overcome this constraint using radical cross-coupling (RCC), converting stereoprobe synthesis from selective sampling into exhaustive exploration of three-dimensional chemical space. By combining stereorandomizing and stereopreserving RCC manifolds, we constructed complete piperidine and pyrrolidine matrices (40 and 24 members, respectively) encompassing every theoretically possible regio- and stereoisomer of the corresponding disubstituted scaffolds and expanded these collections to 108 covalent stereoprobes from a small set of readily available precursors. Proteome-wide activity-based protein profiling (ABPP) revealed highly differentiated engagement across regio- and stereoisomers that could further be diversified by changing the covalent reactive group. Selected engagements were structurally characterized by X-ray crystallography, and extension to complementary protein-directed ABPP further expanded the observable ligandability landscape. These findings establish RCC as a practical strategy for removing synthetic bias from stereochemical exploration and identified stereoselective small molecule-protein engagements that could have been missed by conventional non-exhaustive screening.
items.authors: Yin Li, Jiayan He, Jeffery J. Yu, Jiawei Sun, Rajan R. Gollapudi, Christopher A. Toth

items.title: Lewis-acid mediated borodegermylation grants access to donorand acceptor-substituted azaboraspirobifluorenes
items.abstract: Boron-centered spiro compounds represent a prominent platform for the design of optoelectronic materials. The orthogonally arranged π-conjugated systems around boron enhance stability toward air and moisture, facilitate processing, and allow electronic tuning through donor and acceptor substitution. Synthetic methods reported to date for the preparation of these compounds suffer from low efficiency and poor functional group tolerance, limiting the diversity of accessible electronic materials with tailored properties. Herein, we present a synthetic method leveraging the “Goldilocks” reactivity of germoles among Group 14 analogues to achieve a highly efficient and versatile AlCl3-catalyzed borodegermylation reaction, granting access to donor- and acceptor-functionalized azaboraspirobifluorenes. Furtheremore, the reaction efficiency can be enhanced by employing the sublimed catalyst and the use of an additive. Owing to their high stability, comparatively low toxicity and non-pyrophoric nature, the use of organogermanium compounds provides a more robust and safer alternative to methods that rely on other organometallic reagents.
items.authors: Jan Niedens, Kevin M. Wiegand, Vladyslav Garkusha, Jasmin Hofmann, Daniel Volland, Kevin Reinfurt
items.title_zh: 路易斯酸介导的硼去锗化反应合成取代的氮硼螺双荧光烃
items.summary_zh: 以硼为中心的螺旋化合物是设计光电材料的重要平台。围绕硼的正交排列的π-共轭系统增强了其对空气和湿气的稳定性，促进了加工，并通过供体和受体取代实现电子调节。目前已报道的合成方法效率低且对功能团的耐受性差，限制了可获得的具有定制特性的电子材料的多样性。本文提出了一种利用14族类化合物中锗烯的“适中”反应性，进行高效且多功能的AlCl3催化硼去锗化反应的方法，从而合成供体和受体功能化的氮硼螺双荧光烃。此外，通过使用升华催化剂和添加剂，可以提高反应效率。由于其高稳定性、相对低毒性和非自燃特性，使用有机锗化合物为依赖其他有机金属试剂的方法提供了更稳健和安全的替代方案。

items.title: Leveraging Microenvironment Effects to Enhance Bifunctional Metal–Organic Framework-Catalyzed Aldol Reactions
items.abstract: Solvent effects are known to shift the position of chemical equilibria, alter reaction rates, and dictate the outcome of chemical transformations. Here, we show that tuning the pore surface chemistry of metal–organic framework (MOF) catalysts can mimic desirable solvent effects, more than doubling catalytic activity. First, we demonstrate that templated MOFs featuring bifunctional secondary amine–carboxylic acid pairs are effective catalysts for aldol reactions but exhibit high sensitivity to solvent polarity. Catalytic activity decreases dramatically upon increasing solvent polarity, likely due to the stabilization of off-cycle charged iminium intermediates. We show that high activity can be partially recovered by incorporating nonpolar n-hexyl chains into the framework backbone that destabilize charged species. Overall, this work highlights how precise control over the local pore environment can be a powerful tool for improving catalyst performance.
items.authors: Devin S. Rollins, Kamaya Ronning, Amy E. Nam, Fubin Song, Phuong H. Le, Dianne J. Xiao
items.title_zh: 利用微环境效应提升双功能金属有机框架催化的醇缩反应
items.summary_zh: 溶剂效应已知会改变化学平衡位置、反应速率，并决定化学转化的结果。本研究表明，通过调节金属有机框架（MOF）催化剂的孔表面化学，可以模拟理想的溶剂效应，从而使催化活性提高超过两倍。我们首先展示了具有双功能次胺-羧酸对的模板化MOF在醇缩反应中作为有效催化剂，但对溶剂极性高度敏感。随着溶剂极性的增加，催化活性显著下降，可能是由于带电的亚胺中间体的稳定化。我们发现，通过在框架主链中引入非极性的n-己基链，可以部分恢复高活性，从而破坏带电物种的稳定性。总体而言，本研究强调了对局部孔环境的精确控制如何成为提升催化剂性能的强大工具。

items.title: Regioisomeric Engineering for Triplet Harvesting through Triplet–Triplet Annihilation
items.abstract: Three regioisomeric donor–acceptor–donor luminophores, 1DBF, 2DBF, and 3DBF, based on phenanthrene-9,10-dicarbonitrile (PHCN) acceptor and dibenzofuran (DBF) units, are designed to investigate regioisomer-dependent triplet exciton harvesting. The three emitters exhibit strong blue fluorescence in solution, with photoluminescence quantum yields of 63–87%, and show delayed fluorescence (DF) in both solution and solid states. Low temperature time-gated measurements, large singlet–triplet energy gaps, and concentration-dependent studies collectively support DF from triplet–triplet annihilation (TTA) mechanism rather than thermally activated delayed fluorescence (TADF). Notably, the substitution pattern strongly influences the excited state dynamics and triplet harvesting efficiency. Among the three regioisomers, 2DBF exhibits the most efficient TTA-derived DF, owing to favorable donoracceptor electronic coupling and a balanced contribution of 3 LE and 3 CT states, whereas the weaker coupling in 1DBF favors predominantly 3 LE character, resulting in stronger phosphorescence and less efficient triplet harvesting through TTA. These results demonstrate that regioisomeric engineering can effectively modulate donor–acceptor electronic coupling and triplet state character, providing a useful molecular strategy for tuning the balance between DF and phosphorescence in organic emitters.
items.authors: Madhusudan Dutta, Partha Hazra

items.title: An Affordable Shifted-Excitation Raman Difference Spectroscopy (SERDS) Setup: Construction, Noise Analysis, and Detection Limits
items.abstract: Shifted-excitation Raman difference spectroscopy (SERDS) is an effective method for suppressing fluorescence backgrounds in Raman spectroscopy but often requires expensive instrumentation for the generation of two excitation beams. In this work, we constructed an affordable SERDS instrument using an inexpensive laser pointer together with standard optical components. A diffraction grating and two mechanical slits were used to generate two excitation beams with linewidths below 0.25 nm from the laser pointer. Cyclohexane was first used as a benchmark molecule for data acquisition and analysis processes. The instrument performance was then examined using ethanol samples containing different concentrations of methylene blue (MB), where SERDS spectra were compared with asymmetric least-squares (ALS) baseline corrected spectra. For ethanol contaminated with 1×10-8 M MB, the SERDS spectrum achieved a signal-to-noise ratio (S/N) of 53 at a fluorescence/Raman ratio (FL/Raman) of 18:1, whereas the corresponding ALS baseline-corrected spectrum had a S/N of only 25. The improvement provided by SERDS was reflected not only in the higher S/N but also in its ability to suppress Raman-like artifacts that remained after ALS baseline correction. The effects of the FL/Raman value, scan number, integration time, and the intensity ratio between the two excitation beams were also investigated to understand the major sources of noise and practical methods for improving spectral quality. Finally, the instrument was used to measure the Raman spectrum of anthraquinone-2,7-disulfonic acid disodium salt (2,7-AQDS), a highly fluorescent molecule where conventional ALS correction method failed. This experiment introduces students to optical alignment, SERDS instrumentation, spectral processing, and noise analysis, offering an accessible, hands-on laboratory exercise for teaching fluorescence suppression techniques.
items.authors: Peisen Qian, Brandon Rasmussen, Joaquín Rodríguez-López, Josh Vura-Weis
items.title_zh: 一种经济实惠的偏移激发拉曼差分光谱仪的构建与分析
items.summary_zh: 偏移激发拉曼差分光谱（SERDS）是一种有效抑制拉曼光谱中荧光背景的方法，但通常需要昂贵的仪器来生成两个激发光束。本研究构建了一种经济实惠的SERDS仪器，使用廉价的激光指示器和标准光学元件。通过衍射光栅和两个机械狭缝生成了线宽低于0.25 nm的两个激发光束。以环己烷作为基准分子进行数据采集和分析，随后使用不同浓度的美蓝（MB）乙醇样品检验仪器性能。对于含有1×10^-8 M MB的乙醇，SERDS光谱在荧光/拉曼比（FL/Raman）为18:1时达到了53的信噪比（S/N），而相应的ALS基线校正光谱仅为25。SERDS不仅提高了S/N，还有效抑制了ALS基线校正后残留的拉曼伪影。研究还探讨了FL/Raman值、扫描次数、积分时间及两个激发光束强度比的影响。

items.title: A Statistical Mechanics Perspective on Memory and Forgetting in Nonequilibrated Polymer Films
items.abstract: Polymer systems prepared far from equilibrium often retain long-lived memory of their processing history, manifested experimentally as molecular recoiling stresses and their anomalous relaxation behavior. Relaxation may therefore be viewed as the gradual erasure of stored nonequilibrium memory (forgetting). Experiments on spin-coated polymer thin films reveal relaxation behavior that lies beyond the scope of conventional equilibrium polymer dynamics and continuum viscoelastic descriptions, which only partially explain it. Yet a unifying statistical-mechanical framework for these observations has remained elusive. In this Perspective, I argue that such phenomena can be understood as the non-Markovian regression of constrained conformational entropy. Pivoting from Onsager’s regression hypothesis, the theory of dynamics of nonequilibrium variables, and the Mori–Zwanzig projection-operator formalism, molecular recoiling stress is identified as a slow nonequilibrium variable governing relaxation in nonequilibrated polymer systems. Projecting the microscopic dynamics onto this variable leads naturally to a stress-projected generalized Langevin equation with a history-dependent memory kernel. This minimal coarse-grained description accounts for stretched-exponential stress relaxation, Arrhenius temperature dependence, and the experimentally observed scaling of relaxation times with polymer chain length. The aim is not to introduce new microscopic models, but to provide a simple and general statistical-mechanics framework that rationalizes history-dependent stress relaxation in polymers and clarifies how polymers gradually forget their preparation history far from equilibrium. More broadly, this framework suggests that polymer memory and slow relaxation arise from the regression of constrained conformational entropy stored during nonequilibrium preparation, with topological constraints acting on nonequilibrium polymer ensembles to generate persistent, history-dependent mechanical responses.
items.authors: Mithun Chowdhury
items.title_zh: 非平衡聚合物薄膜中的记忆与遗忘的统计力学视角
items.summary_zh: 远离平衡状态的聚合物系统常常保留其加工历史的长期记忆，这在实验中表现为分子回缩应力及其异常的松弛行为。因此，松弛可以视为存储的非平衡记忆的逐渐抹去（遗忘）。对旋涂聚合物薄膜的实验揭示了超出传统平衡聚合物动力学和连续介质粘弹性描述范围的松弛行为，后者仅能部分解释这些现象。然而，统一的统计力学框架仍然难以捉摸。本文认为，这些现象可以理解为受限构象熵的非马尔可夫回归。基于Onsager的回归假设、非平衡变量的动力学理论及Mori-Zwanzig投影算子形式，分子回缩应力被识别为控制非平衡聚合物系统松弛的慢非平衡变量。将微观动力学投影到该变量上，自然得出具有历史依赖记忆核的应力投影广义Langevin方程。该最小粗粒化描述解释了拉伸指数应力松弛、Arrhenius温度依赖性及实验观察到的松弛时间与聚合物浓度的标度关系。

items.title: The CO₂ Concentration Inversion Effect: *CO Generation Rate and *CO C–C Coupling Efficiency as Dual Kinetic Descriptors for Catalyst-Dependent C₂ Selectivity in Dilute CO₂ Electroreduction¹
items.abstract: The electrochemical reduction of dilute CO₂ (5–33% v/v) to multicarbon (C₂₊) products offers a route to utilize industrial exhaust directly, bypassing energy-intensive CO₂ capture and purification. Our systematic investigations from 2023 to 2026 reveal a counter-intuitive paradigm: under dilute CO₂ feed, the C₂ selectivity of copper-based catalysts can surpass the pure-CO₂ baseline. Here we define the CO₂ concentration inversion effect as a kinetic regime where C₂ selectivity under dilute CO₂ exceeds the pure-CO₂ baseline—first in the FE(C₂)/FE(C₁) ratio and, for an increasing number of catalyst families, in the absolute C₂ Faradaic efficiency at matched potentials. This non-monotonic selectivity shows that C₂ formation is governed by a catalyst-tunable balance between *CO supply and coupling kinetics. We introduce two quantitative kinetic descriptors—the *CO production rate r (in mol cm⁻² s⁻¹) and the *CO C–C coupling efficiency η ∈ [0,1]—that jointly resolve the fate of *CO intermediates. In-situ FT–IR spectroscopy confirms that coupling efficiency is primarily governed by CO₂ concentration; we resolve a decoupling between microscopic η and the macroscopic FE(C₂₊)/FE(C₁) ratio. This framework, validated across B-doped Cu, Ag@Cu₂O and Cu₂(OH)₂CO 3 -derived Cu, challenges the implicit assumption that high-purity CO₂ is a prerequisite for efficient C₂₊ electrosynthesis.
items.authors: Qing Yu, Ying Zhang, Peng Zhu, Qiankang Zhang

items.title: Probing the vibrational and electronic structures of azide contact ion pairs in DMSO with fourier-transform infrared and soft x-ray absorption spectroscopy
items.abstract: The azide ion (N 3 - ) is a highly sensitive vibrational probe for investigating ion–pair interactions in solution. In dimethylsulfoxide (DMSO), N 3 - forms contact ion pairs with cations, leading to two distinct asymmetric stretching bands in the Fourier transform infrared (FT-IR) spectrum. Although this seems obvious, distinguishing different ion-pair species in detail becomes challenging because vibrational features overlap in the linear IR spectra. To obtain more insight into this apparent complexity, we employed two-dimensional correlation spectroscopy (2D-COS) in combination with molecular dynamics (MD) simulations to precisely distinguish the overlapping ion-pair species. Complementing the structural information from IR spectroscopy we used soft X-ray absorption spectroscopy (XAS) at the N K-edge to reveal the electronic interactions underlying the ion-pairing and to distinguish the effect of counter-ions on each atom of N 3 - separately. Combined with calculated spectra, our study demonstrates that nitrogen K-edge XAS, by probing transitions of nitrogen 1s core electrons to unoccupied molecular orbitals, directly reflects how the local electronic structure of N 3 - is affected by ion pairing. We provide evidence, in particular, for ion pairing results due to hybridization of unoccupied orbitals of N 3 - with valence orbitals of the adjacent Na + and Ca 2+ cations.
items.authors: Debkumar Rana, Sambit K. Das, Anna Luisa Upterworth, Marc-Oliver Winghart, Mate Kurucz, Victoria Kabanova
items.title_zh: 利用傅里叶变换红外和软X射线吸收光谱探究DMSO中叠氮接触离子对的结构
items.summary_zh: 叠氮离子（N₃⁻）是研究溶液中离子对相互作用的高度敏感的振动探针。在二甲基亚硫酰胺（DMSO）中，N₃⁻与阳离子形成接触离子对，导致傅里叶变换红外（FT-IR）光谱中出现两个不同的非对称伸缩带。尽管这一现象显而易见，但由于振动特征在线性红外光谱中重叠，详细区分不同的离子对物种变得具有挑战性。为深入了解这一复杂性，我们结合分子动力学（MD）模拟采用二维相关光谱（2D-COS）精确区分重叠的离子对物种。通过软X射线吸收光谱（XAS）在N K边的测量，我们揭示了离子配对背后的电子相互作用，并分别区分了对离子对N₃⁻每个原子的影响。结合计算光谱，我们的研究表明，氮K边XAS通过探测氮1s核心电子向未占据分子轨道的跃迁，直接反映了离子配对对N₃⁻局部电子结构的影响。我们特别提供了由于N₃⁻未占据轨道与相邻Na⁺和Ca²⁺阳离子价轨道杂化导致的离子配对结果的证据。

items.title: Fully Automated System for Exploring Molecular Dynamics Trajectories
items.abstract: Molecular dynamics (MD) studies often require separate tools for system preparation, simulation, enhanced sampling, analysis, and reporting, creating opportunities for inconsistent settings and undocumented decisions. We present FastMDXplora, an open-source Python framework built on OpenMM that integrates setup, simulation, analysis, and report phases through a single declarative configuration. A shared schema supports command-line and browser-based graphical interfaces. An optional artificial intelligence (AI) agent generates study configurations from natural-language descriptions, subject to the same validation as user-defined configurations. Each phase records its resolved settings, software versions, and execution environment. When a requested result lacks sufficient support, the software withholds it and reports the reason through a registry of 111 typed refusal codes. Fifteen estimator tests recover analytical benchmarks, including statistical inefficiencies within 2 % of reference values and WHAM reconstruction of analytical free-energy profiles from synthetic umbrella-sampling data with root-mean-square errors below 0.1 kJ mol−1. A labeled corpus of 25 defective and 26 clean studies produces the expected outcomes in all 51 cases. Calibration against ten replicas shows that singlerun standard errors at 20 ns can be up to tenfold smaller than replica-based estimates, even when the estimated correlation time is resolved. The software withholds standard errors when its correlation diagnostics fail, but passing these diagnostics does not establish calibrated uncertainty. In a trypsin–benzamidine case study, interaction analysis reveals differences in the engagement of Asp189 between two ligand charge states that are not distinguished by total contact counts. FastMDXplora provides an integrated framework for reproducible MD studies, combining workflow automation with explicit validation and provenance while preserving the need for independent assessment of sampling and uncertainty. The source code is available at https://github.com/aai-research-lab/FastMDXplora.
items.authors: Adekunle Aina, Derrick Kwan, Oliche Brown, Obinna Otegbulu, Victory Unegbu, Ayush Kumar
items.title_zh: 全自动分子动力学轨迹探索系统
items.summary_zh: 分子动力学（MD）研究通常需要独立的工具进行系统准备、模拟、增强采样、分析和报告，这可能导致设置不一致和决策未记录。我们提出了FastMDXplora，这是一个基于OpenMM的开源Python框架，通过单一声明性配置集成了设置、模拟、分析和报告阶段。共享模式支持命令行和基于浏览器的图形界面。可选的人工智能（AI）代理根据自然语言描述生成研究配置，并经过与用户定义配置相同的验证。每个阶段记录其解决的设置、软件版本和执行环境。当请求的结果缺乏足够支持时，软件会拒绝并通过111种类型的拒绝代码报告原因。十五项估计测试恢复了分析基准，统计效率在参考值的2%以内，WHAM重构的分析自由能曲线的均方根误差低于0.1 kJ mol−1。25个缺陷和26个干净研究的标记语料库在51个案例中产生了预期结果。与十个复制的校准显示，20 ns的单次运行标准误差可比基于复制的估计小十倍。

items.title: Scanning Electrochemical Microscopy Study of Proton-Coupled Electron Transfer Processes in Aqueous and Concentrated Hydrogen-Bonded Electrolytes: Reorganization Energies and Kinetic Correlations with Medium Acidity
items.abstract: Electrochemical proton-coupled electron transfer (PCET) reactions are ubiquitous, yet quantitative kinetic analysis of soluble redox species is often hindered by practical experimental limitations, such as mass transport, and mechanistic complexity. Here, we employed scanning electrochemical microscopy (SECM) in the feedback mode under stationary, time-independent conditions to investigate the electrochemical PCET kinetics of freely diffusing quinone molecules in aqueous and concentrated hydrogen-bonded electrolytes (CoHBEs) media by constructing rate constant (log k) vs. overpotential (η) plots (k-plots). This approach enabled the direct determination of the apparent electron transfer rate constant at each applied potential, bypassing the reliance on a specific kinetic model. It also captured potential-dependent changes in slope and curvature features that could be described by Butler-Volmer (BV) and Marcus-Hush-Chidsey (MHC) models to obtain standard rate constants (k0) and the reorganization energies (λ) under different reaction conditions. Using anthraquinone-2,7-disulfonic acid (AQDS) as a redox probe, we examined the proton-to-electron transfer ratios during PCET processes across acidic to basic pH conditions through Pourbaix analysis, in situ spectroelectrochemical methods including shifted excitation Raman difference spectroscopy (SERDS), and electronic absorption spectroscopy. We observed that, in both aqueous and CoHBE solvents with varying acidity, more basic environments exhibit larger k0 and smaller λ values as acidity decreases. Density functional theory (DFT) calculations further revealed that multiple PCET pathways coexist, with their relative contributions depending on pH and applied potential. The greater contribution of sequential proton-electron transfer (SPET) pathways and lower activation barriers under more basic conditions provide a mechanistic understanding for the experimentally observed 2 / 41 faster kinetics because concerted PCET steps have larger reorganization energies. Furthermore, extending our approach to the benzoquinone (BQ)/hydroquinone (H2BQ) redox couple enabled the construction of two-tailed k-plots containing both anodic and cathodic branches, revealing redox asymmetry in PCET reactions. Theoretical modeling suggested that different operative reaction mechanisms between oxidation and reduction reactions as a potential origin of apparent redox asymmetry. This work lays the foundations for extracting electrochemical PCET kinetics for a variety of redox systems, electrode materials, and solution compositions and conditions of broad interest for energy storage and beyond.
items.authors: Peisen Qian, Saransh Gupta, Kristin Martin, Zican Lin, Brandon Rasmussen, Burcu E. Gurkan

items.title: Light-Programmed Persistent and Rewritable Anisotropy in Photoresponsive Mesogenic Microdroplets
items.abstract: Photo-responsive liquid-crystalline systems can translate molecular photoisomerization into mesoscale reorganization, but retaining light-written anisotropy in fluid mesophases remains challenging because the programmed order readily relaxes. Here, we show that photo-responsive RM-AzoSi3 microdroplets enable polarized-light writing, rewriting, and quantitative readout of mesophase anisotropy at single-droplet resolution. Microdroplet arrays prepared by µ-contact printing on PDMS exhibit a hyperbolic hedgehog internal organization that can be reoriented by polarized irradiation into directional anisotropic states perpendicular to the incident polarization. Polarized imaging enables the monitoring of internal organization and shows that repeated irradiation progressively suppresses relaxation, yielding long-lived anisotropy while preserving rewritability. Under inert atmosphere, photopolymerization further tunes the balance between structural fixation and preservation of mesoscopic order, with strong sensitivity to irradiation power, exposure time, and pulse frequency. Together, these results establish light-programmed persistent anisotropy as an accessible design principle in fluid soft matter and position photo-responsive microdroplets as a versatile platform for directional optical programming in soft-photonic materials.
items.authors: Osamu Oki, Yuyang Wang, Anjali Devi Das, Bart W. L. van den Bersselaar, Peter Zijlstra, Ghislaine Vantomme
items.title_zh: 光编程持久可重写的光响应微液晶微滴各向异性
items.summary_zh: 光响应液晶系统能够将分子光异构化转化为介观尺度的重组，但在流体介相中保持光写入的各向异性仍然具有挑战性。本文展示了光响应RM-AzoSi3微滴能够实现偏振光写入、重写和单滴分辨率的介相各向异性定量读取。通过µ接触印刷在PDMS上制备的微滴阵列展现出超双曲刺猬的内部组织，可通过偏振辐照重新定向为与入射偏振垂直的各向异性状态。偏振成像监测内部组织，表明重复辐照逐渐抑制松弛，产生持久的各向异性并保持可重写性。在惰性气氛下，光聚合进一步调节结构固定与介观秩序保持之间的平衡，对辐照功率、曝光时间和脉冲频率具有强敏感性。这些结果确立了光编程持久各向异性作为流体软物质中的可行设计原则，并将光响应微滴定位为软光子材料中方向性光学编程的多功能平台。

items.title: Ion Gradients Drive Flooding in Membrane-Electrode Assembly CO2 Electrolyzers
items.abstract: Low-temperature carbon dioxide electrolysis (CO 2 E) provides a low-carbon-emission pathway to basic chemical products. While anion exchange membrane (AEM)-based CO 2 E can provide high selectivity towards carbon products, runtimes are far below industry requirements. Flooding is a major obstacle to long-term stability as it limits CO 2 access to the catalyst layer, but the reasons for continuous water fluxes to the cathode are poorly understood. Here we present a model-aided experimental analysis of the driving forces for flooding. By tracking high-frequency resistance, anolyte conductivity, and cathode water accumulation over 24-hour runtimes across a range of current densities, temperatures and anolyte concentrations, we reveal AEM ion gradients as the main driving force for both flooding and cation-crowding at the cathode catalyst. We then show how ion gradient management can maintain steady CO selectivity and increase maximum CO 2 E partial current densities, with temperatures acting as a primary factor in reducing ion gradients. Using these insights, we demonstrate stable CO production at 500 mA cm -2 on an ionomer-free Ag catalyst.
items.authors: Henri M. Pelzer, Boris D. Wortmann, Samarinda M. de Heer, Eva Looijestein, David A. Vermaas, Thomas Burdyny
items.title_zh: 离子梯度驱动膜电极组装CO2电解槽的淹水现象
items.summary_zh: 低温二氧化碳电解（CO2 E）为基本化学产品提供了低碳排放的途径。尽管基于阴离子交换膜（AEM）的CO2 E对碳产品具有高选择性，但其运行时间远低于行业要求。淹水是长期稳定性的主要障碍，因为它限制了CO2对催化剂层的接触，但持续水流向阴极的原因尚不清楚。本文通过模型辅助实验分析淹水的驱动因素。通过跟踪高频电阻、阳极液导电性和阴极水积累，揭示了AEM离子梯度是淹水和阴极催化剂阳离子拥挤的主要驱动力。研究表明，离子梯度管理可以维持稳定的CO选择性并提高CO2 E的最大部分电流密度，温度是减少离子梯度的主要因素。基于这些发现，我们在无离子聚合物的银催化剂上实现了500 mA cm-2的稳定CO生产。

items.title: Integrated High-Throughput Mass Spectrometry Framework for Multiplexed Substrate Screening in Enzyme Discovery and Development
items.abstract: Biocatalysis continues to advance sustainable synthesis while relying on analytical technologies that can match the demands of high-throughput, miniaturized screening and complex assay formats. In particular, multiplexed substrate screening strategy accelerates enzyme discovery and the expansion of the enzyme toolbox, yet it demands greater selectivity, sensitivity, and throughput than conventional single-quadrupole LC-MS can provide. Here, an integrated high-throughput mass spectrometry framework enabling both quantitative targeted analysis and untargeted product discovery in biocatalytic reactions is introduced. The platform employs a tiered measurement strategy consisting of Acoustic Droplet Ejection-Multiple Reaction Monitoring Mass Spectrometry (ADE-MRM-MS) for targeted quantitation, Acoustic Droplet Ejection-Time-of-Flight Mass Spectrometry (ADE-TOF-MS) for untargeted product discovery through extracted ion chromatogram (XIC) analysis, and Acoustic Droplet Ejection-Quadrupole Time-of-Flight Tandem Mass Spectrometry (ADE-QTOF-MS/MS) for challenging selectivity scenarios involving near-isobaric compounds, closely related masses, and structural isomers. Application of this approach streamlined rapid discovery and evolution campaigns across pyrimidine nucleoside phosphorylases (PyNPs), transaminases (TAs), and nucleoside deoxyribosyltransferases (NDTs). Together, these results established the first unified ADE-MS framework for biocatalysis that delivers the speed, selectivity, and scalability required for next-generation biocatalyst screening and sustainable synthesis.
items.authors: Wenxuan Li, Devin Makey, Vladimir Shchurik, Giulio Fittolani, Jennifer L. Kennemur, Richard S. Ayikpoe

items.title: Substituent Effects on the Photochemistry of Aqueous Phenolate-Based Anions Revealed by Extreme Ultraviolet Time-Resolved Photoelectron Spectroscopy
items.abstract: Phenolate (PhO-) is a prototypical chromophore and a recurring motif in photoactive biomolecular systems. Here, we use extreme-ultraviolet time-resolved photoelectron spectroscopy (XUV-TRPES) to probe how para-substitution redirects the photophysics of aqueous 4-nitrophenolate (4NP-) and 4-chlorophenolate (4CP-) anions. In 4NP-, following 400 nm excitation, internal charge reorganization accompanied by nitrogroup torsion forms a stabilized twisted intramolecular charge-transfer (TICT) configuration in 74 fs, efficiently funneling the population through a conical intersection to the ground state within 200 fs. Similar dynamics are seen upon excitation at 240 nm, although the initially excited state is even shorter-lived (40 fs). No hydrated electron production is seen at either wavelength. In 4CP-, following 240 nm excitation of the S2 state, internal conversion to S1 occurs within 120 fs. Chlorine substitution introduces a competing 1πσ* dissociative channel whose potential energy surface intersects S1, but the higher S1/1πσ* crossing barrier relative to 4BP- allows the S1 population to survive long enough (25 ps) for solvent-assisted electron ejection and internal conversion. The dynamics thus resemble those of PhO- rather than the sub-picosecond dissociative relaxation of 4BP-. Taken together with our previous PhO- and 4-bromophenolate (4BP-) measurements, these results reveal how para-substitution across this prototypical series drives the accessibility of competing excited-state dynamical processes, leading to very different photostability and photochemistry.
items.authors: Jaydeep Basu, Do Hyung Kang, Neal Haldar, Daniel M Neumark

items.title: Electrostatic preactivation, a missing step in dioxygen activation
items.abstract: Dioxygen is the oxidant of aerobic life, yet most closed-shell molecules are stable in its presence. 1–4 Conventional accounts of dioxygen activation begin with electron transfer to O 2 , typically from a redox-active metal centre or cofactor. 5–9 Here we show that preparing dioxygen to receive that electron is a separate function, discharged by the electrostatic environment alone, and that the two can be tuned independently. At the equilibrium geometry of neutral O 2 the anion that must receive the electron is unbound; 10,11 a Lewis-acidic field removes this obstacle before any charge moves, a stage we term preactivation . Point charges alone split the O 2 π* manifold and bind the anion at the neutral geometry. Reaction-path calculations show that inner-sphere electron transfer from the Zn–C bond, which generates a superoxide/alkyl-radical pair without metal-centred redox chemistry, is rate-determining. Calibrated on dialkylzincs alone, the in-plane anisotropy of the field gradient, with one term in the charge and distance of the metal resolved within the same series, predicts the π* splitting to within 7% in four enzyme active sites containing iron, copper, nickel or no metal. The electrostatic contribution of an enzyme active site to preactivation can thus be quantified on a scale calibrated with redox-silent organozinc compounds.
items.authors: Grzegorz Jędrzejczyk, Janusz Lewiński

items.title: Semiempirical Quantum Chemistry in the Age of ab initio Data and Differentiable Programming: II. Parameter Optimization
items.abstract: Semiempirical quantum chemistry (SQC) represents an invaluable asset in the toolbox of molecular and materials modeling. Thanks to their explicit quantum-mechanical treatment of electrons, they allow to capture an array of local and non-local interaction mechanisms and offers access to electronic structure properties, which can be of crucial importance in order to better understand and design molecular systems and materials. In a previous publication, we presented our recent advances within the PySEQM package, enabling rapid gradient evaluations for SQC parameters and thus developing an efficient and reliable back-end for SQC parametrizations. In this work, we detail our implementation of this parametrization procedure, SQCFit, and its features. Offering a high degree of automation, SQCFit implements a suite of tailor-made tools for the optimization of SQC parameters. Specifically, we present local versus global parametrization schemes, the use of train-validation splits and early stopping to avoid overfitting, and advanced scoring/loss functions including appropriately standardized quantitative error measures as well as more qualitative measures such as the performance in ranking candidate systems according to a given molecular property. Based on a set of test applications, we highlight how SQCFit allows to obtain performant parametrizations tailor-made for the modern use cases of SQC.
items.authors: Martin Stöhr, Todd J. Martínez
items.title_zh: 半经验量子化学中的参数优化研究
items.summary_zh: 半经验量子化学（SQC）在分子和材料建模中具有重要价值。由于其对电子的显式量子力学处理，SQC能够捕捉多种局部和非局部相互作用机制，并提供电子结构性质的访问，这对理解和设计分子系统及材料至关重要。我们在PySEQM软件包中实现了快速梯度评估，以支持SQC参数的高效可靠优化。在本研究中，我们详细介绍了参数化程序SQCFit及其功能，提供高度自动化的工具集以优化SQC参数。具体而言，我们展示了局部与全局参数化方案、训练-验证分割和早停法以避免过拟合，以及包括标准化定量误差度量和定性度量的高级评分/损失函数。通过一系列测试应用，我们强调了SQCFit如何实现现代用例所需的高性能参数化。

items.title: Epimeric modulation of post-translational modifications
items.abstract: 2 Abstract Dysregulated PTMs are widely implicated in many diseases both directly and as biomarkers. Investigations into the diverse mechanistic aspects leading to their formation are complex and consequential. Although reports on the prevalence and importance of amino acid epimers in biological systems and therapeutics have escalated, their effect on subsequent posttranslational modifications (PTMs) has been overlooked. We show that such epimeric modifications can have profound effects through a form of hierarchical crosstalk, termed bottomup crosstalk. We examined how D-serine and D-aspartic acid residues within biologically and therapeutically important peptides affect subsequent enzymatic phosphorylation and glycosylation. D-Ser was found to inhibit phosphorylation and/or direct phosphorylation to different sites within the peptide. Surprisingly, the D-Ser6 epimer and L-Ser5 residue of atrial natriuretic peptide were phosphorylated. Asp epimers and isomers produced widely different effects in all peptides examined. Epimers reduced the degree of O-glycosylated products and often altered the glycosylation sites. Epimers also affected enzymatic hydrolysis of the peptide main chain. However, they did not affect higher order PTMs such as extending glycosylation of existing groups. Epimeric modifications often caused negative crosstalk, such as residue competition and site redirection, when the modification was within one or two amino acids of the existing PTM.
items.authors: Daniel W. Armstrong, Angel Covarrubias, Umang Dhaubhadel, Arzoo Patel, Amanda Razo-Smith

items.title: The Electrical Double Layer in Batteries-Perspective on Complex Electrolytes and Future Directions
items.abstract: The electrical double layer (EDL) defines the few nanometer region between an electrified surface and its interfacing electrolyte. This non-Faradaic interfacial phenomenon has often been overlooked in the battery field in preference to the Faradaic charge-transfer and interphasial forming reactions. Here, a perspective is provided to focus on the EDL and how it dictates much of the later reactions’ behaviors. Two fields of understanding are discussed-one being computational and how to accurately model the EDL in more complex electrolytes, the other being experimental and how to accurately probe the EDL. Both fields are of importance to designing electrolytes and electrodes for improved battery performance, all ofwhich is dictated through interfacial behavior. K E YWORD S
items.authors: Corey M. Efaw, Xi Tan, Joshua A. Russell, Yuanqing Yun, Simon L. J. Langois, Shinthia Binte Eskender

items.title: Directing Generation of Polynuclear Plutonium Species with Reduction and Protonation
items.authors: Emily Mikeska, Davis Curry, Richard Wilson, Asmita Sen, Jochen Autschbach, James Blakemore

items.title: Cu-Catalyzed Enantioconvergent Synthesis of N-Alkyl Amides from Racemic Alcohols
items.abstract: Enantioconvergent amidation of racemic alcohols offers a powerful retrosynthetic disconnection to convert abundant, readily accessible alcohol feedstocks into chiral N-alkyl amides, while streamlining access to valuable enantioenriched primary amines. However, a mechanistic framework that can integrate efficient C(sp3)–O bond cleavage with enantioselective amidation has remained understudied. Herein, we report the enantioconvergent deoxygenative amidation of racemic alcohols through a Cu-catalyzed radical relay. β-Scission of oxidant-derived electrophilic alkoxy radicals was leveraged as a radical-umpolung event, producing nucleophilic methyl radicals that effectively activate alcohol substrate-derived xanthates. Computation-guided optimization revealed that increasing xanthate electrophilicity facilitates methyl-radical addition and improves reaction efficiency. The transformation accommodates a variety of alcohols and amides with high enantioselectivity, and the reaction conditions are compatible with medicinally relevant functional groups, heterocycles, and pharmaceutical frameworks. Synthetic applications of this protocol streamline access to enantioenriched β-amino alcohols and biologically active primary amines, circumventing the need for enantioenriched alcohol precursors. Mechanistic studies revealed that polarity matching favors the capture of electron-deficient carbon-centered radicals by electron-rich CuII–amidates. Under catalytic conditions, however, the greater acidity of electron-deficient amides facilitates transmetalation, accelerating the formation of CuII–amidate and enhancing coupling efficiency.
items.authors: Jonathan Vu, Eve Yuanwei Xu, Tanner S. Schubert, Matthew J. Metzger, Yongxian Li, Robert S. Paton
items.title_zh: 铜催化的对映体收敛合成N-烷基酰胺
items.summary_zh: 对映体收敛的酰胺化反应能够有效地将丰富且易得的手性N-烷基酰胺从外消旋醇中合成，同时简化了宝贵的富含对映体的初级胺的获取。然而，能够将高效的C(sp3)–O键断裂与对映选择性酰胺化整合的机制框架仍未得到充分研究。本文报道了一种通过铜催化的自由基中继实现的外消旋醇的对映体收敛去氧酰胺化反应。利用氧化剂衍生的电亲核烷氧基自由基的β-断裂作为自由基反转事件，生成有效激活醇衍生的黄原酸酯的亲核甲基自由基。计算指导的优化表明，增加黄原酸酯的电亲核性有助于甲基自由基的加成，提高反应效率。该转化适用于多种醇和酰胺，具有高对映选择性，反应条件与药物相关的功能团、杂环和药物框架相容。该方法的合成应用简化了富含对映体的β-氨基醇和生物活性初级胺的获取，避免了对映体富集醇前体的需求。机制研究表明，极性匹配有利于捕获电子缺乏的碳。

items.title: Automating Nanoparticle Analysis in Transmission Electron Microscopy with Synthetically Trained Segmentation Models
items.abstract: Nanoparticle morphology governs the functional behaviour: plasmonic, catalytic, magnetic, electronic, of colloidal and supported nanomaterials, yet distributions of single-particle morphology are seldom reported. Published distributions typically aggregate ensemble averages or a few dozen manually segmented transmission electron microscopy (TEM) images, leaving population-level descriptors statistically underpowered. The rate-limiting step is instance segmentation: convolutional neural networks require extensive pixel-level annotations that are prohibitive to curate for every new particle system. Here we report TEMPOS, a deep-learning instance-segmentation package trained on procedurally generated synthetic TEM micrographs which simulate arbitrary particle distributions, substrate, noise, and imaging aberrations. TEMPOS outputs per-particle shape descriptors to a FAIR-compliant relational database and renders image archives searchable by morphological query. Distributed with a graphical interface for nondomain experts, the package reduces large-dataset analysis from weeks of manual segmentation to minutes of active work, enabling routine statistical morphometry across nanomaterials research.
items.authors: Natalia Sá, Andrew Stewart

items.title: Advances on doping strategies and emerging applications of organic (semi)conducting polymers
items.abstract: Conducting polymers have evolved from intrinsically conductive macromolecules into versatile organic (semi)conductors that combine electronic transport with ionic, optical, mechanical, and spin functionalities. A central challenge in this evolution is to generate and stabilize charge carriers while retaining control over molecular organization, processability, and operational stability. This Review examines how molecular design and doping chemistry have progressively addressed this challenge, from early polyacetylene- and polyaniline-based systems to processable polythiophene derivatives and contemporary donor–acceptor conjugated polymers. Across p-type, ntype, and self-doped systems, we consider how advances in molecular architecture and doping chemistry have expanded the means of generating, stabilizing, and transporting charge carriers. Emerging approaches—including side-chain-enabled doping, protoncoupled electron transfer, catalytic and photoinduced doping, and intrinsically open-shell self-doping—are considered in the context of their potential to overcome limitations in doping efficiency, stability, and morphological control. These advances have expanded conducting polymers beyond conventional charge-transport materials toward multifunctional platforms for energy storage, 3D printing, organic electrochemical transistors, neuromorphic computing, and spintronics. We further identify the need to establish more precise relationships among molecular structure, doping state, solid-state organization, and device-level performance. Continuing progress along these directions will be essential for translating the tunable optical, electronic, electrochemical and mechanical properties of these organic conducting polymers into stable, scalable, and multifunctional technologies beyond the reach of classical inorganic (semi)conductors such as silicon and metals.
items.authors: Ying Wei, Yifan Liu, Feng Jiang, Mingfeng Wang
items.title_zh: 导电聚合物掺杂策略及新兴应用进展
items.summary_zh: 导电聚合物已从内在导电的高分子演变为多功能的有机（半）导体，结合了电子传输、离子、光学、机械和自旋功能。本文回顾了分子设计和掺杂化学如何逐步应对生成和稳定电荷载流子的挑战，涵盖了从早期的聚乙炔和聚苯胺系统到可加工的聚噻吩衍生物及现代供体-受体共轭聚合物的进展。我们探讨了p型、n型和自掺杂系统中，分子结构和掺杂化学的进步如何扩展了生成、稳定和传输电荷载流子的手段。新兴方法如侧链掺杂、质子耦合电子转移、催化和光诱导掺杂，以及内在开壳自掺杂等，均被考虑在内，以克服掺杂效率、稳定性和形态控制的局限。这些进展使导电聚合物超越传统电荷传输材料，向能量存储、3D打印、有机电化学晶体管、类脑计算和自旋电子学等多功能平台发展。

items.title: Substrate-Controlled Electrophilic Fluorination of Alkenyl Boronates: Direct versus 1,2- H -Migrative Fluorodeboronation
items.abstract: A general fluorodeboronation protocol that converts readily available alkenyl boronates into fluorinated alkenes under mild aqueous biphasic conditions is proposed. The method employs 1-chloromethyl-4-fluoro-1,4-diazoniabicyclo[2.2.2]octane bis-tetrafluoroborate (F-TEDA) as a fluorine source in the presence of KHF 2 , providing broad access to functionalized alkenyl fluorides from β-substituted and β,β-disubstituted alkenyl boronates, including cyclic, heterocyclic, aryl-, heteroaryl-, and alkyl-substituted derivatives, with good functional-group tolerance and preparative scalability. In contrast, αsubstituted alkenyl boronates displayed divergent reactivity, furnishing allylic fluorides through a rearrangement pathway. Mechanistic experiments and DFT calculations support initial electrophilic fluorination of the C=C bond followed by either BF 3 elimination or 1,2-hydride shift, depending on the substitution pattern and stability of the resulting cationic intermediate.
items.authors: Oleksandr S. Liashuk, Oleksandr P. Demchuk, Varvara Trachova, Illya Zahorniy, Oleksandr Hryshchuk, Tetiana Zubatiuk

items.title: Turning Up the Heat: Investigation into the Driving Forces of the Hofmeister Effect in Water Vibrational Spectra
items.abstract: The Hofmeister series has historically been used to rank ions according to their impact on the solubility of proteins in aqueous solutions. Strongly hydrating salts, which stabilize the native structure of proteins, leading to their “salting-out,” are referred to as kosmotropes (“structure-makers”). Weakly hydrating salts, which facilitate protein denaturing and “salting-in,” are referred to as chaotropes (“structure-breakers”). While the Hofmeister effect has been extensively studied, the underlying thermodynamic driving forces are not well understood. Recent fluctuation theory calculations have suggested that the Hofmeister effect observed in the infrared (IR) spectrum of aqueous alkali–halide solutions is predominantly entropically driven. Here, experimental support for this hypothesis is provided through temperature-dependent Fourier transform IR (FTIR) spectroscopy. The FTIR OH stretch spectrum of alkali halides dissolved in isotopically dilute HOD/D2O was collected and the temperature derivative of the lineshape was used to extract relevant thermodynamic potentials. It was observed that while the effective enthalpy is nearly ion-independent, a reduction of the entropic cost to form stronger hydrogen-bonds (H-bonds) scales with decreasing halide size, suggesting that this contribution is the driving force for this observed Hofmeister effect.
items.authors: Eric J. Cyganowski, Ashley K. Borkowski, Isaac D. Cowan, Ward H. Thompson, Carlos R. Baiz

items.title: Two extrapolation axes for many-body systems: interaction without an interaction module, chemical mixtures as the main example
items.abstract: We separate the extrapolation problem in many-body systems into two axes: toward combinations with more components, and toward components unseen. The prevailing pipeline—encode then interact—performs poorly when extrapolating in composition count. We propose a route that expresses interaction without an interaction module: a per-component encoder shaped by the task compresses interaction behaviour into each component’s encoding, and the encodings are combined and read out by a simple MLP. Where component identities are bounded while their combinations are not, this route performs better along the composition axis—a difference that follows from the underlying function form rather than from the data. Chemical mixtures are the main example, synthetic tasks isolate the two axes, and the same structure recurs in other fields.
items.authors: Xiao Yang, Guanghao Song, Feiyu Li, Zihan Xu, Yanan Yang, Baojiang He
items.title_zh: 多体系统的两种外推轴：无交互模块的交互，化学混合物为主要例子
items.summary_zh: 我们将多体系统中的外推问题分为两个轴：向更多组分的组合外推，以及向未见组分的外推。现有的流程——编码后再交互——在组分数量外推时表现不佳。我们提出了一种无交互模块表达交互的方法：由任务塑造的每个组分编码器将交互行为压缩到每个组分的编码中，这些编码通过简单的多层感知机（MLP）进行组合和读取。当组分身份受到限制而其组合不受限时，这种方法在组合轴上表现更佳——这一差异源于基础函数形式而非数据。化学混合物是主要例子，合成任务隔离了两个轴，相同结构在其他领域也有所体现。

items.title: MicroED Guided Structure Property Relationships in Mechanochemically Synthesized Fluorescent Cocrystals
items.abstract: Co-crystallization offers a versatile strategy to control solid-state fluorescence in organic fluorophores. Here, we demonstrate systematic emission tuning of a pyridine-based fluorophore via mechanochemical co-crystallization with aromatic carboxylic acids differing in positional isomerism and functional group multiplicity. Dicarboxylic acid coformers induced pronounced hypsochromic shifts, whereas tri- and hexa-carboxylic acids produced bathochromic shifts, spanning emission from sapphire blue to greenish yellow. Photophysical and structural analyses revealed that O–H···N hydrogen bonding and conformational twisting in dicarboxylic acid cocrystals reduced π-conjugation, increasing the HOMO-LUMO gap. In contrast, fluorophore cocrystals with tri- and hexa-carboxylic acids enhanced electron-accepting character and donor-acceptor interactions; the resulting increased planarity and charge-transfer stabilization lead to red-shifted emission. These findings show that subtle variations in coformer structure and supramolecular interactions enable precise tuning of solid-state emission, providing a rational route to advanced luminescent materials. MicroED, together with SCXRD, plays a crucial role in establishing structure-property correlations.
items.authors: Nabadeep Kalita, Takanori Nakane, Akihiro Kawamoto, Kouhei Ichiyanagi, Khaled Althubeiti, Toshiyuki Sasaki
items.title_zh: 机械化学合成荧光共晶体的微型电子衍射结构-性质关系研究
items.summary_zh: 共晶化为控制有机荧光体固态荧光提供了一种多功能策略。本研究通过与不同位置异构体和功能团数量的芳香羧酸进行机械化学共晶化，系统调节了一种基于吡啶的荧光体的发射特性。二羧酸共形成分引起明显的蓝移，而三羧酸和六羧酸则导致红移，发射范围从蓝宝石蓝到黄绿色。光物理和结构分析表明，二羧酸共晶体中的O–H···N氢键和构象扭曲减少了π共轭，增加了HOMO-LUMO间隙。相比之下，三羧酸和六羧酸的荧光体共晶体增强了电子受体特性和供体-受体相互作用，导致平面度增加和电荷转移稳定性，从而实现红移发射。这些发现表明，共形成分结构和超分子相互作用的微小变化能够精确调节固态发射，为先进发光材料提供了合理的途径。微型电子衍射与单晶X射线衍射在建立结构-性质关系中发挥了关键作用。

items.title: Electrochemical (3+2) Cycloaddition of Enamides and 4-(Bocamino)phenol for the Synthesis of 2-Aminodihydrobenzofurans
items.abstract: Synopsis: We report a simple electrochemical protocol to prepare 2-amino-dihydrobenzofurans from enamides. In contrast to previously reported approaches relying on stoichiometric chemical oxidants or transition metal catalysis of prefunctionalized compounds, the present method directly couples 4-(Boc-amino)phenol through anodic activation to a wide range of enamides, using inexpensive graphite electrodes in an undivided cell.
items.authors: Maurice Peene, Louis Rouseu, Marios kidonakis
items.title_zh: 电化学(3+2)环加成合成2-氨基二氢苯并呋喃
items.summary_zh: 本研究报告了一种简单的电化学方法，通过酰胺与4-(Boc氨基)苯酚的反应合成2-氨基二氢苯并呋喃。与以往依赖化学氧化剂或过渡金属催化的预功能化化合物的方法不同，本方法通过阳极活化直接将4-(Boc氨基)苯酚与多种酰胺偶联，使用廉价的石墨电极在未分隔的电池中进行反应。

items.title: Thermo-photo catalytic partial oxidation of methane on hematite nanosheets functionalized with silver nanoparticles
items.abstract: Converting reactions driven by thermocatalysis to thermo-photo catalysis can offer several advantages, such as allowing the reaction to proceed under less harsh conditions to improve stability and tune reaction selectivity. Here, we report on using a dilute loading of silver nanoparticles on high surface area hematite nanosheets, an earth-abundant material, to transform our demonstrated thermocatalytic conversion of methane to a thermo-photo conversion of methane with lowered onset temperatures and a shift in reaction mechanism. With a dilute loading of spherical silver nanoparticles, reaction onset temperatures were lowered to 150 °C from 300 °C. Additionally, reaction products were shifted to CO, decreasing the selectivity toward CO 2 and suggesting novel mechanistic pathways. The catalysts demonstrate great stability, with only a corresponding 4.9% and 11.3% decrease in activity over the bare and decorated catalyst over 15 hours. The fundamental relationships between reaction conversion and temperature, light intensity, and light wavelength studied in this work are important for providing a guideline for tuning other reactions with thermo-photo catalysis to improve catalyst conversion, selectivity, and stability.
items.authors: Jake Heinlein, Aislinn Whalen, Gaukhar Alzhanova, Manav Singh, Octavio Balbarin, Yue Wang
items.title_zh: 银纳米颗粒修饰赤铁矿纳米片的热光催化部分氧化甲烷研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了在高比表面积的赤铁矿纳米片上稀释负载银纳米颗粒，以实现甲烷的热光催化转化。通过这种方法，反应的起始温度从300°C降低至150°C，反应产物主要转向一氧化碳（CO），而二氧化碳（CO₂）的选择性降低，提示了新的反应机制。催化剂表现出良好的稳定性，在15小时内，裸催化剂和修饰催化剂的活性仅分别下降了4.9%和11.3%。本研究中探讨的反应转化与温度、光强度及光波长之间的基本关系，为优化其他热光催化反应提供了指导，以提高催化剂的转化率、选择性和稳定性。

items.title: Challenges in Catalyst Design for the Ammonia Oxidation Reaction in Aqueous Media: The Case of Metal Porphyrins
items.authors: Nikolaos Kostopoulos, Alina Sekretareva

items.title: Triple Atom Transfer-Enabled α-C(sp3)-H Aminomethylation of Aliphatic Amines: General and Modular Access to Vicinal Diamines
items.abstract: Vicinal diamines are prevalent structural elements in organic molecules. In particular, those featuring a tertiary alkylamine motif are commonly found in biologically active molecules and therapeutic agents. However, methods for the efficient construction of these architectures from inexpensive and readily available feedstocks remain scarce. Here, we report a mild photocatalytic protocol for the modular synthesis of vicinal alkyl diamines via triple atom transfer-enabled α-C(sp3)–H aminomethylation. This transformation integrates halogen-atom transfer (XAT) and intramolecular 1,5-hydrogen-atom transfer (HAT) processes to furnish key α-amido alkyl radicals, which subsequently add to in situ-generated iminium ions. Critical to the success of the reaction is the cooperative action of a nickel complex and a zinc salt, which jointly promote the aminomethylation process. Utility of this method is demonstrated through late-stage modification of complex amine molecules, scale-up experiments, and ready access to scaffold-diverse free vicinal diamines. In addition, compatibility with aromatic aldehydes and the ability to functionalize alternative C–H sites further expand the chemical space of diamine architectures, highlighting the robustness and synthetic versatility of this protocol.
items.authors: Yu Chen, Caiyun He, Huanyu Xiao, Zhaoyang Xu, Weiran Yang, Tao Yang

items.title: The coefficient map, not the basis, limits how machine-learning surrogates of metal–organic framework water-adsorption beds transfer to unseen materials
items.abstract: Machine-learning surrogates could let designers of metal–organic framework (MOF) water harvesters screen many candidate adsorbents without solving the transport equations for each. A surrogate fails on an unseen material for one of two reasons: its reduced basis cannot represent the true field, or its map from material parameters to basis coefficients predicts the wrong coefficients. Which one limits accuracy decides where method development should go, yet it is rarely measured. We measure it for a one-dimensional, non-isothermal convection–dispersion–adsorption model of a packed bed, verified against 4 closed-form solutions and compared, unfitted, with a published MOF-303 breakthrough curve. Seven explanations of the error were registered in advance, each with the evidence that would eliminate it, and tested on 240 held-out materials in five folds, with a cluster bootstrap that corrects for choosing the best configuration on the test materials. Beyond the first few modes the map, not the basis, limits accuracy: refining the basis 90× changes a per-mode map’s error by 0.9 % and a DeepONet’s by 12 %. More training materials still help (error ∝ N_mat^(-0.222)) and larger models are not ruled out, while Kolmogorov–Arnold networks lose to a same-size perceptron in every comparison by point estimate (exploratory, 12 materials). A physics-residual loss at a small weight improves transfer by 9 % (48 materials); larger weights hurt. Learning beats fitted closed forms 2.44-fold, yet a coarse finite-volume solve is more accurate than the perceptron surrogates (3.1 % normalised error) and cheaper below about 25,400 queries. Effort is better spent on the coefficient map and on training data than on richer bases.
items.authors: Abdulhamid Batayhi

items.title: The Mechanical Bond Reveals Hidden Interrupted Click Reactions
items.abstract: The Cu I -triazolide intermediate of the Cu-mediated alkyne-azide cycloaddition (CuAAC) typically undergoes rapid proto-demetallation but can be intercepted by suitable coupling partners to give 5-substituted triazole products. However, the scope of such “interrupted click” reactions is restricted because some partners react too slowly to outcompete proto-demetallation or even actively promote the decomposition of the Cu I -triazolide in preference to the desired coupling. Here we show that mechanical stabilisation of a Cu I -triazolide within a [2]rotaxane can allow otherwise unproductive “hidden” interrupted click reactions to proceed; the triazolide intermediate of the active template CuAAC reaction couples with cyanide and primary amines under oxidative conditions to install these groups at the triazole 5-position in up to 99% yield. In contrast, the interlocked triazolide reacts slowly with some typical interrupted electrophiles that intercept non-interlocked Cu I -triazolides. Based on these reactivity trends, we propose that the mechanical bond prevents direct attack of electrophiles on the Cu-C bond, instead enforcing inner-sphere reactivity at the Cu I centre with a Cu I /Cu III /Cu I redox cycle. The C-5 substituent leads to a new source of mechanical positional isomerism and a suitably designed macrocycle can be removed after the coupling, allowing the interlocked architecture to serve as an auxiliary for products of otherwise inaccessible interrupted click reactions.
items.authors: Anja Ramström, Qilong Sun, Daisy R. S. Pooler, A. Ken Inge, Stephen M. Goldup, Fredrik Schaufelberger

items.title: Photocatalytic Divergent Skeletal Remodeling through Strain Release: Modular Access to Carbocycles and Heterocycles
items.abstract: Deconstructive skeletal remodeling of three-dimensional architectures offered a unique strategy to access structurally distinct carbocyclic and heterocyclic frameworks. A common, highly strained central σ-bond enabled two divergent skeletal-reorganization pathways, providing direct access to 1,3-disubstituted naphthalenes and pyrroles. A subtle change in reaction environment dictates divergent product formation during this photocatalytic double-strain-release skeletal-remodeling process. Under rigorously anhydrous conditions, skeletal reorganization furnishes carbocycles, whereas the addition of water redirects the reaction pathway toward heterocycle formation. The method accommodates a wide range of functional groups and substitution patterns. Mechanistic studies show that both pathways proceed through a common electron-transfer manifold and shared reactive intermediate. A delicate change in reaction conditions then leads to distinct aza-diene intermediates, driving divergent, regioselective outcomes.
items.authors: Braja Kishor Paul, Malekul Islam, Fadil Faizal Mannighayil, Suman De De Sarkar

items.title: Unraveling the Temperature-Dependent Redox Cycle of Chromium Species in Molten Chloride Salt via In-Situ X-ray Absorption Spectroscopy
items.abstract: Molten chloride salt is a widely studied high-temperature electrolyte, with established use in pyrochemical reprocessing and electrorefining, and frequent use as a model system for concentrated solar power and molten salt reactor applications. Chromium (Cr) is a key element in high-temperature structural alloys. However, the temperature-dependent evolution and stability of Cr species in this environment remain insufficiently understood. Cr-redox chemistry in molten chloride salts governs the dissolution, oxidation and transformation of Cr-containing species, with direct implications for corrosion and dealloying of structural alloys as well as broader molten-salt processing applications. In the present study, the chemical stability of CrCl 2 , CrCl 3 , and Cr 2 O 3 in LiCl-KCl eutectic molten salt during heating and cooling was systematically investigated using in-situ X-ray absorption spectroscopy. The results revealed that CrCl 3 and Cr 2 O 3 remained chemically stable under the tested conditions, whereas CrCl 2 underwent oxidation by impurities to form Cr 2 O 3 at 500 °C, but partially converted back to Cr 2+ species upon cooling to room temperature. Additional gas chromatography measurements detected H 2 evolution during heating of CrCl 2 in LiCl–KCl, supporting the involvement of residual moisture in the oxidation process. Additionally, the interaction between chromium and NiCl 2 in molten salt was examined, indicating that chromium likely reduced Ni 2+ to metallic Ni 0 , while being oxidized to Cr 2+ , which subsequently underwent a similar chemical evolution as CrCl 2 in the molten salt. These findings unravel a temperature-dependent, impurity-mediated redox cycle of Cr species between the initial room-temperature, molten, and post-cooling states in molten chloride salt, providing a foundation for understanding and controlling Cr the dissolution, oxidation and transformation, and for developing effective corrosion-mitigation strategies to enhance the stability of high-temperature structural alloys in molten-salt systems.
items.authors: Yuxiang Peng, Kaifeng Zheng, Kazuhiro Iwamatsu, Ankita Mohanty, Denis Leshchev, Akhil Tayal

items.title: Gas-Conditioned Message Passing Graph Neural Network for Permeability Prediction in Polymeric Membranes
items.abstract: Designing polymeric membranes for diverse gas-separation applications remains a critical challenge. Machine learning (ML) models can significantly accelerate this effort by capturing complex relationships between polymer-gas pairs and enabling permeability prediction over an extended chemical space of gases and polymers. In this work, we present a novel ML framework, the gas-conditioned message passing neural network (GC-MPNN), that jointly combines gas descriptors and polymer chemistry in a fused neural network model. Polymers are represented at the monomer level and encoded as molecular graphs, where node and edge information is propagated through message-passing layers. Six gas species (He, H2, N2, O2, CH4, and CO2) are represented using multiple descriptor sets spanning thermodynamic, kinetic, and electrostatic properties, along with one-hot encodings and combined feature sets that include kinetic plus thermodynamic descriptors and the full physicochemical descriptor set. For each descriptor combination, model hyperparameters are optimized using Bayesian optimization within a leave-one-gas-out (LOGO) validation framework. Test performance is then evaluated on the gas species excluded entirely from the corresponding training fold (out-of-training set) and compared across descriptor sets. For most gas species, the model achieves strong predictive performance (R2 ∼ 0.86–0.96), while CO2 remains more challenging in terms of absolute prediction accuracy (R2 ∼ 0.44). Active learning sampling further improves model performance by adding a few labeled samples from the test gas species into the training set. Among the three strategies tested, deep ensemble-based sampling and random sampling show strong improvement, with R2 reaching approximately ∼ 0.95 for all gas species, while evidential regression shows less consistent improvement. The model is further evaluated on a smaller polymer-gas dataset containing hydrocarbon species (C2H4, C2H6, C3H6, C3H8, and n-C4H10) using the GC-MPNN trained only on the six base gases, achieving moderate to strong Pearson correlations (r ∼ 0.77–0.89) for these out-of-training gases. Overall, this work presents a machine learning model that can learn transferable polymer-gas relationships from known gas species and extend them to previously unseen gases.
items.authors: Krishnendu Mukherjee, Zidan Zhang, Mohammed Alshammasi, Mohammed G. Hashim, Hussain H. Naji, Zainab A. Aithan
items.title_zh: 气体条件下的消息传递图神经网络用于聚合物膜渗透率预测
items.summary_zh: 设计用于多种气体分离应用的聚合物膜仍然是一个关键挑战。机器学习（ML）模型能够显著加速这一过程，通过捕捉聚合物-气体对之间的复杂关系，实现对气体和聚合物的广泛化学空间的渗透率预测。本研究提出了一种新颖的机器学习框架——气体条件下的消息传递神经网络（GC-MPNN），该模型将气体描述符与聚合物化学结合在一起。聚合物在单体水平上表示，并编码为分子图，节点和边的信息通过消息传递层进行传播。六种气体（氦、氢、氮、氧、甲烷和二氧化碳）使用多个描述符集表示，涵盖热力学、动力学和静电特性。模型超参数通过贝叶斯优化在留一气体验证框架内进行优化。测试性能在完全排除的气体物种上进行评估，结果显示大多数气体物种的预测性能强劲（R² ∼ 0.86–0.96）。

items.title: Decarbonizing isolated power systems: The role of renewable sources, storage and grid expansion
items.abstract: Decarbonizing isolated regions is challenging due to fossil fuel dependence and limited grid infrastructure. This study proposes a flexible optimization framework to assess cost-effective decarbonization pathways under different environmental and technological constraints. The methodology integrates automated renewable resource assessment, photovoltaic performance modelling, spatial and temporal clustering, and energy system optimization. The framework is applied to Yukon (Canada), an isolated power system with high hydropower penetration, diesel-dependent remote communities, and limited interconnections. Scenarios include Business-as-Usual (BAU), full decarbonization, intermediate emission constraints, and technology-ban configurations. Achieving net-zero without grid expansion increases system costs fourfold relative to BAU, while grid expansion reduces net-zero costs by about 25%. Intermediate decarbonization is mainly supported by photovoltaic generation and battery storage, whereas deeper decarbonization shifts the system toward large-scale wind deployment coupled with hydrogen storage for long-duration flexibility. The framework is transferable to other isolated and infrastructure-constrained energy systems.
items.authors: Elia Perelli, Elena Rozzi, Paolo Marocco, Marta Gandiglio

items.title: Efficient Long-Wavelength Through-Space Charge Transfer Thermally Activated Delayed Fluorescence in Conformationally Adaptive Emitters without Conformational Locking
items.abstract: Through-space charge-transfer thermally activated delayed fluorescence (TSCT-TADF) emitters often employ conformationally constrained donor–acceptor architectures to control through-space electronic coupling, particularly for long-wavelength emission. Here, we report conformationally adaptive orange-to-red TSCT-TADF emitters based on an S-shaped donor–π–acceptor–π–donor framework composed of phenoxazine donors, xanthene linkers, and a dibenzo[ a,j ]phenazine acceptor. Structural and NMR analyses reveal substantial conformational mobility, while systematic conformational searches and excited-state calculations identify thermally accessible conformers with distinct donor-acceptor geometries and excited-state characteristics. Comparative studies with reference compounds and fragment-resolved transition-density analysis show that the xanthene linker primarily acts as a conformational regulator and that the low-energy CT states have predominant TSCT character with only minor linker involvement. Temperature-dependent early-time photoluminescence measurements reveal continuous spectral relaxation in fluid toluene that slows upon cooling and is absent in rigid Zeonex and mCBP hosts, providing strong evidence for structural relaxation following photoexcitation within a pre-existing conformational ensemble. The emitters exhibit orange-to-red TADF with reverse intersystem crossing rates on the order of 10 5 –10 6 s −1 . Organic light-emitting diodes employing these emitters show electroluminescence at 598–624 nm, external quantum efficiencies up to 14.9%, and limited efficiency roll-off over a broad luminance range. These results demonstrate that efficient long-wavelength TSCT-TADF can be realized without permanent conformational locking and establish a framework for understanding the interplay between ground-state conformational heterogeneity and excited-state structural relaxation.
items.authors: Nae Aota, Jaijanarthanan Lingagouder, Nuno Gandum, Leonardo Evaristo de Sousa, Lucy A. Weatherill, Marc K. Etherington

items.title: SpectraFit-Core: a Rust-cored nonlinear curve-fitting library validated against the NIST Statistical Reference Datasets
items.abstract: Nonlinear least-squares fitting of parametric line shapes is routine in the analysis of spectra, and the analyst often knows relationships between the parameters before the fit starts, such as a shared width or a fixed intensity ratio. SpectraFit-Core is an open-source curve-fitting library in which this knowledge is part of the model. A model is a graph of named components, and each relationship is an expression edge on that graph, within one spectrum or across several spectra fitted jointly in one call. On a measured Fe L2,3 energy-loss spectrum, four such relationships leave the fitted values unchanged and make the edge-step amplitude 28 times more precise. Because the model is a description rather than code, the same graph can be fitted by other implementations and their parameters compared name by name. The parameters and standard errors of the library are checked against certified values: on 22 of the 27 nonlinear-regression problems of the NIST Statistical Reference Datasets, the least accurately recovered parameter agrees to more than six significant figures, and the standard errors agree nearly as well except on Lanczos1. Kernels, analytic Jacobians, and solver iteration run in compiled Rust behind a typed Python interface, which also makes the library faster than lmfit, SciPy, and JAX on its benchmark. A companion repository regenerates the results from the published release. SpectraFit-Core is released under the MIT license, distributed on PyPI and archived on Zenodo.
items.authors: Anselm W. Hahn

items.title: Electrochemical Depolymerization of Propionaldehyde-Stabilized Lignin on Nickel-based Electrodes Enhancing Monomer Yield Recovery
items.abstract: Lignin valorization remains a critical challenge due to its heterogeneous and recalcitrant nature, which complicates conversion into value-added chemicals. While conventional thermochemical methods rely on harsh conditions that compromise biorefinery economics, lignin’s solubility—dictated by its isolation method—further hinders efficient processing. Here, we report a one-pot electrooxidative depolymerization strategy for propionaldehyde-stabilized lignin (PA-lignin) using nickel electrodes in alkaline media. This approach selectively cleaves ~24 % of the lignin polymer into aromatic monomers, predominantly syringyl and guaiacyl derivatives, under mild conditions and without redox mediators. Compared to unmodified lignin, PA-lignin yields 28% ethyl acetate-extractable products, nearly fourfold higher, demonstrating that propionaldehyde capping suppresses condensation reactions and enhances monomer release. The simplicity of this single-step electrochemical process, combined with its improved monomer yield, makes it a promising and scalable upgrade for future lignocellulosic biorefineries.
items.authors: Syed Noman, Cyrille Santerre, Covadonga Lucas-Torres, Edith Nicol, Damien Aureau, David Touboul
items.title_zh: 镍基电极上丙醛稳定木质素的电化学脱聚合研究
items.summary_zh: 木质素的增值利用面临挑战，因其异质性和难降解性使得转化为增值化学品变得复杂。传统热化学方法在苛刻条件下进行，影响生物炼制经济性，而木质素的溶解性又受其分离方法的限制。本文报道了一种在碱性介质中使用镍电极对丙醛稳定木质素（PA-木质素）进行一锅电氧化脱聚合的策略。该方法在温和条件下选择性地将约24%的木质素聚合物裂解为芳香单体，主要为香豆素和愈创木酚衍生物，且无需氧化还原介质。与未改性木质素相比，PA-木质素的乙酸乙酯可提取产物产率达到28%，几乎提高了四倍，表明丙醛封端抑制了缩合反应并增强了单体释放。该单步电化学过程的简便性及其提高的单体产率，使其成为未来木质纤维素生物炼制的有前景的可扩展升级方案。

items.title: Digitalizing Manufacturing Chemistry Targets: A Benchmark for Retrosynthesis Tools
items.abstract: Modern computer-aided synthesis planning (CASP) tools, particularly retrosynthesis planning, are becoming practical aids for the ideation stage of chemical synthesis design. However, the same target molecule can be synthesized via substantially different routes depending on the purpose: a discovery or medicinal chemistry route used to obtain small quantities during early development, or a manufacturing route optimized for industrial-scale production. While CASP tools have been extensively studied and benchmarked for the former, their ability to support manufacturing route design remains largely unexplored. Performance of CASP tools is usually measured by benchmark experiments, which typically report the fraction of target molecules for which a tool can generate a synthesis route, connecting the target molecule through a sequence of intermediates to starting materials. Sometimes, to assess the quality of the generated routes, they are also manually compared with expert-designed routes reported in the literature. Currently, public benchmark datasets focused on process and manufacturing chemistry are lacking. In this study, we take a first step in this direction by analyzing one of the main sources of process chemistry research, the Organic Process Research Development (OPRD) journal. We reviewed OPRD papers published between 1997 and 2022 and selected 2507 papers reporting multi-step synthesis routes. We then separately collected and digitized the target molecules of corresponding synthesis routes as SMILES strings. This resulted in a collection of 2219 unique target molecules, each paired with the DOI of the original publication reporting their corresponding synthesis route. This benchmark can therefore be used to assess how many process-chemistry targets modern CASP tools can solve and, for solved targets, to compare predicted routes with the expert-designed routes reported in the literature. The dataset is publicly available at: https://github.com/KagakuLab/OPRDbench.
items.authors: D. Zankov, M. Barbatti

items.title: Light-assisted bifunctionality in CuPt single-atom alloys for propane dehydroaromatization
items.abstract: Dilute plasmonic alloys offer a route to couple light harvesting with site-specific surface chemistry, but how host and dopant sites cooperate during multi-step hydrocarbon transformations remains poorly understood. Here, we demonstrate that silica-supported CuPt single-atom alloys decouple the elementary steps of propane dehydroaromatization. The Cu host promotes visible light-assisted C-C coupling of C3 intermediates, but Cu remains inactive for direct alkane C-H activation. Introducing atomically dispersed Pt in Cu unlocks propane dehydrogenation and enables a parallel aromatization pathway to benzene under illumination. Isotopic labeling, wavelength- and power-dependent kinetics, catalyst comparisons, and theoretical modeling support a bifunctional mechanism in which Pt sites generate dehydrogenated C3 intermediates, the Cu host facilitates C-C coupling, and the Cu-Pt interface promotes cyclization. These results establish light-assisted single-atom/host cooperation as a design principle for plasmonic alkane upgrading.
items.authors: Yicheng Wang, Moumita Kar, Emma-Rose Newmeyer, Zachary A. Long, Minjung Kim, Matthew Hershey

items.title: The helium ground-state energy to 60 significant figures on a laptop
items.abstract: We report a variational upper bound on the nonrelativistic, infinite-nuclear-mass ground-state energy of helium whose first 60 significant figures are converged, E0 = −2.903 724 377 034 119 598 311 159 245 194 404 446 696 925 311 117 290 339 042 34 Eh, 16 more than the best previous record. The calculation runs on a laptop and the method, which we call FLAKE (Fock-log anisotropic Kronecker eigensolver), combines four ingredients. (i) A change of variables making Schwartz’s Hylleraas-type basis with logarithms an exact tensor product, so the Hamiltonian is a sum of 27 Kronecker products of small matrices. (ii) Exact, arbitrary-precision orthonormalisation of the small radial and angular Gram factors removes all cancellation from the large computation. (iii) Fixed-point products at about 280 bits are split without error into ordinary double-precision matrix multiplications. (iv) The variational space is anisotropic: it carries extra radial degree and a tower of (ln s)p functions only at low angular order, as dictated by channelresolved convergence rates. Every energy quoted is certified by an independent arbitrary-precision evaluation of the Rayleigh quotient of the explicit trial function. The remaining error is estimated from geometric convergence laws that predicted subsequent energy increments to within 2%.
items.authors: Adam Baskerville

items.title: Evaluation of birnessite-based electrocatalysts for ethylene glycol oxidation to formate: towards biocatalysis and electrocatalysis-based waste plastic upgrading
items.abstract: Ethylene glycol (EG) electrooxidation provides an alternative anodic reaction to the 20 oxygen evolution reaction (OER) and enables the conversion of EG-containing plastic hydrolysates into value-added products, potentially facilitating downstream product recovery and purification. Its activity and selectivity depend on the surface redox chemistry of the catalyst and competition with OER. Here, Co-, Fe-, Ni-, and NiFe- 2 modified birnessite-derived manganese oxides were prepared by microwave-assisted 25 hydrothermal synthesis and evaluated for EG oxidation in alkaline media. The synthesis conditions affected both the MnOx phase and the metal content of the recovered solids, leading to hetero-structured electrocatalysts. The Ni-modified birnessite, prepared under neutral conditions with relatively high Ni content and a poorly crystalline birnessite-type structure, showed optimized EG oxidation activity for formate 30 production. The applied potential further affected the formate selectivity. At 1.6 V vs RHE, formate Faradaic efficiency reached 93%, while increasing the potential to 1.9 V increased the overall anodic current but reduced Faradaic efficiency. Nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) and high-performance liquid chromatography (HPLC) identified formate as the major soluble product, while glycolate was detected as an intermediate. 35 This study demonstrated proof-of-concept electro-oxidation of enzyme-catalysisderived EG from polyethylene terephthalate (PET) and polyethylene furanoate (PEF) hydrolysates.
items.authors: Nicklas Munksgaard, Andreas Karlsen, Emil Riis Wolfhagen, Peter Kjær Kristensen, Cristiano Varrone, Virender Kumar
